raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
We are building the next generation of our UI foundation for CrowdStrike's platform called Kestrel which includes new UI and backend features to help customers 'Stop the Breach' by unifying data across security domains, streamlining access to the most important security information, and allowing users to more effectively personalize their user experience by role. You will play a key role in innovating, building and maintaining critical backend features in support of the Kestrel platform.


Bring your experience in distributed technologies, your great API and systems design sensibilities, and your passion for writing code that performs at high scale. Your work will enable hundreds of our UI engineers spread across dozens of feature teams to build the experience customers need to keep pace with and respond to adversaries by leveraging the power of the CrowdStrike platform in the most effective manner for their respective teams. You will be working with multiple backend teams, core service teams, and UI + backend feature teams to bring this new feature to life.


If this sounds like the challenge for you and you have the experience + technical skills that reflect your readiness, submit your resume and let's have a conversation.


PLEASE NOTE: This role is open to candidates based within 30 miles of Dublin, only.


While the position is fully remote for now, CrowdStrike plans to open a Dublin and office (within the next 18-24 months). Once the office is established, we anticipate a hybrid working arrangement of approximately 2 -3 days per week in office.

What You’ll Do:


  • Design, develop, document, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large scale services.
  • Take ownership and be accountable for deliverables.
  • Triage system issues and debug by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on service operations.
  • Mentor other engineers on web and backend engineers on use of our feature services.
  • Constantly re-evaluate our products to improve architecture, testing coverage, knowledge models, user experience, performance, observability and stability.
  • Partner with product teams in understanding their needs, work with PM to document the new requirements, and implement those new features within our feature services
  • Participate in on-call responsibilities for the sustainment and maximizing the availability of the service

What You’ll Use:


  • Go (Golang)
  • Python
  • GIT
  • Cassandra
  • Kafka
  • OpenSearch
  • Kubernetes
  • Postgres
  • Redis
  • AWS Cloud

What You’ll Need:


  • Degree in Computer Science (or commensurate experience in data structures/algorithms/distributed systems).
  • The ability to scale backend systems – sharding, partitioning, scaling horizontally are second nature to you.
  • The desire to ship code and the love of seeing your bits run in production.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges.
  • Team player skills – we embrace collaborating as a team as much as possible.
  • A thorough understanding of engineering best practices from appropriate testing paradigms to effective peer code reviews and resilient architecture.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast paced, test-driven, collaborative and iterative programming environment.
  • The skills to meet your commitments on time and produce high quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:


  • Existing exposure to Go,AWS, Kubernetes, Cassandra, Kafka, OpenSearch.
  • Experience working on security products.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.


CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the Role

We are looking for a People Operations Associate - Regional to manage day-to-day HR operations for employees across multiple countries.

You will work across payroll, EOR and HR vendors, onboarding and offboarding, employee records, and local employment requirements. The role currently supports approximately 15-20 countries and will expand as BJAK grows into new markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage monthly payroll operations across multiple countries, including payroll inputs, changes, deductions, validation and reconciliation.

  • Coordinate with EOR, payroll and HR service providers to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Manage employee onboarding, contract changes, transfers and offboarding across different countries.

  • Maintain accurate employee records, employment documents and HR system data.

  • Manage day-to-day EOR and HR vendor operations, including employee cases, invoices, service issues and escalations.

  • Research employment requirements in new and existing markets, including payroll, statutory benefits, leave, termination and employment compliance.

  • Maintain country-specific HR documentation, processes and SOPs.

  • Identify payroll, employment or operational issues and work with internal teams and vendors to resolve them.

What You Will Need

  • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, payroll, people operations or a related role.

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple countries is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll, EOR providers or international HR vendors is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling payroll, employee data and employment documentation.

  • Ability to research local employment requirements and turn them into clear processes and documentation.

  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and experience working with HR systems.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Ability to manage multiple countries, vendors and deadlines at the same time.

Customer Support Associate – SeatGeek Job Description

Location: Remote – Philippines
Working hours: 8AM - 5PM EST
Working days: 5 working days in a week with 2 days off in a row
Compensation: $700 per month

About SeatGeek

SeatGeek believes live events are powerful experiences that unite humans. With our technological savvy and fan-first attitude, we’re simplifying and modernizing the ticketing industry.

As a Customer Support Representative supporting SeatGeek through Frontier, you’ll help fans navigate every stage of their live-event experience. From accessing tickets before a major game to resolving an unexpected issue close to event time, you’ll provide clear, empathetic, and dependable support when customers need it most.

You’ll assist customers through phone, email, and live chat while developing a strong understanding of SeatGeek’s platform, policies, and customer experience standards. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating with people, and creating positive experiences in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll do

  • Support SeatGeek customers through phone, email, and live chat
  • Help customers with questions related to ticket purchases, ticket delivery, transfers, account access, payments, refunds, and event changes
  • Investigate customer concerns using SeatGeek’s systems, policies, and internal resources
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically, particularly when customers are dealing with urgent or frustrating situations
  • Take ownership of customer issues and work toward accurate, timely, and practical resolutions
  • Document customer interactions and resolutions accurately
  • Identify situations that require additional support and escalate them through the appropriate channels
  • Meet expectations related to customer satisfaction, quality, productivity, attendance, and schedule adherence
  • Participate in regular coaching, quality reviews, training, and team meetings
  • Follow all customer-data, account-security, confidentiality, and information-security requirements
  • Share recurring customer concerns and process gaps with the Team Lead to help improve the overall fan experience
  • Collaborate closely with teammates and internal partners to create a consistent and reliable customer experience

What you have

  • At least two years of experience in customer support, customer service, contact-center operations, or another customer-facing role
  • Strong spoken and written English
  • Experience assisting customers through phone, email, or live chat; experience working across multiple channels is preferred
  • A customer-first mindset and the ability to remain calm and helpful during difficult conversations
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to determine when an issue should be resolved independently or escalated
  • High attention to detail and the ability to document information accurately
  • Comfort learning new systems, policies, and workflows
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • A track record of reliability, punctuality, and ownership
  • Openness to feedback and the ability to apply coaching quickly
  • A collaborative, “one team” approach to working with colleagues

Remote-work requirements

  • A reliable computer and headset with a microphone for the training period (work equipment is provided once you join the live team)
  • A stable high-speed internet connection suitable for voice and video calls
  • A dependable backup internet connection
  • A quiet and professional workspace
  • Ability to meet SeatGeek and Frontier’s information-security and workspace requirements

Training

Your journey starts with an advanced assessment sessions conducted by Frontier to set you up for success from day one. You’ll get hands-on with SeatGeek’s platform, support tools, and phone, email, and chat workflows, practice with realistic customer scenarios, and learn directly from experienced coaches and teammates who want you to thrive.

By the end, you’ll have the product knowledge, confidence, and skills to handle live customer conversations with ease. Your $700 monthly compensation begins when you join the live support team after completing training.

To join the live team, you’ll meet the program’s standards for attendance, knowledge, quality, security, and customer simulations. Everyone who completes it graduates ready to deliver great support and make a real difference for fans.

Why you’ll love this role

  • You’ll help fans enjoy memorable sports, concert, theater, and live entertainment experiences
  • You’ll solve meaningful customer problems rather than simply provide scripted responses
  • You’ll be part of a new team and have the opportunity to help shape how it grows
  • You’ll gain experience supporting a leading technology platform in the live-events industry
  • You’ll work with a collaborative team that values ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement

Compensation and benefits

  • Monthly compensation: $700 per month, beginning when you join the live support team
  • Full-time, remote working arrangement
  • Work equipment provided

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of relevant work experience is required, plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Ready to be a leader with the company that is committed to pushing the limits of truly advanced technologies? At General Dynamics Mission Systems, we create the products and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. The work we do is so advanced, it’s often classified. If you want to put your talent in the spotlight, it’s waiting for you right now, right here. We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between. Utilizing your seasoned team building skills, the Sr Advanced Program Performance Management Specialist - Master Scheduler will utilize required experiences with an integrated performance management, schedule management, or subject matter expert focus. Essentially, you’ll lead a team in contract/program cost and/or schedule development and management/analysis for developing engineering programs for critical major components, or production or logistics programs for a large custom subsystems or small total systems. The scope of the programs will have a contract value typically at $20-50M per year, with total program value of $50-300M. You’ll lead the development of the program cost and/or schedule baselines within the contract parameters, the analysis of program performance (historical and predictive), the monitoring of the contract/program estimate at completion, and the review of results and recommendations to program teams. NOTE: This is a PPM/EVM Master Scheduler role...it is NOT a PM or PMP role.

What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent plus a minimum of 8 years relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years relevant experience
  • Advanced user in MS Project scheduling and EVMS tools and principles
  • Experience in coordination of program requirements across planning stages with several subcontractors across distinct product lines
  • Exceptional experience with DCMA audits

What sets you apart:

  • Creative thinking with the ability to multi-task
  • Commitment to ongoing professional development
  • Team player who thrives in collaborative environments and revels in team success
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits

Workplace Options:

This position can be supported remotely but proximity to any of our 'hubs' (MA, VA, AZ) is ideal.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $130,000.00 - USD $140,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

raw.description:
🚀 About Finalis

Finalis is the leading platform enabling independent and boutique investment banking firms to operate legally and compliantly. The firm provides regulatory affiliation and compliance infrastructure supporting private market transactions, including M&A, capital raising, private placements, secondary transactions, and alternative investments.

✨ About the role

The Investment Banking Compliance Analyst supports Finalis’s investment banking and private markets business by providing compliance guidance throughout the transaction lifecycle. This role works directly with investment bankers and registered representatives on private placements, M&A engagements, and other private market transactions, from initial engagement and due diligence through closing.

We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious and enjoys understanding how transactions work. The strongest candidate will be comfortable analyzing complex or unfamiliar structures, asking thoughtful questions, and becoming a trusted compliance resource to our bankers.

✍️ What you'll do

Transaction & Regulatory Review

  • Review proposed investment banking engagements, engagement letters, compensation arrangements, and transaction structures for compliance with applicable securities laws, FINRA requirements, and Finalis policies.
  • Review private securities offerings and applicable Securities Act exemptions, with particular emphasis on Regulation D and Rules 506(b) and 506(c).
  • Analyze M&A, secondary, and other private market transactions for applicable securities-law and broker-dealer considerations.
  • Review M&A transactions under the federal M&A broker exemption framework and identify circumstances requiring registered broker-dealer involvement.
  • Support applicable FINRA private placement requirements, including Rules 5122 and 5123.

Due Diligence & Transaction Execution

  • Conduct risk-based due diligence on issuers, sponsors, control persons, and other relevant transaction parties and evaluate identified red flags.
  • Review offering materials, organizational documents, financial information, transaction agreements, and other relevant diligence materials.
  • Work with bankers to resolve diligence and compliance questions and appropriately document conclusions, conditions, and approvals.
  • Monitor transactions for material changes and review transaction and closing documentation for consistency with the approved structure.
  • Support transactions through closing, including satisfaction of applicable compliance conditions, books and records, and required regulatory filings.

Banker & Business Partnership

  • Serve as a day-to-day compliance resource for investment bankers and registered representatives.
  • Participate in transaction calls and work directly with bankers to understand proposed structures and resolve regulatory and compliance questions.
  • Ask thoughtful questions to understand the economic substance of transactions rather than relying solely on labels or form.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear, practical guidance while maintaining sound compliance judgment.
  • Stay current on regulatory developments affecting private placements, M&A, and private market transactions.

🔎 Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in broker-dealer compliance, investment banking, securities law, private markets, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of private placements and exemptions from Securities Act registration, particularly Regulation D.
  • Familiarity with FINRA requirements applicable to private placements and investment banking activities.
  • Ability to understand complex transaction structures and legal, financial, and offering documents.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgment, and intellectual curiosity.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and comfort working directly with investment bankers and other sophisticated stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple active transactions and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Track!

  • You currently hold, or have previously held, one or more relevant FINRA registrations, including the Series 7, 24, 79, and/or 82.
  • You have experience reviewing Regulation D offerings and FINRA Rules 5122 and 5123.
  • You have experience working on M&A transactions and analyzing transactions under the federal M&A broker exemption framework.
  • You have experience reviewing investment banking engagement letters, offering documents, purchase agreements, subscription documents, and closing materials.
  • You have experience conducting issuer or transaction-level due diligence and evaluating regulatory or compliance red flags.
  • You have familiarity with private funds, SPVs, secondary transactions, or other complex private market structures.
  • You have experience at an investment bank, broker-dealer, securities law firm, FINRA, the SEC, or another financial-services regulatory organization.

🌟 What we offer

  • 100% Remote work
  • Competitive USD salary
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Additional Flex Days
  • Benefits Package (Healthcare, Medical, Vision, Dental, 401k)
  • Paid Family Leave
  • Diverse and inclusive culture

Our Company

BrightSpring Health Services

Overview

The Business Systems Analyst - SR serves as a subject matter expert for Homecare Homebase (HCHB) and related clinical applications. This role is responsible for providing technical support, optimization of systems, processes, implementing system enhancements, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. The analyst collaborates across teams to maintain system integrity, improve operational efficiency, and support clinical staff through training and technical guidance.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert on HCHB and other clinical systems, focusing on workflow optimization and documentation improvements.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to maintain system integrity and performance.
  • Implement system changes and enhancements, including release management, clinical form updates, workflow adjustments, service codes, table setups, and integrations.
  • Manage and resolve HCHB/Pointcare incidents and service requests via ServiceNow; escalate issues to vendors when necessary and monitor resolution.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to assess the impact of system changes on service desk ticket volume.
  • Foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support projects involving the implementation or expansion of clinical applications.
  • Provide training and education on HCHB functionality and related systems.
  • Participate in audits to ensure compliance with SOX, HIPAA and other regulatory requirements.
  • Support integration between software systems for seamless data flow.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree, preferred.
  • Minimum of 3 years in the Home Health industry, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience supporting/implementing the HomeCare Homebase EMR system.
  • Understanding of Home Health regulations and operational workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking and sound judgment to assess risks and downstream impacts of system changes.
  • Proven ability to lead/manage projects or consistently complete assigned tasks within established timelines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.

About our Line of Business

BrightSpring Health Services provides complementary home- and community-based health solutions for medically complex populations in need of specialized and/or chronic care. Through the Company’s service lines, including pharmacy, home health care, and rehabilitation, we provide comprehensive and more integrated care and clinical solutions in all 50 states to approximately 500,000 customers, clients and patients daily. BrightSpring has consistently demonstrated strong and industry-leading quality metrics across its services lines, while improving the health and quality of life for high-need individuals and reducing overall healthcare system costs. For more information, please visit www.brightspringhealth.com. Follow us on Facebook, LinkedIn, and X.

raw.excerpt: Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure.
raw.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.


What you'll be responsible for:


You will support Circle’s Internal Audit function by planning and delivering technology and integrated audits over financial, operational, and compliance controls for Circle and its subsidiaries, including Circle National Trust. You will lead audit projects from strategic planning and scoping through fieldwork, reporting, and remediation tracking while collaborating closely with 1st- and 2nd-line risk functions to maintain an accurate risk profile. You will also develop and promote the use of generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to streamline audit workflows and improve testing efficiency.


What you'll work on:


  • Developing and enhancing internal audit frameworks, methodologies, and assurance processes for technology audits
  • Conducting risk-based technology, systems, and operational audits to assess compliance and controls
  • Conducting effective client interviews and documentation reviews to inform scoping and testing
  • Analyzing process and system documentation to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness
  • Designing and executing fieldwork testing strategies, including substantive tests and clear working papers

Job Description

This role is fully remote and must be located within the 50 U.S. states. Standard working hours are in Eastern Timezone. Semi-annual travel may be required to a Devoted office for on-site work.


A bit about this role:

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Devoted is growing at an incredible pace, and we are thrilled to welcome and serve every new member who joins us. This growth demands that our Utilization Management (UM) operation must scale and evolve without ever losing sight of the people at the center of every authorization.

We believe UM done right means decisions that are correct, fair, and fast, delivered through a frictionless process and with heart. Behind every request is a member waiting on care and a provider working to deliver it. UM is hard, but the challenge doesn’t exempt us from our mission.

We are seeking a curious, operationally minded leader to serve as Director, Utilization Management Operations. Reporting to the Vice President of Health Services, you will lead the teams behind our administrative work: a large onshore and offshore team of UM Administrative Coordinators who manage intake, outreach, notifications, and follow-up. You will also hold dotted-line accountability for monitoring and ensuring the success of our Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT).

This role is for someone who is energized by a complex process: someone who wants to unravel it, reimagine it, and lead the build of something simpler, faster, and more consistent. You will have significant influence over the roadmap for Orinoco, our internal technology platform, and an integrated AI engine to put to work. This role will help pave the way towards realizing the next generation of our UM program, driving improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, and experience for our members and provider partners.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • SLA & Timeliness Ownership: Own SLA performance for the administrative steps that support authorization review across UM, delivering consistent, predictable performance at a meaningfully lower cost. Hold dotted-line accountability for Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT), partnering with the clinical leaders of that team to monitor performance, surface risks early, and remove administrative barriers to on-time decisions.
  • Process Reimagination: Map our administrative processes end to end, including auth intake, requests for additional clinical information, facility census checks, member and provider notifications, and member follow-up, and lead their redesign for speed, consistency, and simplicity.
  • Technology & AI Leadership: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the Orinoco roadmap so that process and technology evolve together. Put our integrated AI tools to work to remove manual effort, so our administrative capacity no longer has to grow at the same rate as our membership.
  • Build for Measurement: Design processes that are highly measurable and transparent by default. Partner with Data Science to define and monitor the KPIs that matter, including timeliness, cost per authorization, quality, and provider experience, and use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • People & Vendor Leadership: Lead and develop a team that includes approximately 50 onshore UM Administrative Coordinators and their leaders. Manage our offshore vendor partnership, which supports more than 250 administrative team members, holding it to clear performance standards while building a shared culture of ownership and care.
  • Provider & Member Experience: Partner with the Provider Network team to understand what providers and facilities need from this process, and build it in. Design every touchpoint, from outreach to notifications to follow-up, with the humans on the other end in mind.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with the Senior Director of UM, who owns end-to-end authorization performance, along with the UM Medical Directors, Compliance, Provider Network, Data Science, and Engineering teams to keep the operation aligned and consistently audit-ready.

Required skills and experience:

  • Mission & Heart: A genuine commitment to treating members like family, and a belief that operational excellence and empathy belong together.
  • Proven Operator at Scale: A track record of leading high-volume operations that deliver consistent SLA performance.
  • Builder Mindset: Experience taking a complex, multi-step process apart and leading the build of a simpler, more scalable one, rather than only maintaining what exists. You are naturally curious and ask why a step exists before deciding how to improve it.
  • Metrics-Oriented: You build for measurement, are comfortable working deep in the workflows and the data, and use both to drive decisions and hold teams and partners accountable.
  • Technology & AI Curiosity: Experience partnering with product and engineering teams, and genuine excitement about using AI-enabled tools to transform how work gets done.
  • Vendor Management: Experience managing vendor partners against clear performance and quality standards.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into actionable updates for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Healthcare Operations: Experience in payer operations, utilization management, claims, provider revenue cycle, or a similar high-volume healthcare environment. Prior UM experience is not required.
  • Medicare Advantage Familiarity: Understanding of Medicare Advantage operations and CMS requirements.
  • Advanced Degree: MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.
  • MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.


Salary range: $182,000 - 247,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

raw.title: Presales Solutions Architect - Dell
raw.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
raw.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Dell Solutions Architect collaborates with SHI account teams, regional Solutions Engineers, Dell Technologies field teams, and customers to assess complex infrastructure requirements and create defensible, outcome-aligned architectures. The role leads technical discovery, whiteboarding, solution design, competitive differentiation, validation, and executive-level technical communication across Dell infrastructure domains.

This is not a general product-support role. It is a customer-facing technical pursuit and architecture position designed to extend the regional field Solutions Engineer, lead strategic and transformational opportunities, and convert each engagement into reusable technical intellectual property for SHI.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Partner with SHI account teams and regional Solutions Engineers to qualify, scope, and lead complex Dell Technologies opportunities while preserving regional ownership and customer continuity.
  • Lead discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business, operational, application, security, and infrastructure requirements into clear architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and next steps.
  • Analyze assessment data, workload requirements, configuration information, and technical telemetry to support evidence-based sizing and architecture decisions.
  • Design and defend Dell-based solutions across compute and AI, storage, private cloud and hyperconverged infrastructure, data protection and cyber resilience, and data center networking.
  • Create architectures using relevant Dell Technologies platforms, including PowerEdge, PowerStore, PowerScale, PowerSwitch, Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, and supporting AIOps capabilities.
  • Lead customer whiteboards, technical workshops, architecture reviews, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and validation activities for complex or transformational pursuits.
  • Explain architectural trade-offs and competitive alternatives with credibility, using SHI’s cross-OEM perspective while maintaining a clear, evidence-based recommendation.
  • Integrate Dell infrastructure with the customer’s broader environment, including VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, Microsoft and public-cloud services, data protection ecosystems, networking fabrics, automation, and SHI professional services.
  • Collaborate with Dell field, specialist, engineering, and roadmap resources to validate designs, resolve technical risks, and align the right resources to strategic pursuits.
  • Develop complete technical deliverables such as discovery guides, reference architectures, sizing checklists, bills of material inputs, migration considerations, battlecards, workshop decks, and decision or risk logs.
  • Produce reusable technical IP from customer engagements and contribute it to the team repository so successful approaches can be repeated across regions.
  • Enable SHI sales and technical teams through field coaching, opportunity support, technical briefings, solution playbooks, and customer-ready content.
  • Maintain opportunity awareness by identifying attach opportunities, services alignment, lifecycle and modernization triggers, competitive displacement potential, and agreed technical next steps.
  • Manage multiple concurrent pursuits with disciplined documentation, follow-up, stakeholder communication, and escalation.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Adaptability: Can proactively adapt to challenging situations, anticipate changes, and make modifications to meet the demands of changing circumstances.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.
  • Documentation: Independently produces and maintains documentation for routine processes; ensures accuracy and consistency.
  • Leadership: Can proactively seek out leadership roles, initiate team projects, and contribute to team development and success.
  • Problem Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions.
  • Teamwork: Can lead a team effectively, facilitate cooperation, sharing information, and ensuring that all team members are able to contribute to their full potential.
  • Self – Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.


Skill Level Requirements


  • Advanced experience leading complex data center architecture and pre-sales technical engagements.
  • Advanced knowledge in at least one Dell Technologies domain, with working knowledge across multiple adjacent areas including Compute + AI, Storage, Private Cloud + HCI, Data Protection, and Networking.
  • Expertise in architecting, sizing, integrating, and positioning Dell Technologies infrastructure within complex, multi-vendor customer environments.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery and translate business and application requirements into architecture, configuration guidance, migration considerations, and validation plans.
  • Strong experience with PowerEdge and accelerator-based infrastructure supporting virtualization, private cloud, modern applications, and AI workloads.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise storage concepts and Dell platforms such as PowerStore and PowerScale, including performance, availability, data services, connectivity, and operational considerations.
  • Strong understanding of private cloud and HCI technologies, including Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, and relevant Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience with data protection and cyber-resilience architectures, including PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, CyberSense, backup and recovery, immutability, recovery validation, and business continuity.
  • Working knowledge of data center networking, including Ethernet fabrics, PowerSwitch, SONiC, storage connectivity, and infrastructure integration dependencies.
  • Ability to confidently present, articulate, and defend proposed solutions during customer-facing architecture reviews, technical discussions, and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical, operational, and business value while supporting the sales process and maintaining architectural integrity.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, technical communication, and customer-facing skills.

Other Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required.
  • Five or more years of experience in solutions architecture, systems engineering, technical pre-sales, infrastructure consulting, or a comparable customer-facing role preferred.
  • Demonstrated customer-facing experience with complex infrastructure discovery, design, presentation, and technical decision support.
  • Ability to travel to SHI, Dell Technologies, partner, and customer meetings and events as business needs require.
  • Current Dell Technologies training or certification in one or more relevant domains preferred; advanced architecture, VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft, networking, security, or data protection credentials are also valued.


The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience developing full‑stack web applications using modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Familiarity with DevOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Azure DevOps)
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for deployment and scaling
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL querying, and API design (REST/GraphQL)
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with non‑technical staff, gathering requirements and translating them into user‑centric software solutions

Standard Job Description

When it comes to using cutting-edge machine learning to tackle complex problems, Lockheed Martin is driven by a singular mission focus and desire to continuously innovate. Today’s challenges to global security aren’t just changing – they’re accelerating faster than ever before. Through our dedication to our mission, our AI-enabled systems are changing the way militaries operate and protect their forces, the way first responders fight fires, and how researchers explore the far reaches of space and the ocean’s depths.

The Lockheed Martin Artificial Intelligence Center (LAIC) team is seeking a high energy engineer with hands-on experience in developing AI/ML software in support of the AI Consulting team. In this role you will be part of the larger AI Foundations organization consisting of colleagues possessing varying skill sets including AI/Machine Learning specialists, front-end and back-end developers, data engineers, product managers, and other data scientists. The selected candidate will focus on the AI Consulting team, but will be included as part of a broader range of projects across the LAIC portfolio. The AI Consulting team is focused on employing small, innovative, and agile teams to rapidly iterate and mature solutions from prototypes to deployment for utilization across the Lockheed Martin enterprise.
The LAIC AI Consulting Team’s mission includes serving as a center of excellence for AI at Lockheed Martin. The candidate will work to disseminate best practices of the AI Consulting team to other AI and data science teams in the corporation. The candidate will be required to create knowledge materials to publish these best practices, as well as meet with other data science leaders in Lockheed Martin to teach and discuss these practices.

The Full Stack Software Engineer Stf designs, develops, deploys, and supports secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions across the full application lifecycle. The role is responsible for frontend and backend development, API and database design, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and production application stability.

This position will build and operate AI/ML-enabled web applications, integrating services such as model-serving APIs, LLM providers, vector-search tools, and internal machine-learning platforms. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into user-focused technical solutions; developing responsive interfaces and backend services; and ensuring applications are maintainable, performant, and secure.

The engineer will provide technical leadership in Agile delivery, infrastructure automation, deployment processes, monitoring, incident response, and reliability improvements. The role partners with product, data science, security, infrastructure, operations, and business stakeholders while mentoring engineers and establishing sound engineering standards.

Desired Skills

  • Experience delivering and operating AI/ML-powered web applications, including integrations with model-serving APIs, LLM providers, embedding or vector-search systems, and internal machine-learning platforms.
  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation workflows, AI observability, performance monitoring, and safe rollout of AI capabilities.
  • Advanced experience owning production CI/CD and release processes across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and containerized services, including automated testing, security scanning, artifact management, deployment controls, and rollback strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and cloud environment management using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Helm, or similar technologies.
  • Experience improving the reliability, scalability, and availability of cloud-native applications through Kubernetes operations, autoscaling, networking, secrets management, load balancing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning.
  • Strong knowledge of application, cloud, and AI security practices, including secure coding, OWASP guidance, IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, dependency security, and protections for AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and sensitive-data exposure.
  • Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architectures, including message queues, background jobs, streaming workflows, serverless services, or similar patterns.
  • Proven technical leadership, including establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and proactively managing production risks related to quality, performance, usability, reliability, and security.
  • Experience partnering with product, data science, security, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI-enabled solutions.

Pay Information

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $120600.00 - $224000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $108600.00 - $201600.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to guide a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

We're seeking a results-driven and strategic Director, Sales Engineering to lead our US SLED Sales Engineering organization reporting to the Vice President, Solutions Consulting - Strategics.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Recruiting, mentoring, and building a world-class team of sales engineering managers, architects, and individual contributors
  • Collaborating with sales leadership and clients to develop and execute winning segment and account-level strategies. You will own the technical sales motion from start to finish
  • Refining and scaling the core sales engineering processes, ensuring consistency and efficiency
  • Acting as a key technical leader and executive sponsor for strategic customers and partners, representing the company at industry events, forums, and executive briefings
  • Driving the technical strategy that positions our solutions as essential to the customer's long-term business objectives

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Industry certifications including CCNP, JNCIP, PCNSA , CISSP, or CCSP

  • A deep understanding of complex, multi-year sales cycles and expertise in value-based storytelling

raw.description:
Client Partner (East Coast, US)

Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage. Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.


We Take Ownership

Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner at Lateral, you’ll be the trusted business partner to our clients, shaping how they think about technology as a driver of measurable value. You’ll own key client relationships end to end: from identifying opportunities and shaping deals, to ensuring delivery meets (and exceeds) commercial outcomes.

This is a role for someone who blends commercial acumen, consultative selling, and delivery awareness. You’ll know how to open doors, nurture relationships, and connect Lateral’s capabilities to client business priorities.

You will:

  • Build, grow, and own a portfolio of client relationships, driving long-term revenue and partnership value.

  • Identify and convert new opportunities within existing and new accounts. You’ll know how to move from a first conversation to a signed engagement with clarity and confidence.

  • Partner with Delivery and Technical Leads to ensure projects align with client goals and deliver tangible business results.

  • Be the voice of the client inside Lateral translating their commercial objectives into clear internal focus.

  • Develop and execute account strategies: mapping stakeholders, anticipating needs, and expanding our footprint through trust and results.

  • Represent Lateral externally - you’ll already have a network you can activate on day one.

  • Stay close to delivery without being in it: you’ll track satisfaction, renewals, and the health of the partnership, ensuring we keep raising the bar.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a self-starting, commercially driven operator who thrives at the intersection of business development and delivery excellence.

You must bring:

  • Proven commercial results. You’ve personally led complex deals from 0% to 100% and can walk us through how you built the relationship, structured the opportunity, and closed it.

  • An active network. You have a Rolodex of people you’d call on day one - contacts who trust your judgment and would take your call because you’ve delivered value before.

  • Agency mindset. You move fast, think commercially, and build momentum without needing playbooks. You can create opportunity where none existed.

  • Client leadership. You’ve been the face of delivery and the commercial voice for clients, ensuring their business objectives stay at the heart of everything we build.

  • Strategic curiosity. You’re energized by understanding how businesses make money, where technology creates leverage, and how to shape deals that align both.

  • Reputation for excellence. If we called five people you’ve worked with, they’d describe you as proactive, trustworthy, sharp, and relentless in driving results.

  • Comfort in ambiguity. You can build clarity where there’s none and know when to push, when to listen, and when to close.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Software Developer to support the implementation, enhancement, and integration of a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) within a regulated manufacturing environment.

The project focuses on implementing MES to enable Electronic Batch Records (EBR), equipment integration, and OCPLM integration. The objective is to improve manufacturing efficiency, reduce batch record errors, automate data capture, enhance traceability and audit readiness, and streamline manufacturing operations.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, SQL, full-stack development, and MES applications, along with the ability to develop scalable solutions across multiple manufacturing sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance MES applications using C#, .NET, and related development technologies.
  • Develop and implement solutions supporting Electronic Batch Records (EBR), manufacturing workflows, and system integrations.
  • Support MES implementation and customization across multiple manufacturing facilities.
  • Develop reusable, scalable software components aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing Operations, IT, Engineering, and Quality teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Develop tools and automation to improve MES development efficiency and operational productivity.
  • Provide technical analysis, troubleshooting, and production support for MES applications.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, database procedures, and data integrations.
  • Support integration between MES, manufacturing equipment, and enterprise applications.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, development, testing, and delivery.
  • Follow software development best practices, including version control, code reviews, testing, and documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement, software standardization, and adoption of modern development practices.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to technical architecture and engineering standards.
  • Utilize AI-assisted development tools while reviewing, validating, and correcting generated code.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional full-stack software development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or supporting Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong SQL development experience with Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle.
  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular or React.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, application development, and system integration.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN.
  • Strong knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting production applications and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality software solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with MES software platforms and Electronic Batch Records (EBR).
  • Equipment integration using IoT, OPC, or Kepware.
  • Experience integrating MES with Oracle
  • Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical Manufacturing experience.
  • Knowledge of AWS/Azure, TDD, and automated testing.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AI-assisted development tools.

Other Job Details:

  • Job Type: C2C or W2.
  • Duration: 12+ months with high possibility of extension.
  • Location: REMOTE.
  • Interviews: Video interviews.
  • Docs required: ID proof will be required.

From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're looking for an Integrated ABM Campaign Manager to develop and scale creative, targeted campaigns that engage priority accounts and drive pipeline across our Enterprise and Mid-Market segments.

You'll own the strategy and execution of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns, bringing together paid advertising, personalized content, direct mail, gifting, and coordinated Sales outreach to reach the right people at the right accounts.

This is a hands-on role where you'll have the freedom to test new ideas, build integrated programs, and use data to understand what's working. You'll also partner closely with our wider ABM, Sales, and Partner Marketing team to connect campaigns with account priorities, strategic experiences, and partner-led opportunities.

  • Manage targeted paid advertising, particularly LinkedIn, alongside personalized landing pages and other digital ABM experiences.
  • Own direct mail, gifting, and scalable prospect engagement programs, including gifting program workflows.
  • Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to identify target accounts, build contact lists, and activate campaigns.
  • Develop coordinated Sales outreach plays and sequences with the Sales Enablement Lead to support campaign engagement and follow-up.
  • Work with Product Marketing and Content to develop relevant messaging and creative for priority audiences.
  • Collaborate with our wider Enterprise ABM, Events, and Partner Marketing teams on account-specific activations, event invitations, and joint campaigns.
