raw.title: Presales Solutions Architect - Dell
raw.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
raw.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Dell Solutions Architect collaborates with SHI account teams, regional Solutions Engineers, Dell Technologies field teams, and customers to assess complex infrastructure requirements and create defensible, outcome-aligned architectures. The role leads technical discovery, whiteboarding, solution design, competitive differentiation, validation, and executive-level technical communication across Dell infrastructure domains.

This is not a general product-support role. It is a customer-facing technical pursuit and architecture position designed to extend the regional field Solutions Engineer, lead strategic and transformational opportunities, and convert each engagement into reusable technical intellectual property for SHI.

This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management.

Role Description

  • Partner with SHI account teams and regional Solutions Engineers to qualify, scope, and lead complex Dell Technologies opportunities while preserving regional ownership and customer continuity.
  • Lead discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business, operational, application, security, and infrastructure requirements into clear architecture decisions, assumptions, dependencies, and next steps.
  • Analyze assessment data, workload requirements, configuration information, and technical telemetry to support evidence-based sizing and architecture decisions.
  • Design and defend Dell-based solutions across compute and AI, storage, private cloud and hyperconverged infrastructure, data protection and cyber resilience, and data center networking.
  • Create architectures using relevant Dell Technologies platforms, including PowerEdge, PowerStore, PowerScale, PowerSwitch, Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, and supporting AIOps capabilities.
  • Lead customer whiteboards, technical workshops, architecture reviews, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and validation activities for complex or transformational pursuits.
  • Explain architectural trade-offs and competitive alternatives with credibility, using SHI’s cross-OEM perspective while maintaining a clear, evidence-based recommendation.
  • Integrate Dell infrastructure with the customer’s broader environment, including VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, Microsoft and public-cloud services, data protection ecosystems, networking fabrics, automation, and SHI professional services.
  • Collaborate with Dell field, specialist, engineering, and roadmap resources to validate designs, resolve technical risks, and align the right resources to strategic pursuits.
  • Develop complete technical deliverables such as discovery guides, reference architectures, sizing checklists, bills of material inputs, migration considerations, battlecards, workshop decks, and decision or risk logs.
  • Produce reusable technical IP from customer engagements and contribute it to the team repository so successful approaches can be repeated across regions.
  • Enable SHI sales and technical teams through field coaching, opportunity support, technical briefings, solution playbooks, and customer-ready content.
  • Maintain opportunity awareness by identifying attach opportunities, services alignment, lifecycle and modernization triggers, competitive displacement potential, and agreed technical next steps.
  • Manage multiple concurrent pursuits with disciplined documentation, follow-up, stakeholder communication, and escalation.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Adaptability: Can proactively adapt to challenging situations, anticipate changes, and make modifications to meet the demands of changing circumstances.
  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others.
  • Documentation: Independently produces and maintains documentation for routine processes; ensures accuracy and consistency.
  • Leadership: Can proactively seek out leadership roles, initiate team projects, and contribute to team development and success.
  • Problem Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions.
  • Teamwork: Can lead a team effectively, facilitate cooperation, sharing information, and ensuring that all team members are able to contribute to their full potential.
  • Self – Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas.


Skill Level Requirements


  • Advanced experience leading complex data center architecture and pre-sales technical engagements.
  • Advanced knowledge in at least one Dell Technologies domain, with working knowledge across multiple adjacent areas including Compute + AI, Storage, Private Cloud + HCI, Data Protection, and Networking.
  • Expertise in architecting, sizing, integrating, and positioning Dell Technologies infrastructure within complex, multi-vendor customer environments.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery and translate business and application requirements into architecture, configuration guidance, migration considerations, and validation plans.
  • Strong experience with PowerEdge and accelerator-based infrastructure supporting virtualization, private cloud, modern applications, and AI workloads.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise storage concepts and Dell platforms such as PowerStore and PowerScale, including performance, availability, data services, connectivity, and operational considerations.
  • Strong understanding of private cloud and HCI technologies, including Dell Private Cloud, Dell Automation Platform, VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, and relevant Microsoft technologies.
  • Experience with data protection and cyber-resilience architectures, including PowerProtect, Cyber Recovery, CyberSense, backup and recovery, immutability, recovery validation, and business continuity.
  • Working knowledge of data center networking, including Ethernet fabrics, PowerSwitch, SONiC, storage connectivity, and infrastructure integration dependencies.
  • Ability to confidently present, articulate, and defend proposed solutions during customer-facing architecture reviews, technical discussions, and executive-level presentations.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical, operational, and business value while supporting the sales process and maintaining architectural integrity.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, technical communication, and customer-facing skills.

Other Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required.
  • Five or more years of experience in solutions architecture, systems engineering, technical pre-sales, infrastructure consulting, or a comparable customer-facing role preferred.
  • Demonstrated customer-facing experience with complex infrastructure discovery, design, presentation, and technical decision support.
  • Ability to travel to SHI, Dell Technologies, partner, and customer meetings and events as business needs require.
  • Current Dell Technologies training or certification in one or more relevant domains preferred; advanced architecture, VMware, Nutanix, Microsoft, networking, security, or data protection credentials are also valued.


The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

raw.description:
Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Minimum 7 years of professional experience developing full‑stack web applications using modern frameworks such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS
  • Familiarity with DevOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Azure DevOps)
  • Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) for deployment and scaling
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL querying, and API design (REST/GraphQL)
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with non‑technical staff, gathering requirements and translating them into user‑centric software solutions

Standard Job Description

When it comes to using cutting-edge machine learning to tackle complex problems, Lockheed Martin is driven by a singular mission focus and desire to continuously innovate. Today’s challenges to global security aren’t just changing – they’re accelerating faster than ever before. Through our dedication to our mission, our AI-enabled systems are changing the way militaries operate and protect their forces, the way first responders fight fires, and how researchers explore the far reaches of space and the ocean’s depths.

The Lockheed Martin Artificial Intelligence Center (LAIC) team is seeking a high energy engineer with hands-on experience in developing AI/ML software in support of the AI Consulting team. In this role you will be part of the larger AI Foundations organization consisting of colleagues possessing varying skill sets including AI/Machine Learning specialists, front-end and back-end developers, data engineers, product managers, and other data scientists. The selected candidate will focus on the AI Consulting team, but will be included as part of a broader range of projects across the LAIC portfolio. The AI Consulting team is focused on employing small, innovative, and agile teams to rapidly iterate and mature solutions from prototypes to deployment for utilization across the Lockheed Martin enterprise.
The LAIC AI Consulting Team’s mission includes serving as a center of excellence for AI at Lockheed Martin. The candidate will work to disseminate best practices of the AI Consulting team to other AI and data science teams in the corporation. The candidate will be required to create knowledge materials to publish these best practices, as well as meet with other data science leaders in Lockheed Martin to teach and discuss these practices.

The Full Stack Software Engineer Stf designs, develops, deploys, and supports secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions across the full application lifecycle. The role is responsible for frontend and backend development, API and database design, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security controls, and production application stability.

This position will build and operate AI/ML-enabled web applications, integrating services such as model-serving APIs, LLM providers, vector-search tools, and internal machine-learning platforms. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into user-focused technical solutions; developing responsive interfaces and backend services; and ensuring applications are maintainable, performant, and secure.

The engineer will provide technical leadership in Agile delivery, infrastructure automation, deployment processes, monitoring, incident response, and reliability improvements. The role partners with product, data science, security, infrastructure, operations, and business stakeholders while mentoring engineers and establishing sound engineering standards.

Desired Skills

  • Experience delivering and operating AI/ML-powered web applications, including integrations with model-serving APIs, LLM providers, embedding or vector-search systems, and internal machine-learning platforms.
  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation workflows, AI observability, performance monitoring, and safe rollout of AI capabilities.
  • Advanced experience owning production CI/CD and release processes across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and containerized services, including automated testing, security scanning, artifact management, deployment controls, and rollback strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code and cloud environment management using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Helm, or similar technologies.
  • Experience improving the reliability, scalability, and availability of cloud-native applications through Kubernetes operations, autoscaling, networking, secrets management, load balancing, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning.
  • Strong knowledge of application, cloud, and AI security practices, including secure coding, OWASP guidance, IAM, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, dependency security, and protections for AI-specific risks such as prompt injection and sensitive-data exposure.
  • Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architectures, including message queues, background jobs, streaming workflows, serverless services, or similar patterns.
  • Proven technical leadership, including establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and proactively managing production risks related to quality, performance, usability, reliability, and security.
  • Experience partnering with product, data science, security, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver practical AI-enabled solutions.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $150800.00 - $280000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $135700.00 - $251900.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $120600.00 - $224000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $108600.00 - $201600.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

raw.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to guide a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.

We're seeking a results-driven and strategic Director, Sales Engineering to lead our US SLED Sales Engineering organization reporting to the Vice President, Solutions Consulting - Strategics.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Recruiting, mentoring, and building a world-class team of sales engineering managers, architects, and individual contributors
  • Collaborating with sales leadership and clients to develop and execute winning segment and account-level strategies. You will own the technical sales motion from start to finish
  • Refining and scaling the core sales engineering processes, ensuring consistency and efficiency
  • Acting as a key technical leader and executive sponsor for strategic customers and partners, representing the company at industry events, forums, and executive briefings
  • Driving the technical strategy that positions our solutions as essential to the customer's long-term business objectives

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Technology or a related field or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years of experience in technical, customer-facing roles with at least 5 years of experience leading teams, including multiple lines of management
  • Must be proficient in selling network security technologies including but not limited to: SSL and web related technologies, proxies, caches, firewalls, SSL/IPsec, VPN’s, DLP, anti-virus, spam, spyware solutions, and end user monitoring
  • This role requires travel to support teams and engage with customers up to 40%
  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Industry certifications including CCNP, JNCIP, PCNSA , CISSP, or CCSP
  • A hands-on leadership approach, with the proven ability to engage directly with strategic accounts to secure technical wins
  • A deep understanding of complex, multi-year sales cycles and expertise in value-based storytelling
  • Demonstrate strong AI fluency by leveraging coding assistants, LLMs, and Generative AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, solution design, automation, and customer problem-solving, while applying sound technical judgment to validate outputs.

raw.excerpt: Client Partner (East Coast, US)Lateral stands for technology excellence.
raw.description:
Client Partner (East Coast, US)

Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We do things differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage. Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning. We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.


We Take Ownership

Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a Client Partner at Lateral, you’ll be the trusted business partner to our clients, shaping how they think about technology as a driver of measurable value. You’ll own key client relationships end to end: from identifying opportunities and shaping deals, to ensuring delivery meets (and exceeds) commercial outcomes.

This is a role for someone who blends commercial acumen, consultative selling, and delivery awareness. You’ll know how to open doors, nurture relationships, and connect Lateral’s capabilities to client business priorities.

You will:

  • Build, grow, and own a portfolio of client relationships, driving long-term revenue and partnership value.

  • Identify and convert new opportunities within existing and new accounts. You’ll know how to move from a first conversation to a signed engagement with clarity and confidence.

  • Partner with Delivery and Technical Leads to ensure projects align with client goals and deliver tangible business results.

  • Be the voice of the client inside Lateral translating their commercial objectives into clear internal focus.

  • Develop and execute account strategies: mapping stakeholders, anticipating needs, and expanding our footprint through trust and results.

  • Represent Lateral externally - you’ll already have a network you can activate on day one.

  • Stay close to delivery without being in it: you’ll track satisfaction, renewals, and the health of the partnership, ensuring we keep raising the bar.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a self-starting, commercially driven operator who thrives at the intersection of business development and delivery excellence.

You must bring:

  • Proven commercial results. You’ve personally led complex deals from 0% to 100% and can walk us through how you built the relationship, structured the opportunity, and closed it.

  • An active network. You have a Rolodex of people you’d call on day one - contacts who trust your judgment and would take your call because you’ve delivered value before.

  • Agency mindset. You move fast, think commercially, and build momentum without needing playbooks. You can create opportunity where none existed.

  • Client leadership. You’ve been the face of delivery and the commercial voice for clients, ensuring their business objectives stay at the heart of everything we build.

  • Strategic curiosity. You’re energized by understanding how businesses make money, where technology creates leverage, and how to shape deals that align both.

  • Reputation for excellence. If we called five people you’ve worked with, they’d describe you as proactive, trustworthy, sharp, and relentless in driving results.

  • Comfort in ambiguity. You can build clarity where there’s none and know when to push, when to listen, and when to close.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will bring proven experience with both AWS and Azure, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, automation tools, GitOps methodologies, and release engineering best practices.

You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and automated deployment workflows — working closely with developers, QA, and operations teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-quality software releases.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across software, infrastructure, and network layers.

Preferred

Education

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Role summary:
The Senior Manager, Insights Consulting, Global Fees & Incentives is a highly analytical business strategy role responsible for shaping how Walmart Marketplace prices its seller services and invests in seller incentives globally. This role combines deep analytical expertise with strong business judgment to identify growth opportunities, optimize Marketplace economics, and influence strategic decisions across one of Walmart's fastest-growing businesses. You will work hands-on with large datasets, financial models, and advanced analytics to uncover insights, evaluate investment opportunities, and recommend changes to Marketplace fees and incentive programs at a global scale.
About the team:
The Seller Fees & Incentives team drives profitable Marketplace growth by designing competitive fee structures and scalable incentive programs that create value for both sellers and Walmart. We use rigorous, data-driven analysis to optimize investment decisions, maximize ROI, and influence seller behavior through attracting high-value sellers, expanding strategic assortment, improving the customer value proposition, and accelerating adoption of new Marketplace capabilities. Our team partners closely with seller-facing teams, Product, Data Science, Finance, and internal business partners to shape high-impact Marketplace strategy.
What you'll do:
  • Own complex analytics shaping seller fees and incentive investments across Walmart's global Marketplace.
  • Analyze large datasets using SQL to identify trends, uncover insights, and solve high-priority business problems.
  • Build financial models and business cases for Marketplace fee changes and high-value incentive programs.
  • Design experiments and measurement frameworks to quantify business impact, optimize ROI and investment decisions.
  • Partner with Data Science to develop and validate measurement and recommendation models.
  • Translate complex analyses into executive-ready recommendations.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to build scalable global fees and incentive capabilities.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution.
  • Coach associates on analytical thinking and structured problem solving.

What you'll bring:
  • Exceptional analytical skills with demonstrated experience using SQL and large datasets to solve complex business problems.
  • Strong business intuition with the ability to connect analytical findings to global Marketplace strategy and financial outcomes.
  • Experience building financial models, evaluating investment opportunities, and measuring ROI.
  • Ability to independently identify opportunities, frame ambiguous problems, and drive analyses with limited direction.
  • Experience partnering with Data Science to develop, validate, and operationalize predictive or optimization models.
  • Ability to synthesize complex analyses into compelling executive-level recommendations.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with experience influencing cross-functional leaders.
  • A natural curiosity to explore data, challenge assumptions, proactively identify opportunities, and independently drive business improvements.

raw.description:
About Matter Health

Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in public housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. We are rapidly expanding and are seeking mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, people-centered environments.

We Lead with Love in Everything We Do.

About the Role

Matter Health is seeking a hands-on, mission-driven AI Automation Workflow Specialist to join our Information Technology team. This individual contributor role is responsible for building and deploying AI-assisted workflow automations that support our operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams, helping them spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the patients and work that matter most.

Working directly with business and clinical stakeholders, you will identify day-to-day workflow opportunities, configure and deploy automations using Matter Health's established AI tools and platform, and support adoption across the organization. This is a building and operational role, not a platform architecture or people management position.

This role is ideal for someone who learns new AI tools quickly, enjoys partnering with non-technical teams to solve real problems, and is excited about applying emerging AI capabilities in service of a genuine mission. This position reports to the Chief Technology Officer. This is a fully remote role with up to 10% travel for occasional in-person meetings or team offsites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with clinical, care support, operations, and field-based teams to understand day-to-day workflows, pain points, and opportunities for AI-driven automation
  • Gather requirements from stakeholders with varying levels of technical fluency and translate real operational problems into automation ideas that can be built and tested quickly
  • Collect structured and informal feedback from clinicians, care support agents, operations staff, and field-based teams to guide ongoing iteration of deployed automations
  • Submit identified opportunities into the team's intake process and collaborate with the AI Platform Engineer and requesting-team leadership to define priorities
  • Use approved AI tools, agent platforms, and automation software to configure, build, and deploy workflow automations and AI-assisted processes for operations, clinical, care support, and field-based teams
  • Write and refine prompts and configure workflow logic within existing platform tooling, templates, and standards to automate repetitive day-to-day tasks
  • Test and refine deployed automations with real users, iterating based on usage feedback and observed performance
  • Monitor day-to-day performance of deployed automations and escalate issues related to accuracy, reliability, or unexpected behavior to the AI Platform Engineer or Engineering team
  • Follow established platform standards, prompt and context templates, and controls when building and deploying automations, including those handling protected health information (PHI)
  • Create documentation, training materials, and enablement content to support successful adoption of new AI-driven workflows
  • Maintain a library of deployed automations, prompts, and workflow configurations to support consistency, reuse, and knowledge sharing across the organization
  • Support change management and adoption efforts as new automations are rolled out across operational teams
  • Partner with the AI Platform Engineer and stakeholders to evaluate when a deployed automation is ready to expand, refine, or retire

Qualifications

Required

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, workflow automation, or a related operational role
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, chatbots, or no-code/low-code automation platforms to build or configure workflows

Mortenson is currently seeking a Senior Commissioning Engineer II that will perform aspects of commissioning assignments which require knowledge and application of basic engineering principles in a construction environment with a focus on successful commissioning. Using prescribed methods, performs specific and portions of commissioning assignments to completion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

raw.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Job Overview:

You’ll be joining our Mitratech Workforce Compliance Engineering team, building AI-first SaaS products. This role sits at the intersection of two disciplines. First, you’ll build the AI features our customers use every day: LLM-powered workflows, retrieval over compliance content, and agents that take action inside our products. Second, you’ll help lead how we build software, using agentic, pipeline-driven development in which AI coding agents plan, write, test, and review code under strong engineering oversight.

We hold both to the same bar: high quality (low escaped defects), well tested (Cypress automation framework with focus on unit test coverage), secure (scanned and verified), scalable (AWS, but hardware isn’t the answer), and measurably accurate when AI is involved. This is a great opportunity to join a growing company, be part of an excellent team, architect solutions to complex problems, and deliver valuable features where clean code, and trustworthy AI, matter.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Agentic, Pipeline-Driven Development

  • System Design & Task Decomposition: Break down high-level product goals into well-defined, modular engineering tasks with clear specifications and acceptance criteria that can be executed by both engineers and AI coding agents.
  • Agentic Development Pipelines: Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines that incorporate AI agents for code generation, automated testing, and intelligent code review, with guardrails, quality gates, and clear human approval points.
  • Specification & Context Engineering: Design and test structured instructions, prompts, specifications, and repository context (e.g., agent instruction files, reusable skills, MCP tools) that drive accurate, context-aligned output from AI agents, and measure and improve agent output over time.
  • Code Review & Validation: Conduct in-depth reviews of both human and AI-generated code, ensuring quality, security, scalability, and alignment with domain requirements.
  • Architectural Oversight: Ensure design plans created by both human engineers and AI tools adhere to architectural best practices with a focus on modularity, bounded contexts, etc.
  • Documentation and Domain Clarity: Contribute to the development of domain models, technical documentation, and internal knowledge bases that support AI agent performance and team activity.

Engineering Excellence & Teamwork

  • Write secure code. Avoid introducing an OWASP vulnerability, including those in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Know how APIs are secured, sessions are handled, and data is validated properly.
  • Serve in an on-call rotation (DevOps philosophy where you will participate in ops) and respond promptly to any production issues, including AI feature degradations, to remediate rapidly.
  • Be a teammate, help other teammates resolve complex problems or think through design/architecture challenges. Be available and responsive.
  • Mentor others and foster an excellent engineering culture based in trust, accountability, character, and honesty, including coaching teammates on using AI agents effectively and responsibly.
  • Seek feedback and deliver constructive criticism (e.g., code reviews) in a tactful and empathetic manner; build others up and mentor without ego.

Your Qualifications:

Required

  • Possess a bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience. Emphasis in engineering, data science, computer science or information systems is preferred.
  • Have a minimum of 5 years of software engineering experience developing SaaS applications, with strong hands-on experience in our stack: Python, React, AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB).
  • Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns: prompt design, embeddings and vector search/RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and agent orchestration.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering software with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Devin, or Codex as a core part of your workflow, including integrating agents into CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates.
  • Experience designing evaluation and testing strategies for non-deterministic systems, and the judgment to decide when AI is, and is not, the right solution.
  • Strong fundamentals in system design, API security, automated testing, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Clear, precise written communication: specs and documentation that both people and AI agents can act on.

Preferred

  • Experience with managed model platforms and provider APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) and agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Have shipped at least one AI/LLM-powered feature to production in a SaaS product and supported it after launch (monitoring, evaluation, and iteration based on real usage).
  • Experience building MCP servers or other tool integrations for AI agents.
  • Background in regulated domains (HR, legal, risk, or compliance) and with data privacy and security standards (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA).
  • Familiarity with AI risk and governance practices (e.g., NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Experience with spec-driven development.

Our Technology Stack:

  • Python, React
  • AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway)
  • Containerized environments with CICD pipelines, RESTful APIs, etc.
  • LLM, RAG, and MCP components powering in-product AI features
  • AI coding agents integrated into the development lifecycle with automated quality gates

Benefits we offer:

  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance *
  • 401 (k) + Employer Match *
  • Open PTO + 11 Paid Holidays + 4 Annual Paid Global Wellness Days Off
  • STD, LTD & Group Life Insurance
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Pet Insurance
  • FSA & HSA Options
  • Employee Assistance Program

Perks we offer:

  • Remote Work
  • Career Advancement & Professional Development Opportunities
  • Employee Recognition
  • LinkedIn Learning Platform

raw.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
  • Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
  • Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
  • You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Recruiter Screening Conversation
  • Initial HM Interview
  • Role Specific Interview
  • Behavioural Interview

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Principal Executive Recruiter at GitLab, you’ll lead VP-level and other senior leadership searches across Sales, People, Legal, Finance, and other corporate teams. You’ll partner directly with senior executives to identify, engage, assess, and hire leaders, bringing market intelligence and a research-driven approach to complex, often confidential searches. Alongside owning searches end to end, you’ll help shape the strategies, frameworks, and practices that strengthen executive recruiting at GitLab, balancing search rigor with the agility of a fast-moving technology organization.

What you’ll do

  • Lead VP-level and other senior leadership searches end to end, from search strategy and market mapping through assessment, selection, and closing.
  • Advise C-suite executives and senior business leaders on hiring decisions, challenge assumptions, and navigate complex stakeholder dynamics.
  • Develop talent strategies using market mapping, competitive intelligence, creative sourcing, and recruiting data to guide each search.
  • Build relationships with passive executive talent, understand their motivations, and connect opportunities to GitLab’s mission and business priorities.
  • Partner with hiring leaders to define success profiles, assess executive capabilities and business impact, and guide evidence-based hiring decisions.
  • Own executive candidate relationships and deliver a high-touch experience through compensation discussions, competing opportunities, and negotiations.
  • Manage multiple confidential, business-critical searches with discretion, balancing urgency, quality, stakeholder alignment, and candidate experience.
  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition leadership and executive recruiting peers to improve search frameworks, assessment practices, reporting, and tools.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience independently leading VP-level and senior executive searches through successful hires in an executive search firm, an in-house executive recruiting function, or both.
  • Executive recruiting experience across functions such as Sales, People, Legal, Finance, or other corporate teams, with the business acumen and curiosity to learn new domains.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, influence senior stakeholders, and provide candid, evidence-based guidance on hiring decisions.
  • Skills in talent research, market mapping, creative sourcing, leadership assessment, and engaging and closing passive executive talent.
  • Business judgment, communication, and negotiation skills to navigate sensitive searches, complex compensation discussions, and competing executive priorities.
  • Experience developing or improving executive search methodologies, frameworks, and processes while maintaining speed and flexibility.
  • A hands-on approach to managing multiple high-priority searches independently and working through ambiguity.
  • Experience in high-growth technology or enterprise software organizations, global executive searches, and distributed organizations is helpful.

About the team

You’ll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Guided by GitLab’s operating principles, including Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, we take ownership, move with urgency and rigor, and focus on hiring outcomes that matter to our internal customers. We share learnings and create reusable resources to continually improve the quality and consistency of hiring across Business teams.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$184,800—$314,400 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. This is a remote position open to candidates across the United States, with a hybrid option available for those near an AECOM office.

The Senior-Level Information & Communication Technologies (ICT) Consultant will have or develop a solid understanding of Data Center client business practices and goals to:

  • Oversee a team of ICT consultants, designers and BIM specialists to produce quality constructable data center design documents on schedule.
  • Under general direction, be responsible for the creation of work plans and task definitions
  • Develop and formulate solutions to Data Center client problems on assigned projects
  • Have broad technical knowledge but possesses an area of specialization or focus

  • Work on detailed and/or routine design and/or consulting assignments.

AECOM’s Buildings + Places practice includes architecture, interiors, building engineering, workplace strategy, business transformation, asset advisory, economics and development planning, master planning, urban planning, and landscape architecture. Qualifications

  • Data Center design experience with ICT infrastructure
  • Current BICSI Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD) Certification

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Sponsorship is not available for this position

🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Senior Financial Control Analyst

📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits

⭐ Our Financial Control Team:

Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges!

Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.

We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.

Your day-to-day:

  • Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.
  • Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.
  • Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.
  • Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.
  • Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.
  • Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.
  • Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.
  • Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.
  • Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.
  • Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment
  • You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards
  • You have a great eye for detail
  • You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls
  • You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors
  • You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds
  • You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)
  • You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process
  • You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment
  • What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!

💰£56,000 - £75,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

  • Recruiter Screening Conversation
  • Initial HM Interview
  • Role Specific Interview
  • Behavioural Interview

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. As a Principal Executive Recruiter at GitLab, you’ll lead VP-level and other senior leadership searches across Sales, People, Legal, Finance, and other corporate teams.   • Partner with hiring leaders to define success profiles, assess executive capabilities and business impact, and guide evidence-based hiring decisions.
  • Own executive candidate relationships and deliver a high-touch experience through compensation discussions, competing opportunities, and negotiations.
  • Manage multiple confidential, business-critical searches with discretion, balancing urgency, quality, stakeholder alignment, and candidate experience.
  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition leadership and executive recruiting peers to improve search frameworks, assessment practices, reporting, and tools.

  • Experience independently leading VP-level and senior executive searches through successful hires in an executive search firm, an in-house executive recruiting function, or both.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, influence senior stakeholders, and provide candid, evidence-based guidance on hiring decisions.
  • Skills in talent research, market mapping, creative sourcing, leadership assessment, and engaging and closing passive executive talent.
  • Business judgment, communication, and negotiation skills to navigate sensitive searches, complex compensation discussions, and competing executive priorities.
  • Experience developing or improving executive search methodologies, frameworks, and processes while maintaining speed and flexibility.

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

BJAK builds technology products used across Southeast Asia. Doit App Sdn. Bhd. is the group’s digital wallet business in Malaysia, preparing to apply to Bank Negara Malaysia for approval to issue electronic money.

The Head of Risk & Compliance owns risk and compliance for Doit App end to end, from the licence application through to running the control function once the approval is granted. The first year is the application itself, so this is a build role rather than a maintenance one.

The role covers compliance, risk management, AML/CFT/CPF as the designated Compliance Officer at management level, and data protection as Doit App’s data protection officer.

You will report to the Board of Doit App Sdn. Bhd., with administrative reporting lines to Doit App’s Chief Executive and to BJAK’s Head of Risk & Compliance.

What You'll Own

  • Owning the risk and compliance content of the application to Bank Negara Malaysia, and the engagement with the Bank from pre-application through to approval.

  • Building and running the compliance framework, which is the monitoring plan, the registers, and the breach and corrective action process.

  • Building the risk management framework, the risk appetite statement and the risk register, and reporting material risks to the Board.

  • Safeguarding of customer funds, including keeping the electronic money float separate from the company’s own money and operating the trust account.

  • The anti-money laundering programme as a reporting institution, covering risk assessment, customer due diligence, screening, suspicious transaction reporting, record keeping and training.

  • Oversight of the white label partner and other outsourcing arrangements, making sure what each party is responsible for is written down and evidenced rather than assumed.

  • Owning conflicts of interest, anti-bribery and corruption, whistleblowing, complaints, and personal data protection.

  • Owning regulatory reporting and notifications to the Bank within their deadlines, and the compliance and risk reporting that goes to the Board.

  • Reviewing onboarding flows, product additions, disclosures and marketing before they ship, and running compliance training across the team.

What We're Looking For

  • A degree or professional qualification from an institution recognised by the government of Malaysia.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in financial services, including 3 in a compliance, regulatory or risk role at an institution regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia.

  • Experience across both risk management and compliance. This is a combined function and not a specialist seat.

  • Command of the Financial Services Act 2013, BNM’s policy document on Electronic Money, and BNM’s AML/CFT/CPF requirements and AMLA 2001.

  • Familiarity with BNM’s requirements on technology risk, outsourcing, electronic know your customer, complaints handling and fair treatment of financial consumers.

  • Experience dealing directly with Bank Negara on submissions, supervisory queries and compliance reviews.

  • Able to meet the relevant fit and proper criteria.

Nice to have

  • Experience taking an electronic money or money services business application through Bank Negara Malaysia to approval.

  • CAMS, the ICA Diploma in Governance, Risk and Compliance, or an equivalent risk or compliance qualification.

  • Experience in payments, electronic money, digital banking or fintech, including white label or multi-partner models.

  • Familiarity with Shariah compliant electronic money and the Islamic Financial Services Act 2013.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Introductory conversation

2. Regulatory and compliance deep dive

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
