Saluda Medical is a commercial‑stage medical device company focused on developing treatments for chronic neurological conditions using its novel closed‑loop neuromodulation platform. The company’s proprietary technology senses and measures neural responses to stimulation and automatically adjusts therapy based on real‑time neurophysiological feedback.

Saluda Medical’s first product, the Evoke® System, is designed to deliver known, consistent, and personalized spinal cord stimulation therapy by objectively measuring neural responses and maintaining therapy within a prescribed therapeutic window. Saluda Medical is headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

At Saluda, we challenge boundaries. We innovate and think beyond the conventional. Our focus is to revolutionize the standard of care in neuromodulation to positively impact patient’s lives.

In this exciting role as a Manager, Clinical Affairs, you will be at the center of Saluda’s clinical study program. Your insights will contribute to formulating the clinical research and evidence generation strategy, and you will be responsible for the planning, implementation, managing, and reporting of the applicable clinical studies and associated regulatory activities in accordance with that strategy. To achieve this you will collaborate with a cross-functional team, including Research and Development, Marketing, Clinical Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Operations, enabling global market access and adoption of a new class III implantable electrical stimulation therapy worldwide. While driving program execution to meet customer needs and financial goals of the business, you will create and uphold a high-performance culture centered on customer focus, creative and determined problem solving, transparency and partnership.

What You’ll Do:

  • Development, maintenance, and optimization of the clinical quality system, clinical regulatory requirements, and data integrity/quality
  • Establish detailed program plans, drive program execution toward established objectives, assess risk and implement strategies to ensure successful delivery of the clinical objectives
  • Direct and collaborate with internal and external staff, and liaise with partner sites and physicians, to ensure successful conduct of assigned clinical programs consistent with company objectives and applicable regulations and policies
  • Development of protocols, statistical analysis plans, reports and other clinical study documentation
  • Contribute to the overall strategic direction for development and implementation of clinical affairs objectives and processes
  • Support and contribute to manuscripts, abstracts, data presentations, and health economic value initiatives
  • Promote and embody culture and behavior expectations of a high-performance culture
  • Drives leadership of issue identification and resolution

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years direct clinical and regulatory experience in medical devices including some experience with Active Implantable Medical Devices.· Demonstrated success in designing and conducting clinical trials in support of medical device and/or pharmaceuticals· Experience with neurostimulation industry preferred
  • Experience working with FDA and/or other regulatory and governmental agencies desire
  • Experience in synthesizing complex clinical data into understandable written format
  • A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in science/biomedical/health related field; Masters or PhD preferred
  • Ability to work effectively across time zones and cultures
  • Ability to travel domestically (10% of time) and internationally

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication· Knowledge of ICH/GCP and FDA medical device regulations· Knowledge of research design, data analysis and biostatistics· Self-assured, knowledgeable professional capable of developing good interpersonal relationships with medical professionals· High degree of personal integrity
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Self-motivated and independent work style with the ability to initiate and follow through on assignments
  • Knowledge of electronic data capture systems and web-based clinical trial management tools
  • Ability to think creatively, dynamically, and foster a culture of commitment to thoughtful science to help patients in need

Our Core Values:

  • People – Our first responsibility is to the patients we serve.
  • Integrity – Do the right thing
  • Pioneering – Lead Boldly, Change Lives, Disrupt the Status-Quo
  • Performance – Win together – Deliver with Excellence.

Saluda Medical embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team representative of a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. We believe people are the source of our inspiration and innovation.

Saluda Medical does not accept non-solicited resumes or candidate submittals from search/recruiting agencies not already on Saluda Medical’s approved agency list. Unsolicited resumes or candidate information submitted to Saluda Medical by search/recruiting agencies not already on Saluda Medical’s approved agency list shall become the property of Saluda Medical.

raw.description:
Welcome to Nutrium

Before you apply, here's the key thing: our mission is to promote global well-being by making quality 1:1 nutrition accessible to everyone.

A lot has changed since we started, but our mission is still at the heart of everything we do — it's written in our culture book, in our proposals, in our docs, and it guides every decision we make.

It's also what allowed us, for years, to improve the experience of nutrition professionals and their patients through the world's #1 nutrition counseling platform. But we didn't stop there.

Today, with Nutrium Care, we're taking the next step: bringing real, personalized nutrition to people anytime, anywhere, and helping them build healthier, happier lives.

Along the way, we raised our Series A and surpassed €15M in funding, partnered with global leaders like Vodafone, Adidas, Wellhub, and Linde, and reached millions of people around the world.

From day one, we also knew something else: building this future would take more than great tech. It would take a place where talented people can grow, feel supported, and actually enjoy the journey along the way.

You go first

We're proud of our journey so far, and we believe there's space for more people to shine, challenge us, and help shape what comes next.

⭐ What you will bring

You bring the experience and ownership needed to build impactful features end to end, contributing directly to a product that improves the daily work of dietitians and supports thousands of people on their health journeys. You care about quality, scalability, and real user impact, and you enjoy collaborating in a fast-paced team to turn ideas into meaningful solutions.

⭐ What you will be doing

  • Contribute to the development of new features and the improvement of the existing ones in our web platform;

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to successfully deliver high-quality and on-time product features;

  • Participate in code reviews, ensuring code quality and consistency across the team;

  • Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure a smooth application experience;

  • Mentor and guide other team members to help them grow;

  • Stay updated on Web development tools, evaluating their impact on the project.

⭐ You might be a great fit if you...

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience;

  • Bring solid experience as a Full-Stack Developer, with experience on backend development, ideally in fast-paced tech environments;

  • Are proficient in web development frameworks (experience with Ruby on Rails is a plus);

  • Are familiar with modern frontend frameworks (experience with React is a plus);

  • Are confident in building, deploying, monitoring, and maintaining server applications in dynamic, iterative environments;

  • Have experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs;

  • Are comfortable working with SQL databases (PostgreSQL is a plus);

  • Are proficient with Git for version control and collaboration;

  • Thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy working with cross-functional teams;

  • Bonus:Have experience with or curiosity about Elasticsearch and Redis;

  • Are proficient in Portuguese and English;

  • Have an "AI-native" mindset and are excited to bring intelligent tools into your everyday work;

  • Bonus: Are based in the north of Portugal (Braga/Porto).

Now, it's our turn

Transparency is one of our core values, so here's exactly what you can expect from Nutrium:

  • Gross annual salary: 33.600€ - 53.200€, depending on your experience.

  • Perks and benefits:

    • A flexible work model and hours

    • 27 days of annual leave

    • Unlimited nutritional appointments (via Nutrium Care)

    • Unlimited psychology sessions

    • Health insurance

    • Meal allowance: 10,46€ per working day

    • Professional development budget

    • Snacks and good coffee in the offices

    • A multicultural team that enjoys spending time together, not just while working, but also through team activities, social events, and our annual offsite.

🚀 How we'll get to know each other

A quick overview of what our hiring journey looks like:

  1. CV Screening

  2. First interview with the recruiter

  3. Technical interview with the hiring manager

  4. A take-home challenge sent by email

  5. Final Interview (with challenge discussion)

We're committed to making our hiring process fair, inclusive, and human.

We aim to build a team that reflects the diversity of the world we live in. That means welcoming people of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, ages, abilities, religions, and backgrounds.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be exactly who we're looking for.

A note on our hiring process

We want our interviewers focused on you. To help with that, interviews may be recorded via Teamtailor Meet, with the support of AI note-taking tools.

If you'd prefer not to be recorded, just let us know before the interview begins. This won't change anything about how we assess you.

raw.excerpt: About Club Capital and the youth sports businessClub Capital is an accounting, tax, and CFO advisory firm that serves insurance agencies and youth sports clubs.
raw.description:
About Club Capital and the youth sports business

Club Capital is an accounting, tax, and CFO advisory firm that serves insurance agencies and youth sports clubs. We work with roughly 1,000 clients firmwide, about 50 of them youth sports clubs, and each one is matched with a credentialed accountant or controller who knows their business. This role sits on the youth sports side.

Our youth sports clients are organizations run as businesses, and we support the business side of each one: accounting, tax, and compliance. Most are 501(c)(3) nonprofits managed by a volunteer board of directors, most of whom are parents of current players. A smaller share are for-profit entities owned by a founder or head coach. They collect registration, tournament, and sponsorship revenue and pay coaches as employees or contractors, which creates exempt-organization filings, payroll tax and 1099 reporting, and sales and use tax obligations in the states where they operate.

About the role

You own all tax for the non-profit side of our youth sports practice. Every tax client is also a controller and/or CFO services client of ours. We do not handle tax filings for any entity or individual whose business or club is not with us for accounting or advisory work. Your work starts with tax onboarding: working out which returns have been filed, whether the client is current, which accounting method they say they use and whether it matches the books, what resolution items are open, and what questions they have. From there, you manage the recurring tax work that keeps each client current. You also handle returns for our for-profit clubs and individual 1040s, mostly for club owners and executive directors.

What we hold this role to:

  • Every new client onboarded with filing history confirmed, accounting method matched to the books, and open resolution items identified.
  • Every 990 filed or extended on time, and every 1099 filed by its deadline.
  • Federal, state, and payroll notices answered well before their response deadlines.
  • Clients who know where they stand on sales tax and payroll tax.

What you'll do

  • Own the process. Create, refine, and hold to the process around the recurring tax work. If the process fails, you have failed. Our youth sports accountants and controllers keep the books, so you partner with them at every step and present a unified front to the client, in plain English.
  • Manage the 990 cycle. Manage the preparation of Forms 990, 990-EZ, and 990-N, plus Form 990-T where unrelated business income applies, and review and sign the returns. Handle state charitable registrations and annual filings, and file the extensions for every return that needs one. Get the governance, compensation, and program service answers right, because the public reads them.
  • Own the annual 1099 process. Set the timeline, coordinate with the accounting team and the client, prepare all forms, and meet every deadline.
  • Own sales and use tax and franchise tax. Work out what is taxable for each club by state, manage registrations and exemption certificates, prepare and file sales and use tax returns and state franchise tax filings, and answer state inquiries.
  • Own tax resolution. Resolve federal, state, and payroll notices: triage what comes in, research it, respond, and request penalty relief where it is warranted. Handle payment plans, delinquent filings, and representation before the IRS and state agencies as part of that work. Keep powers of attorney current so clients never have to deal with the IRS or a state agency alone.
  • Own payroll tax items. Review 941, 940, state withholding, and unemployment filings, reconcile W-2 reporting, and settle coach classification questions before they become notices.
  • Prepare for-profit and individual returns. Prepare business returns for our for-profit clubs and 1040s for club owners and executive directors.
  • Provide tax planning and advisory. Meet with clients to discuss their tax strategy, explain what a number on a 990 means and how to protect exempt status, and work with the accounting team so the books stay in alignment with that strategy.

What we're looking for

Required

  • An active CPA or EA license in good standing
  • Experience managing and reviewing Forms 990 for tax-exempt organizations
  • Experience with tax resolution, including resolving IRS and state tax notices
  • Working knowledge of payroll tax filings, including Forms 941 and 940 and state withholding and unemployment
  • Experience managing the full 1099 process: setting timelines, coordinating with accounting teams and clients, preparing all forms, and meeting every deadline
  • Comfort preparing business returns and 1040s
  • The ability to explain tax issues clearly to volunteer board members and small-business owners

Preferred

  • A CPA license
  • Experience with sales and use tax across more than one state
  • Experience with state charitable registrations and franchise tax filings
  • Experience with Form 990-T and unrelated business income
  • Experience with youth sports, schools, or other membership-based nonprofits
  • Experience in a high-volume practice with a large client base
  • Familiarity with Intuit ProConnect, TaxDome, and QuickBooks

How we work

Most of our deadlines are nonprofit deadlines, which vary by each client's registered fiscal year.

We work in Intuit ProConnect for returns, TaxDome for client workflow, e-signatures, and powers of attorney, and QuickBooks for the books. You will work alongside our youth sports accountants and controllers, who each carry a small, defined set of clients, so you will know both the people and the books behind every return.

Reports to: Director of Tax (dotted line to VP of Youth Sports)

We are a dynamic portfolio of companies dedicated to advancing health, wellness, and longevity. Led by #1 New York Times Bestselling Author Dr. Peter Attia, we are redefining modern healthcare with a focus on Medicine 3.0—an approach that blends cutting-edge science with proactive, personalized care.

Early Medical is a pioneering virtual (telemedicine) practice specializing in longevity and healthspan optimization. We take a rigorous, science-driven, and precision-based approach, utilizing interventions in nutrition, exercise physiology, sleep optimization, and emotional resilience to help patients live longer and better. Early Medical is part of a broader ecosystem of ventures driven by Peter Attia, including The Drive, a widely recognized podcast dedicated to deep-diving into the science of longevity, and Early, a transformative digital health platform designed to guide individuals through their personalized health journey.

Our team is a high-caliber, mission-driven group of professionals who are deeply passionate about progressive learning and continuous innovation. We operate with autonomy, collaboration, and intellectual rigor, valuing curiosity and evidence-based decision-making. We are a fully remote company, spanning the U.S., united by a commitment to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in health and longevity. We are not just passionate about what we do—we are obsessed with excellence. Our standards are high because our work changes lives.

Join us as we introduce Medicine 3.0 to the world.

About the Role

As our Nutrition Specialist, you are the bridge between science and implementation—helping high-performing individuals make meaningful, lasting changes despite demanding schedules.

Your role is to remove friction, ensuring patients don’t just understand the plan but actually integrate it into their lives. You'll combine deep nutritional expertise with behavioral psychology to craft personalized strategies that drive results. You’ll analyze glucose data, body composition metrics, and biomarkers, pinpointing the barriers that hold patients back—whether physiological, psychological, or practical. Then, you’ll build solutions that make adherence feel effortless.

  • Develop Precision Nutrition Plans – Apply metabolic science to create highly tailored nutrition protocols that optimize glucose, balance caloric intake, and support lean muscle retention.
  • Translate Data into Actionable Strategies – Use CGMs, body composition metrics (ALMI, VAT), and biomarkers to build customized recommendations that fit seamlessly into patients' routines.
  • Coach for Real-World Success – Understand individual barriers, build trust, and help patients implement strategies that work—even in high-pressure environments like travel or intense work phases.
  • Integrate Sleep & Stress Optimization – Ensure patients are set up for success by addressing stress and sleep alongside their nutrition.
  • Create Efficient Systems – Design meal planning, tracking, and adherence strategies that fit into busy schedules while delivering real results.
  • Collaborate with Physicians & Specialists – Work alongside top medical professionals to ensure a fully integrated approach to metabolic health.
  • Continuously Refine & Improve – Monitor patient progress, refine approaches based on outcomes, and contribute insights to optimize our methodologies.

We are targeting a Q1 2027 hire date for this position.

Patient Education (5%)

  • Experience with metabolic health optimization
  • Proven expertise in caloric restriction (CR) and dietary restriction (DR) strategies

  • Strong understanding of, or willingness to learn, Nutrition 3.0 and the Early Medical framework

Preferred Credentials

raw.excerpt: About RunwareRunware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end.
raw.description:
About Runware

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers.

We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom-designed compute into a 20-foot container with closed-loop, water-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement).

Every one of those pods holds customer models, customer data and millions of dollars of GPUs, sometimes inside a customer's own perimeter or a sovereign jurisdiction. Keeping all of it secure without slowing anyone down is the job.

The role

As Senior Security Engineer, you will own the security of Runware's AI supercomputer: the bare-metal GPU fleet, the Sonic Inference Pods it lives in, the managed Kubernetes clusters we hand to customers, and the control plane that ties it all together across the US and Europe. You will design the controls, build the first version with your own hands, and set the standard for how security is run across every pod.

This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will threat-model a new pod before it ships, harden the image that every GPU node boots from, prove to an enterprise customer's security team that their model weights never leave their tenant, and when something goes wrong, lead the response and fix the root cause so it never happens again. You will work directly with our CISO, with the inference engine, platform and hardware teams, and with the site teams deploying pods.

Success means a customer workload on a shared pod is isolated as strongly as on a dedicated one, no human has a standing login to a production node, every change to the fleet is reviewed, signed and auditable, and an enterprise security review takes days instead of months.

What you'll do

  • Own the security architecture of the fleet: host hardening for bare-metal GPU nodes, immutable images and a signed build pipeline, boot integrity, and the identity, secrets and access model for humans and services across every pod.
  • Secure multi-tenancy on shared infrastructure. Design and verify isolation between customer workloads at the network, Kubernetes, host and GPU layers, and produce the evidence that proves it holds.
  • Secure the managed Kubernetes offering: cluster hardening, admission control, RBAC, supply-chain controls for images, and a clean, auditable handover of clusters to customers.
  • Build security visibility across the fleet: logging, detection, alerting and audit trails from firmware to API, wired into the fleet dashboards and on-call so that an anomaly on one node in one pod is seen within minutes.
  • Lead security reviews and threat models for new pods, sites, servers and platform features, with a focus on real-world risk rather than checklists.
  • Run incident response for the infrastructure: investigation, containment, recovery and post-incident learning, as part of the on-call rotation.
  • Own vulnerability management for the fleet: firmware, kernel, drivers, GPU stack and container images across thousands of nodes, with a patch cadence you can defend to a customer.
  • Answer enterprise customers' security due diligence with engineering evidence, and partner with the CISO on the SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls that touch the infrastructure.
  • Design for sovereign and on-premise deployments: data residency, in-country key management, and physical and remote-access controls for a pod sitting on a customer's site.
  • Use AI to accelerate the work: automate evidence collection, log triage, configuration audits and runbooks with LLM-based agents, so that a very small team can secure a very large fleet.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years in security or infrastructure engineering, with several of those securing production infrastructure at a company that runs its own hardware at scale.
  • A track record of building security controls, not just auditing them. You have taken a hardening standard, an access model or a detection pipeline from design to running across a fleet, and you know what breaks between the two.
  • Deep, current, hands-on Linux security expertise: kernel hardening, namespaces and cgroups, seccomp, eBPF, secure and measured boot, TPM-based attestation, and the tooling to see exactly what a process did.
  • Strong Kubernetes security: RBAC, admission control and policy engines, network policy, runtime security, image signing and SBOMs, and the ways a container escapes.
  • Fluent in network security on real hardware: segmentation and VLAN or VXLAN isolation, firewalls, out-of-band management networks, and the risks that live in BMC, IPMI and switch management planes.
  • Experience with identity, secrets and PKI at scale: short-lived credentials, workload identity, hardware-backed keys, and removing standing access without slowing engineers down.
  • Fluent in Python or Go, and comfortable writing the tooling, scanners and automation yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own output every day, for scripting, log analysis, code review, documentation and incident triage, and you have a clear view of how a small security team armed with these tools should operate differently.
  • A clear communicator who can explain the same trade-off to an engineer, a customer's CISO and a founder in one afternoon, and who assesses risk pragmatically rather than by the book.
  • Able to travel to sites in the US and Europe as needed.

Nice to have

  • Experience securing GPU clusters for AI training or inference: the NVIDIA driver and fabric manager stack, GPU multi-tenancy (MIG, time-slicing, per-tenant isolation), confidential computing on GPUs, and protecting model weights at rest and in flight.
  • Firmware and hardware security: UEFI, BMC and NIC firmware lifecycle, Redfish, hardware root of trust and supply-chain attestation for servers arriving at a site.
  • Hands-on experience with InfiniBand or RoCE fabrics and the security model of RDMA.
  • Delivering SOC 2 or ISO 27001 in a production environment, and compliance tooling and evidence automation.
  • Offensive experience: red teaming, penetration testing or vulnerability research against infrastructure.
  • Experience with sovereign, air-gapped or regulated deployments, including data residency across jurisdictions.
  • Physical security of data centres or edge sites: access control, tamper evidence and remote-hands procedures.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A rare mandate: secure an AI supercomputer from the firmware up, at a company that owns every layer of its stack and whose enterprise customers are trusting it with their models, with the backing to match.
  • Meaningful stock options.
  • We're a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm and celebrate wins. We keep core hours for collaboration and calls; outside those, you set your own schedule.
  • Our release cycles are fast and intense, and they're followed by real downtime. We expect you to take it.
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, sick days and public holidays.
  • Paid maternity, paternity and caregiver leave.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats in inspiring locations.

raw.excerpt: About Us Chess. com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
raw.description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About the role

The Site Reliability Engineer will play a critical role in ensuring the stability, performance, and scalability of our global gaming platform infrastructure. This position exists to bridge the gap between development and operations, maintaining high availability for millions of concurrent users while supporting rapid feature development and deployment. The SRE will be instrumental in building resilient systems that can handle massive scale across multiple regions, directly impacting user experience and platform reliability.

As our platform continues to grow and serve a global community, this role will drive the technical infrastructure decisions that enable seamless gaming experiences. The position requires both deep technical expertise and collaborative leadership to work across engineering teams, ensuring our systems can scale efficiently while maintaining the performance standards our users expect.

What you'll do

  • Design and implement multi-regional resilient infrastructure capable of handling millions of concurrent sessions and transactions daily across global data centers
  • Lead the hybrid cloud migration strategy, integrating bare-metal datacenter resources with cloud services for optimal performance and cost efficiency
  • Own the on-call rotation and incident response procedures, ensuring rapid resolution of critical system issues and maintaining high availability SLAs
  • Architect monitoring and alerting systems using industry-standard tools to proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they impact users
  • Collaborate with development teams to implement infrastructure-as-code practices and establish deployment pipelines that support continuous integration and delivery
  • Optimize system performance through capacity planning, load testing, and resource allocation across distributed computing environments
  • Establish and maintain security protocols and risk assessment procedures for infrastructure components and data protection
  • Partner with engineering teams to design scalable solutions for high-traffic applications and real-time processing requirements
  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational overhead and improve system reliability through scripting and configuration management
  • Mentor team members on SRE best practices and contribute to the development of infrastructure standards and documentation

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering roles
  • Experience managing bare-metal server infrastructure and datacenter operations
  • Strong proficiency with UNIX/Linux operating systems and command-line administration
  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with configuration management systems (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS), and network troubleshooting
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar)
  • Proficiency with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, including performance optimization and scaling strategies
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills for working effectively in a distributed team environment
  • Demonstrated sense of ownership and accountability for system reliability and performance

Nice to have

  • Advanced knowledge of content delivery networks (CDNs) and edge computing
  • Experience with server-side automation and scripting languages (Python, Go, Bash, or similar)
  • Background in high-availability architectures and disaster recovery planning
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and compliance requirements
  • Experience with game server infrastructure or real-time application hosting
  • Knowledge of database administration and optimization for high-concurrency applications
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
  • Experience with capacity planning and performance testing tools
  • Previous experience in a fully remote, distributed work environment
  • Continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging infrastructure technologies

About the Opportunity

  • This is a full-time opportunity
  • We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

raw.description:
What's the role?

HERE Technologies is looking for an experienced enterprise seller to own and grow strategic customers with a focus in On-Demand Mobility and Fleet Technology & Telematics. You'll build executive relationships, uncover new growth opportunities, and connect HERE's location platform, data and emerging AI capabilities to customers' most important business and technology priorities. What will you do?
  • Own and grow complex strategic accounts.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business, Product, Engineering and Technology leaders.
  • Identify whitespace and develop multi-year growth opportunities.
  • Lead enterprise opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Translate HERE's location, data and AI capabilities into compelling business outcomes.
  • Orchestrate HERE teams around customer opportunities and strengthen our Bay Area presence.

Who are you?

  • 10+ years in enterprise technology sales, business development or strategic accounts.
  • Proven success with large, complex enterprise customers.
  • Experience selling SaaS, cloud, data, platforms, APIs/SDKs or other sophisticated technology solutions.
  • Strong executive presence, consultative discovery and negotiation skills.
  • Comfort engaging both technical and business leaders.
  • Experience in Mobility, Fleet/Telematics, Logistics, AI or location technology is a plus.
  • An established Bay Area technology network is highly desirable.

Why HERE?

HERE combines global location data, enterprise-grade technology and deep real-world context. You will help customers use those capabilities to optimize movement, improve operations, build location-aware products and apply AI to problems in the physical world. You do not need to know everything about HERE on day one. What matters is your ability to learn quickly, architect credible solutions and communicate their value.

The expected base salary range for this position is $154,000 - $220,000 per year. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills and experience. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, which is subject to company and individual performance.

Life at HERE comes with generous benefits to support your health and overall wellness. Benefits available to US-based HERE employees include health (Medical/Dental/Vision) insurance, retirement savings plans, paid time off & leave policies.

As part of HERE Technologies employment process, candidates will be required to successfully complete a background verification process. Offers of employment and any related claims are subject to the successful completion of a background verification. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, HERE will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

HERE is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, parental status, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Under Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 and VEVRAA, we have developed an affirmative action program (AAP) for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Portions of the AAP are available for review by applicants and employees through our People Team.

Who are we?

HERE Technologies is a location data and technology platform company. We empower our customers to achieve better outcomes – from helping a city manage its infrastructure or a business optimize its assets to guiding drivers to their destination safely.

At HERE we take it upon ourselves to be the change we wish to see. We create solutions that fuel innovation, provide opportunity and foster inclusion to improve people’s lives. If you are inspired by an open world and driven to create positive change, join us. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

Engine is looking for a Partner Hub Solutions leader to grow and scale our advertising business across enterprise hotel chains, property management groups (PMGs), and destination marketing organizations (DMOs).

Partner Hub is Engine's advertising platform for the hospitality supply ecosystem. This role owns a defined portfolio of Partner Hub advertising customers and drives new business across the supply base — selling, launching, and managing campaigns across our media portfolio (Spotlight, Carousel, 2XR / Elevate Plus, Group Spotlight, and future ad units).

This is a hybrid account management and new business role. You will renew and expand a book of existing accounts, prospect and close new logos, build customized media proposals, quarterback campaign launches with Product and Engineering, and serve as the day-to-day commercial owner of your accounts.

This role is ideal for a media or marketing sales professional who wants to own outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise hospitality accounts — someone who is equally comfortable pitching a $500K annual program to a chain CMO and optimizing weekly performance reports to keep a live campaign on track.

What You'll Do

  • Own a book of Partner Hub advertising accounts across hotel chains, PMGs, and DMOs — driving renewals, upsells, and cross-sells across Spotlight, Carousel, 2XR / Elevate Plus, and Group Spotlight
  • Prospect, qualify, and close new business across the hospitality supply base — hotel chains, property management groups, and destination marketing organizations
  • Build customized marketing proposals (deck, memo, and mocks) that translate customer objectives — occupancy, mid-week compression, group demand, seasonal need periods, market share — into specific media plans with clear ROAS assumptions
  • Run campaigns end-to-end: brief creative, coordinate launch with Partner Hub PM and Engineering, monitor pacing and performance, deliver mid-flight optimizations, and produce end-of-flight recaps
  • Serve as the day-to-day partner contact for your accounts, leading QBRs, campaign check-ins, and performance reviews
  • Partner with Partner Hub PM and Engineering to surface customer feedback, prioritize campaign-blocking gaps, and inform the product roadmap
  • Maintain accurate Salesforce hygiene across pipeline, forecast, and account activity, and contribute to weekly and monthly commercial reviews
  • Represent Engine at partner-facing meetings, joint business planning sessions, and select industry events

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in media sales, marketing sales, ad-tech / mar-tech account roles, or destination / hospitality marketing
  • Track record carrying quota and growing a book of enterprise accounts against both renewal and new-logo targets
  • Background in media solutions, digital advertising, or marketing services is required; travel, hospitality, or destination-marketing industry experience is strongly preferred
  • Strong proposal and deck-building skills — able to translate a customer brief into a specific, well-priced, ROAS-anchored media plan
  • Fluency with campaign metrics (impressions, CTR, ROAS, incrementality, attributed room nights) and the ability to explain them clearly to non-technical partners
  • Proficient in Salesforce, PowerPoint / Google Slides, and campaign performance / ROI analysis in spreadsheets
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; poised in executive settings but willing to do the operational work to keep campaigns on track
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Applications for this role will be accepted through January 4, 2027 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$165,000—$195,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

raw.description:
Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the #ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.

Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

Job Summary

Support the rapid expansion of Shake Shack’s global licensing business through menu development, product manufacturing, food quality assessment and culinary marketing initiatives. This role is equal parts food science and culinary creativity. The ideal candidate is versed in the norms of food manufacturing and commercialization and has experience working in factory settings to develop and produce a variety of food products. Restaurant kitchen experience is also preferred as this position supports global culinary menu development and innovation through the creation and implementation of locally relevant, on trend, menu items. A strong ability to organoleptically assess food quality and adjust and calibrate recipes to ensure menus across the world remain consistent and true to Shake Shack’s culinary standards. This position will support the expansion of Shake Shack by entering new countries and markets through working closely with the Supply Chain team to develop core products and ingredients. This role will also liaise and work closely with domestic US based Culinary, R&D, and QA teams.

Job Responsibilities and Duties

1. Commercially develop proprietary products for Shake Shack with a focus on localized production where possible.

  • KPI: Leverage existing supplier and partner network or identify new manufacturing facilities that have the necessary capabilities to produce core products and work in collaboration with those facilities to commercialize products according to brand standard to meet all sensory, quality and food safety specifications
  • KPI: Work cross functionally to identify and execute product improvement and consistency through reformulations and maintenance initiatives.
  • KPI: Consult with manufacturers to ensure that any change in process or ingredient does not affect the performance or sensory standards of items
    • Review and approve proposed ingredients throughout any development or reformulation
  • KPI: Develop and review specifications to ensure production runs yield desired product attributes consistently and in a safe manner.
  • KPI: Independently travel and attend various factory visits with the purpose of implementing necessary product adjustments and ultimately review final product for approval for use in market.

raw.description:
Be the last expert to look at a deliverable before it reaches the client. We promise our client that a senior reviewer who did not produce the work will approve every final deliverable. That reviewer needs to be someone who has seen enough analyses to know when a number looks too clean, a comparison is not fair, or a conclusion goes further than the data. You work only when there is something to review, and your sign-off carries real weight.

What you'll do

  • Review and approve final deliverables for analytical soundness, traceability to source data, material limitations, conformance with scope, and acceptance criteria.

  • Check that findings are supported, that data gaps and uncertainty are stated, and that AI-assisted results were validated by a person.

  • Document required corrections, confirm they were made, and record your approval.

  • Advise Task Leads on analytical approach when asked, before work reaches final review.

  • Stay independent: you never review work you helped produce.

Required qualifications

  • Advanced degree (master's or doctorate) in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • At least 15 years of professional experience in analytics, data science, or applied research, including leading complex analytical engagements.

  • A record of reviewing other people's quantitative work and giving direct, specific feedback.

  • Experience with large datasets drawn from many sources with inconsistent definitions.

  • Clear, concise writing, since your review notes become part of the record.

  • Based in the US and able to work remotely, part-time, in TechSilo's managed environment.

How the role works

Work is on call and tied to deliverable dates. Expect a few hours per deliverable and typically under 10 hours a month, with more during busy periods. There is no guaranteed minimum, and the role starts only if the contract is awarded. We also name a backup reviewer so deliveries are never held up, and you may be asked to cover for them. Finalists will be asked to sign a commitment letter so we can name them in our proposal, and their resume may be shared with the client.

Required qualifications

  • Advanced degree (master's or doctorate) in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • At least 15 years of professional experience in analytics, data science, or applied research, including leading complex analytical engagements.

  • A record of reviewing other people's quantitative work and giving direct, specific feedback.

  • Experience with large datasets drawn from many sources with inconsistent definitions.

  • Clear, concise writing, since your review notes become part of the record.

  • Based in the US and able to work remotely, part-time, in TechSilo's managed environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with procurement or spend data, sustainability reporting, or emissions accounting (GHG Protocol, STARS).

  • Work for a university, a public agency, or another organization made of many separate entities.

  • Experience validating machine-learning or AI-assisted analysis.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

#CJ

TechSilo is a small technology and engineering services firm in Fredericksburg, Virginia. We support federal defense customers, including a multi-year Navy engineering program, and we are growing into higher education and public-sector analytics. The team is small and senior, and our CEO is the Program Director on this work, so your review goes to decision makers directly.

Join Vi’s Life Science Markets squad that turns large, varied proprietary datasets into products that help evaluate pharmaceutical markets, treatment adoption, competitive dynamics, and drug commercial performance.

The role provides input into audit strategy and risk-based audit planning and leads process and complex audits, as well as providing QA consultancy activities within their area of GxP expertise.

Core responsibilities of the Senior Auditor are:

  • Auditing
  • Within area of their GxP expertise, conduct audits initiated by the Company, or contracted by small to mid-size Clients, according to the agreed Audit Program including effective management of pre-audit activities.

Audit types may include:

    • Audits of Company Partners and Vendors/Service Providers
    • Internal System Audits
    • Study audits (e.g. of study files, investigational sites)
    • Audits of Third Parties on behalf of Clients (e.g. including MAH PV System, Vendors, MAH Affiliate/ Partner Audits).
      • Reviews and approves all final CAPA plans from contracted audits within timelines mandated by Company/ Client procedures
    • Consultancies e.g. Client PV / QMS system gap analysis, SOP development, etc.
  • Main QA contact for designated Clients and plans, conducts and reports on audits requested by Clients
  • Quality as a Service
    • Attend commercial meetings related to Quality as a Service
    • Supports Clients with a wide variety of Quality as a Service activities, including
      • Mock inspections
      • Training
      • Gap analysis
      • Procedure drafting and revision
  • Other
    • Supports audits and inspections of the Company performed by Clients/third parties and regulatory authorities
    • Works with the Quality leadership to develop and train Auditors and other quality employees
    • Assists in the development of strategic internal audit program
    • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of international regulatory requirements, guidelines and best practices and actively participate in knowledge-sharing and learning process to ensure personal and team continuous learning and development
    • Participate in preparation (authoring or QC) of audit strategy, SOPs, guidelines and other documented procedures required for auditing activity of the Company and/or Client as per operational needs
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline required; Master’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

  • Strong previous pharmaceutical and/or biotech pharmacovigilance experience, including strong understanding of GVP & GCP related Quality Management and Assurance, with previous experience of GVP and GCP auditing experience in an Audit Lead role.
  • Analytical, written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to manage all tasks assigned and effectively deliver all expected deliverables in an organized and a timely manner
  • Proactively communicate changes in pre-established goals and deadlines
  • Ability to think strategically and to work collaboratively using risk-based, proactive approaches to problem-solving
  • Strong team player
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional/ local languages a plus, but not required

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

Location: Remote – Must be in the United StatesCompensation: $80,000 - $90,000 annually + commission

Develop and execute a market and account strategy to acquire mid-market retail and secured deposit customers. You have the entrepreneurial vision to set the business strategy, the detailed focus to execute that strategy, and the self-motivation to constantly drive long-term financial growth & success for your product portfolio.


In this role, you’ll be part of our Digital Product Management team. We develop shipping and tracking solutions like PitneyShip and PitneyTrack, ParcelPoint smart lockers, and the reporting and insights solution PitneyAnalytics. All of our offerings are built on our modern Shipping 360 digital platform and are focused on reducing the complexity of sending and receiving parcels and mail for our clients.

  • A strong strategic thinker, able to build successful long-term growth businesses.
  • Passionate about exceeding internal leadership & external client expectations.

The wage range for this position is $150,000-180,000 per year, with the actual pay dependent on your skills, experience, and location as they relate to the job requirements. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus.

SendTech Solutions offers physical and digital mailing and shipping technology solutions, financing, services, supplies and other applications for small and medium businesses, retail, enterprise, and government clients around the world to help simplify and save on the sending, tracking and receiving of letters, parcels and flats.


Check out our mail stations: SendPro Series C&P, DI2000 and our newest product/service-Smart Lockers. Machines for automating the insertion of mail into envelopes, opening mail, creating/printing documents, and shredding office documents.

Movable Ink scales content personalization for marketers through data-activated content generation and AI decisioning. The world’s most innovative brands rely on Movable Ink to maximize revenue, simplify workflow and boost marketing agility. Headquartered in New York City with close to 600 employees, Movable Ink serves its global client base with operations throughout North America, Central America, Europe, Australia, and Japan.

As Lead Product Manager at Movable Ink, you'll own the behavioral decisioning capabilities that sit at the heart of our most time-sensitive marketing activations. This means defining how our platform detects meaningful customer patterns over time and turns them into reliable, high-value triggers, from abandoned cart and price drop to the next generation of signals our customers haven't yet imagined. You'll partner closely with a technically strong engineering team to set product direction, resolve ownership boundaries across dependent teams, and build the foundation for self-serve behavioral configuration at scale. This is a role for a product thinker who is energized by technical depth, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by seeing their work drive real customer outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Movable Ink's Behavioral decisioning layer across Da Vinci and Studio
  • Partner with engineering to define and evolve the trigger library, stateful contact context model, declarative pattern framework, and suppression and eligibility controls
  • Establish and maintain clear product scope and integration contracts with dependent teams including events, data persistence, semantic labeling, and delivery
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-value behavioral use cases by drawing on customer insight, commercial input, and data, and translate them into well-scoped requirements engineering can execute against
  • Define the configuration model and taxonomy for the declarative pattern framework, enabling new behavioral signals to be created without engineering involvement
  • Be a ruthless advocate for our customers in every interaction and decision

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of product management experience working directly with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders, with demonstrated ownership of a technical product domain
  • Ability to reason about event-driven systems, stateful logic, and time-windowed pattern detection at a conceptual level, and translate those concepts into clear product requirements
  • Strong prioritization skills, capable of distinguishing high-leverage investments from parity work and building alignment around sequencing decisions
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguous ownership boundaries and establishing durable cross-team contracts in environments with multiple interdependent engineering teams
  • Clear communicator who can operate across engineering, CX, sales, and executive stakeholders, adjusting depth and framing without losing precision
  • Experience partnering closely with engineering in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where product direction and team process are shaped together
The base pay range for this position is $168,000-$215,000/year, which can include additional bonus depending on the position ultimately offered, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits. The base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Studies have shown that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture where all Inkers can thrive. If you’re excited about the role but don’t meet all of the abovementioned qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Our differences bring a breadth of knowledge and perspectives that makes us collectively stronger.

We welcome and employ people regardless of race, color, gender identity or expression, religion, genetic information, parental or pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ethnicity, family or marital status, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, disability, Veteran status, or other protected characteristics. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

The Role:

The incumbent will also work closely with other Compliance and Customer Support teams, and peer AML Investigators in addressing both fraud and money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions risks.

The incumbent will maintain and develop strong relationships and network amongst peers in the industry to learn and share best practices and investigative techniques.

In performing the role, the incumbent will continuously strive to continuously self-develop and enhance their skill sets incl. understanding blockchain technology, virtual currencies, suspicious activities in the space, criminals’ modus operandi and best investigative practices to mitigate against the risk of money laundering, financing terrorism or violating sanctions on behalf of Bitfinex and to ensure the company’s robust Regulatory Compliance requirements.

  • Communication with customers, agents, and internal attorneys as applicable.

  • Demonstrated AML experience incl. customer and enhanced due diligence (CDD/EDD), AML/CTF/Sanctions Investigations, SAR/STR reporting

Skills:

  • Career Development Opportunities

  • Supportive Team Environment

  • Learning & Knowledge Sharing

About the Role

Orchard is looking for a dynamic Escrow Officer to manage the closing process and provide an exceptional experience for our customers. The ideal candidate is a seasoned real estate professional with direct experience closing 1-4 family residential purchase transactions. If you are used to working with high-stakes and time-sensitive deals with an awesome support staff where every detail and process is critical to the successful and timely completion of the transaction, this is the job for you!. This is a full time role that will report into the National Escrow Manager.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Prepare closing disclosures, escrow agreements and all other settlement documents according to lender and/or buyer/seller instructions
  • Clearly communicate and collaborate with cross-department contacts in Customer Experience / Sales, Contract Operations, and Funding to promptly troubleshoot and resolve any issues in the Title process to avoid delays
  • Obtain clear title by ordering title reports, resolving title defects, satisfying existing liens and encumbrances against property or principals
  • Audit all files for accuracy, completion, and compliance to prevent potential claims
  • Coordinate closings via e-notary or mobile notary services
  • Provide correct lender closing instructions and oversee the receipt and proper disbursement of funds; ensure all outstanding checks and escrowed funds are properly managed
  • Maintain compliance with Orchard Title policies and procedures in accordance with governing laws, regulations, regulatory agencies and company standards

We’d Love to Hear From You if You Have:

  • 4+ years of experience as an Escrow Officer
  • Exceptional verbal and written customer service skills that help form positive relationships both internally and externally
  • BilingualinEnglishandSpanish(verbalandwrittencommunicationskillspreferred).
  • Experience mastering complex processes and contributing with the understanding of your role within a larger series of processes
  • Confidence working with technologies (e.g. Microsoft Suite and Google Suite) and speciality software (e.g. Qualia)
  • Working knowledge of FL state-level escrow rules and regulations
  • A team player mentality who subscribes to the concept of “Team Before Self”
  • Passion for innovation and are comfortable with change
  • Organization skills and are exceptionally detail-oriented

About the Title, Escrow & Closing Team

Orchard Title is an affiliate of Orchard Technologies, fully dedicated to offering Title & Escrow services to customers to provide the most seamless, delightful closing experience possible. Orchard Title has a national footprint; we are currently in Texas, Georgia, Colorado, Tennessee, Washington, Arizona, California, North Carolina, and Florida with plans to expand to additional states that we are currently licensed in.

raw.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (U.S.)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reports To: Director, Early Talent, Claude Corps
Manages: Claude Corps screeners
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000

About Claude Corps

Claude Corps is a fellowship that places early-career talent in nonprofits, government agencies, and public-interest organizations to build AI solutions those organizations can continue using after the fellowship ends. It is a partnership between Anthropic, CodePath, and Social Finance. Fellows are full-time employees for a one-year term.

Each cohort is larger than the last, and every candidate deserves a process that feels organized, responsive, and human. That’s where you come in.

You’ll lead the Claude Corps screener team day to day. You make sure applications are reviewed, screens are completed, and every candidate decision is documented on time.

The Director sets recruiting strategy and cohort hiring goals. You turn those goals into weekly targets, plan staffing, and manage the team’s work. This is a hands-on management role. You train and coach screeners, review their work, and keep selection standards consistent as volume grows. You work closely with the Director, the recruiting coordinator, and the Claude Corps program team.

Key Activities

Run screening delivery

  • Turn cohort hiring goals into weekly review and screening targets with the Director
  • Assign work based on volume, deadlines, and screener availability
  • Track outstanding reviews, screens, and decisions, and flag staffing gaps early
  • Deliver a steady pipeline of qualified candidates to final-round interviews

Maintain clear selection standards

  • Train screeners on the program’s eligibility requirements, interview questions, and evaluation criteria
  • Make sure every decision has a completed scorecard with clear evidence
  • Review decisions regularly for consistency across screeners, and resolve unclear guidance
  • Use candidate and final-round results to sharpen screening guidance and questions

Build and lead the screener team

  • Hire and train screeners as cohort needs grow
  • Set clear expectations for output, decision quality, documentation, and candidate communication
  • Coach screeners with regular feedback and address performance issues directly
  • Run weekly team meetings and keep the screener guide and process instructions current

Run the operation

  • Keep Greenhouse reviews, stages, and scorecards complete and accurate
  • Give the Director weekly results, explain what’s driving changes, and recommend actions
  • Plan screening capacity ahead of application surges and share what results show about where more qualified applicants are needed
  • Use AI and automation to cut repetitive administrative work, and train screeners to check the quality of what it produces
  • Keep people responsible for evaluating candidates and making selection decisions

Key Success Metrics

  • Weekly delivery: Application reviews and screens meet agreed targets, and delays and staffing gaps are flagged early
  • Selection quality: Screeners apply criteria consistently, with clear evidence in every scorecard
  • Screener readiness: New screeners are trained in time for cohort needs and meet the team’s standards
  • Accurate reporting: The Director gets reliable weekly numbers with context and recommended actions
  • Team performance: Screeners get regular feedback, and performance issues are addressed promptly

Qualifications

  • You have at least five (5) years of recruiting experience, including managing recruiters or screeners in a high-volume or early-talent hiring program
  • You have managed a team’s workload, output, and quality using weekly targets and reporting
  • You have trained people to apply consistent selection standards and can explain how you checked their decisions
  • You have coached team members and addressed performance issues directly
  • You have personally reviewed applications and conducted structured candidate screens at volume
  • You can manage candidate stages, scorecards, and reports in an applicant tracking system (Greenhouse experience is preferred)
  • You use AI in your work and can describe a process you improved or automated
  • You can build clear processes while a program is still developing and adjust them as needed

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

$110,000—$150,000 USD

raw.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn.
raw.description:
Grow our AI image service.

Before you apply, spend ten minutes on our website and LinkedIn. In your Loom we will ask what we do, where you found out about us, and why you want to work at Drop Zero Digital. Answers that could be about any company will not pass.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years. We check your work history against what you tell us, and a false answer ends the application.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video. Research us first.
  2. A short test by email: one real decision task, your internet speed, your computer, and a paragraph on your work history.
  3. A 15 minute call with the founder.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. Aptitude tests. These inform us, they do not decide.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Based in Uruguay.

Benefits

2100 USD per month from day one, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

Role Summary

The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading the organization's commercial strategy, revenue generation, sales operations, business development, and market expansion across insurance and investment services. The role focuses on driving sustainable revenue growth, increasing market share, developing strategic partnerships, expanding distribution channels, and maximizing commercial performance across business units and markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Strategy: Develop and execute group-wide commercial strategies, sales plans, and revenue growth initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand market presence, and establish strategic partnerships with insurers, banks, brokers, investors, and financial institutions.
  • Sales Leadership: Lead sales, business development, relationship management, and distribution teams to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Insurance Business Growth: Drive insurance premium growth, product distribution, policy acquisition, renewals, and expansion of insurance brokerage or agency networks.
  • Investment Business Development: Develop commercial strategies for investment products, asset management services, wealth management, and institutional investment relationships, where applicable.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and manage relationships with corporate clients, institutional investors, insurance providers, intermediaries, and distribution partners.
  • Market Expansion: Identify new geographical markets, customer segments, and distribution channels to strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Revenue & Profitability Management: Oversee commercial budgets, sales forecasts, pricing strategies, pipeline management, and revenue performance.
  • Customer & Relationship Management: Strengthen client acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Commercial Performance: Establish KPIs, monitor sales performance, evaluate market trends, and report commercial results to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
  • MBA or master's degree in Business, Finance, or Marketing preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales, insurance, investments, or financial services.
  • Significant experience leading commercial operations, revenue generation, and multi-channel sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance products, investment services, wealth management, financial markets, and distribution models.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, developing strategic partnerships, expanding market share, and achieving commercial targets.
  • Experience managing large client portfolios, institutional relationships, and cross-functional commercial teams.
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, financial analysis, communication, and strategic decision-making skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue growth and commercial profitability.
  • Insurance premium growth and policy acquisition.
  • Investment product sales and assets under management growth, where applicable.
  • New client acquisition and customer retention.
