raw.description:
Trade Specialist | U.S. Customs & Client Care

Take your customs expertise beyond the entry.

At GHY, we don’t just move goods across borders. We help businesses navigate complexity, solve problems, and trade with confidence.

For more than a century, we’ve helped importers and exporters navigate global trade. As a Best-Managed Employer and family-led organization, we’ve built our reputation on expertise, integrity, innovation, and genuinely caring about our clients and one another.

If you know customs, enjoy solving problems, and are ready to take greater ownership of the client experience, this could be your next move.

About the Role:

As a Trade Specialist, you’ll go beyond processing customs entries to help ensure our clients receive accurate, consistent, and knowledgeable support.

Reporting to the Client Care Manager, you’ll oversee day-to-day client needs, audit released shipments, maintain client databases and work instructions, and help resolve issues as they arise. You’ll also share your experience with colleagues and support the release team when additional expertise is needed.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced customs professional who is ready to take more ownership, deepen their technical knowledge, and become a trusted resource for both clients and teammates.

What You'll Do:

  • 🤝 Own the client experience. Support day-to-day client needs, answer questions, troubleshoot issues, and help find solutions when challenges arise.🔎
  • Protect quality and accuracy. Audit customs entries and released shipments to identify errors, inconsistencies, and opportunities to improve.
  • 🧠 Be a customs resource. Stay current on CBP regulations and Partner Government Agency requirements, research questions, and help translate regulations into practical guidance.
  • 📞 Keep everyone connected. Communicate professionally with clients, carriers, vendors, Customs, and internal teams to gather information and resolve issues.
  • 📋 Know the client inside and out. Develop and maintain client work instructions, databases, FTA correlations, annual certificates, and other critical account information.
  • 🚚 Step in when it matters. Support accurate customs entry processing across transportation modes when needed to keep shipments moving.
  • 🌱 Share what you know. Assist, coach, and mentor teammates with transactional processing, client requirements, and customs-related questions.
  • 💡 Solve problems before they grow. Recognize risks, use sound judgment, and make timely decisions that help protect both our clients and GHY.

Who You Are:

You know customs, but you also understand that great brokerage service is about more than getting an entry released.

You’re someone who asks questions, catches details others might miss, and takes ownership when something needs to be resolved. You’re equally comfortable digging into regulations, talking with a client, or helping a teammate work through a challenging entry.

You bring:

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. Customs rules and regulations
  • Advanced understanding of customs entry and commercial invoice requirements
  • Working knowledge of Partner Government Agency requirements and entry data elements
  • Knowledge of tariff classification, the General Rules of Interpretation (GRIs), General Notes, and Explanatory Notes
  • Exceptional client service and relationship-building skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Sound judgment when making time-sensitive decisions
  • Experience navigating different client requirements, nuances, and SOPs
  • The ability to prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment
  • Clear, positive, and professional written and verbal communication
  • Experience with customs brokerage software
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • The ability to work independently while remaining a collaborative member of the team

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of customs brokerage or related industry experience
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) designation
  • U.S. Customs Broker License (REQUIRED for Remote Work)
  • Demonstrated experience applying customs knowledge to client needs and transactional processing

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • ❤️ We CARE: Our values guide how we work: Clients are our focus, Associates matter, Relentlessly serving traders, and Excellence and innovation in all we do.
  • 🏡 Remote Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a collaborative, experienced team.
  • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Fair pay supported by scheduled salary assessments and a performance-based bonus program.
  • 🩺 Excellent Benefits: Comprehensive, subsidized health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life & AD&D coverage.
  • 📈 Keep Growing: Access ongoing learning through our internal university and leadership development programming.
  • 🤝 More Than Work: Our Giveback Committee, Social Committee, and Cultural Ambassadors create opportunities to connect, contribute, and have some fun along the way.

The Details

📍 Location: We offer flexibility based on experience and location. Candidates within 2 hours of a GHY office may be considered without a U.S. Customs Broker License. For candidates located more than 2 hours from a GHY office, an active U.S. Customs Broker License is required.

🕒 Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week
📅 Holidays: Two statutory holidays per year may be required

💰 Compensation: Based on experience

Know Customs. Own the Details. Make an Impact.

You’ve built the foundation. Now it’s time to use that experience in a role where your judgment, client service, and customs knowledge make a bigger impact.

At GHY, you’ll solve problems, support clients, share what you know, and continue building your expertise alongside people who understand the complexities of international trade.

Ready to take the next step in your customs career? Apply today.

GHY is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Salary: Starts at $50,000; Based on Experience

raw.excerpt: Lateral stands for technology excellence.  We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses.
raw.description:
Lateral stands for technology excellence.

We’re a profitable, award-winning design and technology company with over 20 years of experience launching bold ventures and transforming businesses. A globally distributed team of 200+ experts united by a shared purpose: the continuous pursuit of quality.

Our clients come to us for results, quality and craft - and stay because we keep raising the bar.

We Do Things Differently at Lateral

Our mission is simple: design and build great products.
What sets us apart isn’t just the talent of our team - it’s the way we work:

We Have A Bias For Action & Results.

We are doers - we spot the gaps, connect the dots, anticipate what’s around the corner and take action. We move fast, stay focused, and let the results - not the effort - speak for themselves.

We Work On Time, On Budget, On Quality

Discipline is our edge - a commitment we make to each other, to our clients, and to the standards we hold ourselves to.

We Care Deeply.

We care about our work and about each other. Care Is A Competitive Advantage.

Every detail matters. Every design, every line of code, every decision. Thoughtful by default.

We Do Things Right - Because It’s the Right Thing to Do

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You'll Do

As a Solutions Architect at Lateral, your role is to connect business ambition with the technology needed to deliver it. You will shape solutions, guide technical direction, and partner directly with clients, while supporting our delivery teams with clarity, structure, and sound architectural judgment.

You will:

  • Lead solution definition for key initiatives: architecture, technical approach, integration strategy, cloud alignment, and delivery feasibility.

  • Work directly with client executives and product leaders to translate business needs into scalable, modern architectures across AWS, Azure,orGCP.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to turn architectural direction into actionable plans, balancing quality, velocity, and pragmatic tradeoffs.

  • Conduct architecture assessments, review existing systems, and define modernization, migration, or greenfield approaches.

  • Develop solution proposals, SOWs, estimates, and architectural documentation for pre-sales and delivery.

  • Represent Lateral in early conversations with hyperscalers. As part of a strategic initiative, you’ll help build partner relationships with AWS, Azure, and GCP.

  • Support delivery teams through ongoing architectural decisions, technical guidance, and risk identification.

  • Champion clarity and quality: ensuring our solutions are maintainable, well-structured, secure, and aligned with long-term business value.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a seasoned architect with a consulting mindset, someone who is equally strong in technical depth, stakeholder communication, and problem framing.

You must bring:

  • 7+ years of experience in technical leadership roles such as Solutions Architect, Senior Architect, Principal Consultant, or similar.

  • A background in consulting or services environments

  • Deep expertise in designing systems on AWS, Azure,orGCP architecture patterns, compute, storage, API design, integration strategies, observability, and deployment models.

  • Strong ability to lead discovery conversations, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into technical direction.

  • Experience shaping architecture for complex systems, SaaS products, integrations, distributed systems, and modern cloud applications.

  • Excellent communication skills: you can explain tradeoffs, options, and decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong consultancy instincts: pre-sales exposure, client advisory work, and solution packaging are second nature to you.

  • A preference for modern software engineering (cloud-native, serverless, event-driven, container-based, or hybrid approaches).

  • Comfort working in ambiguity, shaping clarity, and bringing structure to complex technical and business problems.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.

    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

01. Your work
Show us the work that reflects you at your best. We’ll look at depth, design thinking, and the logic behind your choices.

02. Lateral team fit
You’ll speak with our Talent team about your career direction, your motivators, and our plans ahead.

03. Work trial

You’ll tackle a take-home challenge that mirrors what we actually do.

04.Engineering deep dive
A collaborative session with our engineers.

05. Project fit
An interview focussed on prioritization, collaboration across disciplines, and how you handle the "messy middle".

Role Summary

The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) – Insurance & Investments is responsible for leading the organization's commercial strategy, revenue generation, sales operations, business development, and market expansion across insurance and investment services. The role focuses on driving sustainable revenue growth, increasing market share, developing strategic partnerships, expanding distribution channels, and maximizing commercial performance across business units and markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial Strategy: Develop and execute group-wide commercial strategies, sales plans, and revenue growth initiatives across insurance and investment businesses.
  • Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, expand market presence, and establish strategic partnerships with insurers, banks, brokers, investors, and financial institutions.
  • Sales Leadership: Lead sales, business development, relationship management, and distribution teams to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Insurance Business Growth: Drive insurance premium growth, product distribution, policy acquisition, renewals, and expansion of insurance brokerage or agency networks.
  • Investment Business Development: Develop commercial strategies for investment products, asset management services, wealth management, and institutional investment relationships, where applicable.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Build and manage relationships with corporate clients, institutional investors, insurance providers, intermediaries, and distribution partners.
  • Market Expansion: Identify new geographical markets, customer segments, and distribution channels to strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Revenue & Profitability Management: Oversee commercial budgets, sales forecasts, pricing strategies, pipeline management, and revenue performance.
  • Customer & Relationship Management: Strengthen client acquisition, retention, cross-selling, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Commercial Performance: Establish KPIs, monitor sales performance, evaluate market trends, and report commercial results to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.
  • MBA or master's degree in Business, Finance, or Marketing preferred.
  • Typically 12–18+ years of experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales, insurance, investments, or financial services.
  • Significant experience leading commercial operations, revenue generation, and multi-channel sales teams.
  • Strong understanding of insurance products, investment services, wealth management, financial markets, and distribution models.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth, developing strategic partnerships, expanding market share, and achieving commercial targets.
  • Experience managing large client portfolios, institutional relationships, and cross-functional commercial teams.
  • Excellent leadership, negotiation, financial analysis, communication, and strategic decision-making skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Revenue growth and commercial profitability.
  • Insurance premium growth and policy acquisition.
  • Investment product sales and assets under management growth, where applicable.
  • New client acquisition and customer retention.
  • Market share and geographical expansion.
  • Strategic partnership and distribution-channel development.
  • Sales pipeline conversion and target achievement.

Implementation Specialist

Location: Kansas City metro preferred; remote within the U.S. considered

About Daupler

Serving millions of citizens across the U.S., Daupler helps the professionals who run essential services deliver faster, more reliable operations, whether responding to a burst water main, flagging contaminated drinking water, or keeping customers informed during a power restoration. We are the infrastructure for customer service excellence: a utility within a utility. Backed by leading investors and growing quickly, we’re looking for mission-driven people to help bring American infrastructure, and government, into the 21st century.

About the Role

The Implementation Specialist is where the customer relationship comes to life after the deal is signed. You’ll guide new customers from signed contract to full production — configuring our platform to fit their operations, coordinating across teams, and making sure every customer’s first experience with Daupler is a great one. This is a customer-facing, consultative role: you’ll listen closely to understand each customer’s needs, communicate the value of what we do in terms that matter to them, and represent Daupler throughout onboarding. Strong implementations build trust, deepen adoption, and open the door to growth, and you’ll be central to all three.

This is fundamentally a people role. We can teach the technology; we’re looking for someone who connects with customers and keeps complex work organized and on track.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with our Customer Support, Account Management, and Sales teams to take customers from signed contract to production
  • Work directly with customers to configure our software to meet their specific needs
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and the face of Daupler during onboarding, building strong relationships and communicating our value clearly and consultatively
  • Listen first to understand each customer’s operations, then translate how Daupler solves their challenges
  • Partner with Engineering to facilitate and troubleshoot configuration
  • Work with internal stakeholders to report on scope, and advise on new features that better support customers
  • Surface opportunities to deepen adoption and flag potential expansion internally
  • Maintain disciplined, well-organized records of implementation progress, timelines, and customer interactions

What We’re Looking For

The strongest candidates bring:

  • A people-first approach: exceptional interpersonal skills, empathy, and the ability to build trust with customers and colleagues.
  • Strong organization: you manage multiple implementations, timelines, and details at once without letting things slip. You have a familiarity with project and task management tools: (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
  • A consultative, commercial mindset: comfort understanding customer needs and communicating value, with an eye for opportunities to help customers get more from the platform.
  • Project management experience: solid planning, execution, and delivery.
  • Technical aptitude: familiarity with, or a genuine willingness to learn, customer integration technologies. Hands-on experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.
  • Creative problem-solving: comfort working under pressure, and a flexible, adaptable mindset.
  • A strong sense of responsibility and initiative.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary range based on experience and location
  • Flexible, casual work environment
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Amazing medical, dental and vision options for you and your family
  • The resources and support you need to do your best work

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time.

Equal Opportunity

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at .

Chainlink Labs is looking for a Sales lead to build and scale a new institutional offering that helps financial institutions launch and operate digital asset initiatives through a unified, Chainlink-led approach. You will shape how banks, asset managers, custodians, and financial market infrastructures access the technology and services needed to bring global finance on-chain.

Institutions today navigate complex integrations across custody, tokenization, legacy systems, compliance, and cross-chain distribution. Working across Chainlink’s capabilities and partner ecosystem, you will help define an offering that brings these components together, validate where demand is strongest, and turn that demand into commercial opportunities.

This is a hands-on commercial leadership role with a mandate to build a new business from the ground up. You will define priority customer segments, shape pricing and packaging, and personally lead the first strategic deals.

Your Impact

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for a unified digital asset infrastructure offering (“one stop shop”), establishing priority markets, customer profiles, target accounts, and a clear value proposition.

  • Lead structured discovery with senior institutional stakeholders to understand their business priorities, buying committees, budget ownership, and requirements for adoption.

  • Identify and prioritize the strongest commercial opportunities across tokenized assets, tokenized deposits, custody connectivity, institutional data, compliance, and cross-chain distribution.

  • Personally originate, advance, and close flagship customer deals, working alongside internal account owners to build executive alignment and navigate complex sales cycles.

  • Develop scalable pricing, packaging, services models, and partner economics that meet institutional needs and support a repeatable commercial offering.

  • Partner with Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Marketing, and Partnerships to align customer requirements with technical scope, commercial terms, and market positioning.

  • Turn early opportunities and customer wins into sales playbooks, qualification criteria, and enablement materials that equip the broader BCM Sales organization to scale adoption.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience across banking, capital markets, fintech, or digital asset infrastructure, with a strong track record in senior commercial roles.

  • Demonstrated success building a new commercial offering, go-to-market motion, or business line from initial market validation through early revenue and repeatable growth.

  • Deep understanding of institutional digital asset infrastructure, including tokenization, custody, stablecoins, interoperability, and compliance, and how these capabilities address institutional needs.

  • Proven ability to engage C-level stakeholders and personally close complex, multi-million-dollar deals with financial institutions.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to assess market demand, prioritize opportunities, and translate customer insight into compelling propositions and commercial models.

  • A hands-on, player-coach approach, combining direct ownership of strategic deals with the ability to establish processes and enable other sellers.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and bring structure to ambiguous opportunities, aligning technical and commercial stakeholders around clear priorities and execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An established senior network across regional banks, asset managers, custodians, financial market infrastructures, and digital asset firms.

  • Experience packaging platform technology with professional or advisory services and developing commercial models across a partner ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with regulated financial markets, institutional procurement, and the compliance and governance requirements involved in adopting new infrastructure.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The Falcon Complete Detection Engineering (FCDE) team builds and maintains the NG-SIEM detection ruleset that powers CrowdStrike's managed detection and response capability. The team develops high-fidelity detections driven by threat intelligence and real-world observations, including rapid response to zero-days and emerging threats, filling detection gaps across a broad range of third-party data sources where adversaries increasingly operate. FCDE also builds and refines AI-powered tooling to maximize the speed and fidelity of detection development at scale. Engineers collaborate across the full pipeline, from ingestion and parsing to response and automation, to improve triage efficiency and accelerate threat disruption.


What You’ll Do:


  • Perform threat research and threat hunting to identify emerging tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) to build detections using an intelligence driven approach
  • Develop, test, and deploy actionable high fidelity CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM detection rules to enable a world class Managed Detection and Response team
  • Conduct code reviews and testing to ensure rules meet our quality and performance expectations prior to deployment at scale
  • Leverage CI/CD best practices and principles to deploy detections as code
  • Contribute to and leverage an AI-powered detection engineering ecosystem, including LLM-assisted tooling and coding agents, to accelerate threat research, rule development, and detection workflow automation
  • Collaborate with SIEM architects to develop and define best practices for parsing data and normalizing data to a common event schema

  • Relevant industry certifications (i.e. GCFA, GCDA, GCIH, etc.)
  • Experience with analyzing large datasets across a variety of vendors and technologies
  • Experience working with SIEM solutions (LogScale, Splunk, SumoLogic, Sentinel, QRadar, LogRhythm, etc)
  • Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and AI coding agents, with hands-on experience integrating or building LLM-assisted workflows a plus
  • Python or other scripting experience strongly preferred
  • A curious, self-motivated mindset with a high standard for your own work

raw.description:
As AI Transformation Director, Marketing, you will set and drive marketing's AI adoption strategy and decide where AI can create the most value for marketing, then making sure those ideas become solutions people use. This is a strategy-and-delivery role: you'll prioritize where to invest, choose the right internal and external partners to build with, and stay close enough to execution to make sure what ships solves the problem and gets adopted. You'll operate within the firm's AI governance model and treat every deployment as a chance to make the next one faster and easier.

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with individual marketing teams to understand their workflows and pain points, scoping and prioritizing the highest-value AI use cases
  • Act as a de facto product manager: write requirements, design flows/process maps, and produce specs clear enough for internal teams and external vendors to build against
  • Guide initiatives through the full delivery cycle including intake, build, testing, and rollout, plus staying aligned with the firm's AI governance requirements throughout
  • Evaluate the external vendor/product landscape and own build/buy/partner recommendations and decisions within marketing's AI budget
  • Champion a test-and-learn approach, including piloting and experimenting before full launch, rather than going straight to scale
  • Turn what works into repeatable templates and a scaling approach for marketing — covering ownership, change management, and adoption — so each new initiative takes less time than the last
  • Own the AI roadmap for marketing, including budget planning, ongoing budget management, and governance reporting to leadership, supported by business cases and ROI models for major AI investments
  • Continuously track emerging AI capabilities and vendor developments to keep marketing's AI strategy ahead of the curve, rather than only reacting to current requests
  • Keep marketing's AI initiatives aligned with the AI Council's governance standards, and partner with marketing analytics to validate solutions before they scale
  • Spot and escalate data governance concerns — such as access permissions or conflicting data sources — in marketing's AI work before they become production problems

What You Will Need:

  • 10+ years of experience in digital, product, strategy, or workflow transformation roles within a complex technology or professional services organization, with a proven track record of redesigning how teams work and driving measurable business outcomes
  • Genuine, active engagement with AI tools and the vendor landscape — you track what's emerging and have a point of view on how it applies to marketing
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders, with the executive presence to translate ambiguous or complex problems into clear, credible recommendations
  • Comfortable building structure and a path forward in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, with strong judgment on risk and prioritization
  • Demonstrated experience translating AI capabilities into deployed, adopted solutions that measurably changed how a team or function operated
  • Comfort operating inside a structured governance model, balancing speed with enterprise-scale discipline

What you will gain:

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

Intapp provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and will make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please note: Intapp will not hire through text message, social media, or email alone. raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 2 or more years of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

At Valtech, we design, build and run large-scale global data, experience and commerce platforms together with our clients. These platforms connect services from many vendors and increasingly include AI-enabled components. Site Reliability Engineering is at the core of how we manage them. As an SRE, you act as the bridge between software development and operations. You help delivery teams ship stable software quickly, anticipate instability and improve the reliability of the systems we manage. You will join a team of SREs of various levels, act as an escalation point for associate SREs and be backed up by your senior colleagues. You will work with multidisciplinary delivery teams in a DevOps way of working that keeps everyone focused on what happens in production.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Maintain systems for observability
  • Adjust and maintain SLOs
  • Participate in and facilitate incident resolution, including on-call duty (maximum of one week-long shift per month)
  • Work on proactive improvements that increase the reliability of the managed platforms
  • Work with teams to assess anticipated or manifested failure scenarios and define possible mitigations
  • Help create runbooks to remediate or prevent failure scenarios
  • Reduce work that does not add value

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 2 or more years of experience as a DevOps Engineer, Support Engineer or Site Reliability Engineer
  • Knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering principles and experience working with SLOs
  • Experience resolving severe incidents on high-impact platforms
  • Scripting skills and experience automating moderately complex processes
  • Familiarity with automation systems such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Ansible or Chef
  • Upper-intermediate English level (at least B2), written and spoken

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience with React.js. We are seeing more full-stack opportunities and want to grow the team in that direction
  • Incident management experience on a production environment of a public-facing online service with high business value and high traffic, in a 24x7 setup
  • Experience with commerce platforms
  • Experience working in corporate environments
  • Experience with international, on-shore and off-shore teams
  • Basic knowledge of serverless services in one or more public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with monitoring and APM systems such as Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, Prometheus or Grafana
  • Experience with pipelining tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab or Jenkins
  • Familiarity with Docker
  • A solution mindset and a desire to help your colleagues

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

About Shakepay

Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise Value Engineer (Presales) to shape and win enterprise ERP automation decisions: you reframe problems, quantify the cost of inaction, and prove value through tailored workshops and demos. Partnering with an AE, you own technical leadership, value articulation, and de-risking security/integration, building alignment across CFO/CIO-led buying committees.

What you'll own

Insight-led discovery and deal shaping

  • Practice insight selling: challenge the customer's initial framing, introduce a sharper point of view on where value is actually trapped (exceptions, approvals, master data, controls), and reframe urgency using cost-of-inaction.

  • Lead discovery across CFO/CIO/Shared Services/Procurement to uncover operational bottlenecks and decision friction, and translate that into a crisp target-state narrative and mutual action plan.

Solution design and technical leadership

  • Architect a tailored solution: scope, rollout approach, integration pattern, security posture, and success criteria.

  • Run deep dives with IT/security and articulate how blp works in enterprise environments (ERP digital twin, data synchronization, governance and controls).

Demos, workshops, and executive storytelling

  • Deliver high-impact demos that map to customer workflows (P2P, AP, S2P) and prove outcomes, not features.

  • Facilitate workshops that turn stakeholder skepticism into a tangible blueprint and path to value.

Value engineering (business case support)

  • Build a credible value narrative: labor productivity gains, cycle time reduction, compliance/control improvements, and stack simplification.

  • Support champions and the AE with executive-ready business-case inputs, impact ranges, and rollout economics, flagging risk to the deal early rather than late.

Competitive positioning

  • Position blp against point tools and fragmented stacks (OCR/IDP/workflow/process mining/RPA) with an "end-to-end + exceptions-first" narrative.

  • Help the deal team land a clear "why now" anchored in operational risk, ERP program success, and enterprise scale requirements.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 3–8+ years in Value Engineering / Presales / Solution Consulting / ERP process consulting (or equivalent in finance/procurement operations with strong customer-facing chops).

  • Demonstrated ability to run insight-based discovery (Challenger-style): you can respectfully push back, quantify impact, and build conviction across a buying committee.

  • Comfort with senior stakeholders (CFO/CIO/Head of Shared Services): you can lead without authority.

  • Strong workshop facilitation and demo craft: story, structure, and objection handling.

  • Ability to connect technical realities to business outcomes (FTE capacity, cycle time, controls, compliance risk, TCO).

Strong plus

  • SAP exposure (S/4, ECC, Public/Private Cloud) or multi-ERP environments.

  • Finance/process knowledge: AP, invoice processing, S2P/P2P, exception handling, approvals, master data workflows.

  • Experience competing against legacy vendors and "patchwork stacks."

Language

  • Fluent in English and German (or another major European language depending on territory).

What you'll get

  • A product that wins. blp's solution consistently outperforms competitors. Your job is to open more doors.

  • Uncapped earnings. High, realistic OTEs with uncapped commission.

  • Real ownership. Choose annually to take your variable compensation in cash or company shares.

  • Growth and autonomy. Build your own success path in a rapidly scaling, internationally expanding company.

  • Continuous learning. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to help you excel.

  • Exceptional team. Join a group of ambitious, collaborative colleagues who push each other to achieve excellence.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a SAP S/4HANA Cutover Lead / Deployment & Go-Live Lead- Remote to join our team in Ottawa, Ontario (CA-ON), Canada (CA).

SAP S/4HANA Cutover Lead / Deployment & Go-Live Lead

Experience: 10+ years of overall IT/SAP experience
Role Type: Senior Lead
Start Date: ASAP

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Cutover Lead to lead the end-to-end planning, coordination, and execution of cutover activities for a complex SAP transformation program.

In this role, you will oversee the transition from legacy systems to SAP, ensuring all business and technology activities are properly planned, coordinated, and executed for a successful go-live. This includes developing the cutover strategy, managing detailed execution runbooks, leading cutover rehearsals, coordinating production deployment, overseeing command-center activities, and supporting post-go-live stabilization.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, data migration, integration, infrastructure, security, testing, reporting, change management, and third-party vendors to deliver a controlled and timely deployment while minimizing disruption to critical business operations.

The ideal candidate brings significant experience leading complex SAP deployments, with a strong understanding of SAP cutover planning, data migration, integrations, production readiness, go/no-go governance, and hypercare. Experience with SAP S/4HANA and large-scale, multi-site or multi-country implementations is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cutover Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and maintain the overall SAP cutover strategy, integrated cutover plan, detailed schedule, and execution runbook.
  • Translate deployment requirements into clearly defined cutover activities, including owners, timelines, dependencies, prerequisites, and completion criteria.
  • Establish entry and exit criteria, decision points, escalation paths, rollback procedures, and contingency plans.
  • Identify critical-path activities and ensure dependencies across business and technology workstreams are properly sequenced.
  • Maintain an integrated view of all activities required before, during, and immediately following SAP go-live.

2. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate cutover activities across the following areas:
    • SAP functional modules and workstreams
    • Business functions
    • Data migration and conversion
    • Interfaces and integrations
    • Infrastructure and environments
    • Security and user access
    • Reporting and analytics
    • Testing and validation
    • Batch jobs and scheduling
    • Third-party applications and vendors
    • Business readiness and operational support
  • Work closely with the IT Technical Lead, SAP functional and technical leads, business stakeholders, project managers, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability for every cutover activity.

3. Cutover Rehearsals & Readiness

  • Plan and lead cutover rehearsals, mock cutovers, dress rehearsals, and production-readiness exercises.
  • Facilitate cutover planning workshops and readiness-review meetings.
  • Document rehearsal results, identify gaps and bottlenecks, and incorporate lessons learned into subsequent cutover plans.
  • Validate that critical activities can be completed within the required production cutover window.
  • Lead readiness assessments and ensure outstanding issues are resolved or formally accepted before go-live.

4. Go-Live Governance

  • Establish and manage go/no-go criteria and governance checkpoints.
  • Facilitate go/no-go meetings with business and technology leadership.
  • Ensure critical risks, dependencies, defects, data issues, infrastructure readiness, and support requirements are understood before production deployment.
  • Maintain decision, action, risk, issue, and dependency logs.
  • Provide concise status reporting and promptly escalate blockers and critical risks.

5. Production Cutover Execution

  • Lead execution of the approved cutover plan during the production deployment window.
  • Coordinate technical and business teams through each stage of the cutover.
  • Track activities against the integrated cutover runbook in real time.
  • Manage deviations from the approved plan and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Facilitate command-center or war-room meetings during critical cutover periods.
  • Ensure decisions, exceptions, issues, and resolutions are accurately documented.

6. Data Migration & Technical Coordination

  • Coordinate data extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and business validation activities.
  • Ensure data migration activities are properly sequenced with SAP configuration, integrations, interfaces, and business processes.
  • Coordinate system access, security provisioning, interface transitions, batch schedules, and technical validation.
  • Ensure critical integrations and business processes are validated before and after go-live.
  • Work closely with technical teams to resolve cutover-related defects and dependencies.

7. Post-Go-Live Stabilization & Hypercare

  • Coordinate early-life support and hypercare activities following SAP go-live.
  • Ensure incidents, defects, outstanding cutover activities, and operational issues have clearly assigned owners and resolution timelines.
  • Monitor stabilization progress and escalate critical production issues.
  • Coordinate the transition from the project/cutover organization to application support and operational teams.
  • Ensure operational procedures, support coverage, documentation, and escalation processes are established.

8. Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct post-cutover reviews and document lessons learned.
  • Identify opportunities to improve cutover methodologies, governance, templates, controls, and execution practices.
  • Develop reusable cutover frameworks and best practices for future SAP releases and deployments.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of overall IT/SAP experience, with significant experience in enterprise application deployment, cutover, or go-live management.
  • 7+ years of proven experience as a Cutover Lead, Deployment Lead, Go-Live Lead, or in a similar role on complex SAP programs.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting SAP implementations, upgrades, migrations, or major releases.
  • Strong experience developing and managing detailed cutover plans, schedules, runbooks, dependency maps, and readiness checklists.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cutover rehearsals, production deployments, command centers, go/no-go meetings, and hypercare activities.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • SAP implementation lifecycle
    • Data migration and reconciliation
    • Enterprise integrations and interfaces
    • Testing and validation
    • Infrastructure and production environments
    • Security and access management
    • Change management
    • Production support and hypercare
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex activities across business teams, IT, implementation partners, and third-party vendors.
  • Strong RAID management, governance, and executive-status reporting capabilities.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions, manage escalations, and coordinate large teams under significant time pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA implementations or migrations.
  • Experience leading multiple mock cutovers or cutover rehearsals ahead of production deployment.
  • Experience with large-scale multi-site, multi-country, or global SAP deployments.
  • Experience coordinating SAP deployments involving multiple legacy applications and complex integration landscapes.
  • Experience working with geographically distributed business and technology teams.
  • Experience in highly regulated or complex enterprise environments is an advantage.

Key Skills & Competencies

SAP Cutover Management | SAP S/4HANA | Deployment Planning | Go-Live Management | Cutover Runbook | Cutover Rehearsals | Mock Cutover | Data Migration | Data Reconciliation | SAP Integrations | Production Readiness | Go/No-Go Governance | Command Center | Hypercare | RAID Management | Dependency Management | Business Readiness | Stakeholder Management | Production Support

About Sibros Technologies

Who We Are

Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.

Learn more at .

Our Mission

Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.

Follow us on

LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram

About the Role:

Job Title: Senior Manager (Software Solutions Architecture)

Location: Remote, India

Job Type: Full-Time

Experience: 10+ years, including 4+ years managing engineers

You will travel to prospective and existing OEM customers and design how their systems connect to the Sibros Deep Connected Platform: vehicle-to-cloud connectivity, data pipelines, OTA update programs, and the integration points into their own manufacturing and after-sales systems. You are the person the customer's engineering leadership talks to when they need to know how this will actually work in their environment.

From design to delivery, your team sits at every step of the customer engagement and owns what comes out of it: the Sibros platform running inside the customer's own cloud account, with Sibros keeping ownership and day-to-day management of the environment, plus the customer-specific solutions that let the platform interface with an OEM's manufacturing and after-sales processes. You design the solutions that bring our product platform and our customers' requirements together. As part of the Infrastructure department, you help keep that platform performing reliably and at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own the customer architecture. Act as the primary technical contact for OEM accounts and prospects. Travel on site to run architecture workshops, technical deep dives, and the executive conversations that follow them.
  • Design the integration. Architect how a customer's vehicle programs, cloud estate, and enterprise systems connect to the Deep Connected Platform, and make sure the design holds up against their security, compliance, and data residency requirements.
  • Support pre-sales. Lead proof-of-concept engagements, architecture reviews, and RFP responses, and carry them through to a design that can be deployed rather than one that only reads well.
  • Run the Customer Hosted team. Manage the engineers who deploy and operate the Sibros platform inside customer cloud accounts, where we keep ownership of the service without owning the account it runs in.
  • Deliver custom solutions. Direct the design and delivery of customer-specific work built within the platform, using AI-assisted development tooling to keep delivery fast without giving up quality.
  • Grow the team. Hire, coach, and set direction, and stay technical enough to be a genuine reference for your engineers rather than only their manager.
  • Work across Sibros. Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Customer Success to turn a customer's business objectives into something we can build and operate.

What You Should Know

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience. 10+ years across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, networking, and security.
  • People management. 4+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance responsibility.
  • Architecture. 5+ years designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud architectures, with production deployments behind you.
  • Hands-on infrastructure. Strong Kubernetes and Terraform. You should be able to review your team's work on a customer-hosted deployment and recognise when the answer is wrong.
  • Cloud. Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (AWS or GCP), and of deploying into an environment you do not control, under someone else's security and compliance rules.
  • Communication. Able to explain the same design to a customer's VP of Engineering and to the engineer who has to build it, and be understood by both.
  • Travel. Willing to travel internationally to customer sites on a regular basis.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Connected vehicle, SDV, or automotive telematics background.
  • Hands-on experience integrating cloud-native platforms with OEM enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP, after-sales).
  • Experience running software in a customer-controlled environment, where you own the service but not the account.
  • Familiarity with multi-region delivery across regions, and the requirements that differ between them.
  • Comfortable using LLM-based tooling in daily engineering work. Experience with Claude Code is a bonus.
  • Real-time and batch processing using technologies such as MQTT, Kafka, Kubernetes, time-series databases, and the analytics tooling on top of them, applied to connected vehicles or comparable IoT workloads.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
  • A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
  • Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
  • A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.

raw.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an M&A Intern to join manda, iwoca's M&A platform. This is a paid off-cycle internship of up to 6 months, for someone who wants to build a long-term career in fintech - Hybrid in London.

manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions. Over the last months we've built a proposition for buying and selling UK small businesses. Our first deals are done, and our pipeline is growing across both sell-side and buy-side. Most M&A firms shy away from the sub-£10m EV segment because information asymmetry, lack of knowledge, and low transaction sizes make it hard to serve profitably. iwoca has 150,000+ SME customers in the UK and a track record of building clean, automated processes, and manda is leveraging that to build an M&A platform that serves this market properly.

Your edge as an intern: you'll work on live sub-£10m transactions from week one, not pitch books for deals you'll never touch. You'll see the full deal lifecycle (origination, diligence, execution, close) inside a venture small enough that the work you do moves the business, and you'll have AI and automation as leverage rather than as a side project.

The team

You'll sit inside the manda Deal Team and work directly with the people running the platform: our sell-side and buy-side Transaction Managers, our Due Diligence Manager, and the Venture Lead. The team is small enough that you'll be in the room for real decisions on live deals, and the tooling we use (CRM, VDR, AI automated workflows) is being built in parallel by the same people you'll be working alongside.

The role

The internship is split into two phases to give you both breadth across the deal engine and depth on a project you own.

Phase 1: Core M&A Operations (first 2 months). You'll get to try out several of our live workstreams, and we'll decide your final placement based on deal flow, team priorities and where you add the most. You'll do real day-to-day work supporting the team where it matters most. Workstreams include:

  • Sell-side execution: supporting our sell-side Transaction Managers across the deal lifecycle. Qualifying inbound and outbound vendor leads, preparing materials, populating Virtual Data Rooms, and coordinating buyer Q&A.

  • Buy-side execution: supporting our buy-side Transaction Manager managing the live pipeline of searchers and acquirers. Qualifying buyer mandates, matching them to live sell-side opportunities, and helping move deals through to LOI.

  • Due diligence support: working with our DD Manager on company valuation and diligence for live sell-side mandates. Turning raw SME data into clear reports on business model, financial position, and fair valuation.

  • Origination: identifying SMEs likely to sell, running our "likely seller" models against iwoca's customer base, and converting matches into mandates.

  • Product, data & AI: turning manual workflows into automated ones, mapping the data schema for our "Digital IM", and building AI-enabled tooling that gives our Transaction Managers leverage. You'll work closely with the Venture Lead on this.

Phase 2: The project (months 3-6). Once you've built the foundation, you'll scope a project with the Venture Lead to solve a real problem or seize an opportunity you've identified during Phase 1. You'll spend the rest of the internship executing it end-to-end with full ownership and regular check-ins. Examples of the kind of project we'd back: a model that scores acquisition targets against a buyer's mandate, an AI workflow that drafts a first-pass IM from raw accounts, or a structured outbound channel into a new vendor segment.

Who you are

You're interested in M&A, FinTech, or building things from scratch, and you want to do all three at once. Most importantly, you're smart, motivated, humble, and have a growth mindset.

  • You are need-driven. You take whatever is in front of you and move it forward, whether that's fixing a broken spreadsheet, calling a vendor, or cleaning up CRM data. You don't wait to be told what's important.

  • You are financially literate. You can read a P&L and a balance sheet, spot what's odd, and ask the question that surfaces the real story behind the numbers.

  • You are tech-curious. You bring your own stack, you're already using AI tools to multiply your output, and you treat any manual workflow you see as a candidate for automation.

  • You are a clear communicator. M&A runs on trust. You write professional emails, you're not afraid to pick up the phone, and you can hold a conversation with a business owner about the company they spent 30 years building.

The requirements

  • Available for a full-time, off-cycle placement of up to 6 months.

  • Strong academic background, open to all disciplines.

  • Any experience, projects, or initiatives that show genuine M&A, FinTech, or entrepreneurial interest. We care more about evidence of initiative than a polished CV.

  • Bonus: experience working with SME data, financing, or M&A workflows.

The salary & conversion

This is a paid internship with annual compensation of £30k. If it goes well and there's a fit on both sides, we'd convert you into a permanent role on the manda team, with compensation re-benchmarked against the new position.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
raw.excerpt: Join the Tilt teamAt Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
raw.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform

ML is core to what Tilt does: our models make credit decisions for millions of customers across multiple markets, and they run on a platform shared by several business units. You’ll own the layer between data science and infrastructure. Half your time goes to running our managed feature store, and the other half to building the training and deployment platforms that let data scientists ship without an engineer in the loop.

The foundation is in place: a feature store, standard pipelines and an automated deployment framework. The team is now moving quickly into deep learning and streaming models. You’ll own the platform layer that sits between data science and infrastructure, and your measure of success is how much faster and more independently data scientists can move because you built it. You’ll thrive here if you go find the pain points yourself, turn them into platform work, and stay with each project until data scientists are actually using it.

Tilt is remote-first. We come together in person at least twice a year for company offsites — and those gatherings are worth the trip.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Run our managed feature store: build the patterns and tooling for defining, backfilling, and serving features so a new model can be trained from existing features and deployed.

  • Make the feature store the starting point for model training, not just deployment, so new models are trained on existing features instead of rebuilt pipelines.

  • Build and improve our automated training and deployment platforms. Our ML engineers own frameworks, not individual models.

  • Turn the steps data scientists repeat (registering features, launching training jobs, promoting a model, setting up monitoring) into self-service agents and skills they run themselves.

  • Standardize training and retraining so refits are schedulable, reproducible and backed by feature store data rather than one-off queries.

  • Scale batch scoring and low-latency online inference, with autoscaling, resource isolation and cost controls that hold up as the number of models grows.

  • Extend monitoring for data drift, feature drift, prediction quality and serving health, with alerts and dashboards data scientists use without escalating to engineering.

  • Define standards for model and feature versioning, lineage, testing and documentation, and lead their adoption across data science teams.

Why You’re a Great Fit

  • Deep hands-on experience as a platform or software engineer working in ML, with a track record of platforms that served many models in production across multiple teams.

  • Experience with feature stores and model deployment platforms, such as Databricks Feature Store, Feast, Tecton or equivalent. Time on a managed feature store is especially relevant.

  • Strong CI/CD for ML (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure Pipelines or similar), model registries, and infrastructure as code with Terraform.

  • Cloud expertise in AWS or Azure for ML deployment, plus Kubernetes, workflow orchestration, and a strong command of batch and real-time serving, autoscaling, and latency and cost trade-offs.

  • You’ve removed engineers from the deployment loop with self-service tooling that data scientists actually adopted, and you’ve worked side by side with backend engineers to get deployments live instead of handing models off.

  • You work well with ambiguity: you gather requirements from stakeholders without being directed, propose solutions and drive projects to completion.

  • Enough depth in model development and common algorithms to be a real technical partner to data scientists. Familiarity with PySpark, Databricks and monitoring tools such as Evidently AI is a plus.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you’re looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your experience.

  3. Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach.

  4. Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you’ll contribute to Tilt’s mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $220K - $265K

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the Role

We are looking for a People Operations Specialist - Regional to manage day-to-day HR operations for employees across multiple countries.

You will work across payroll, EOR and HR vendors, onboarding and offboarding, employee records, and local employment requirements. The role currently supports approximately 15-20 countries and will expand as BJAK grows into new markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage monthly payroll operations across multiple countries, including payroll inputs, changes, deductions, validation and reconciliation.

  • Coordinate with EOR, payroll and HR service providers to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Manage employee onboarding, contract changes, transfers and offboarding across different countries.

  • Maintain accurate employee records, employment documents and HR system data.

  • Manage day-to-day EOR and HR vendor operations, including employee cases, invoices, service issues and escalations.

  • Research employment requirements in new and existing markets, including payroll, statutory benefits, leave, termination and employment compliance.

  • Maintain country-specific HR documentation, processes and SOPs.

  • Identify payroll, employment or operational issues and work with internal teams and vendors to resolve them.

What You Will Need

  • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, payroll, people operations or a related role.

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple countries is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll, EOR providers or international HR vendors is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling payroll, employee data and employment documentation.

  • Ability to research local employment requirements and turn them into clear processes and documentation.

  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and experience working with HR systems.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Ability to manage multiple countries, vendors and deadlines at the same time.
