raw.title: Director of ERISA Compliance
raw.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

The Director of Retirement Compliance is a strategic, high-impact leadership role responsible for ensuring that Human Interest’s platform operates with regulatory precision under ERISA, DOL, and IRS guidelines. This leader will drive continuous innovation across compliance workflows, architecting root-cause feedback loops to resolve plan errors and delinquencies while driving the end-to-end compliance health of our plans at scale.

Operating at the intersection of regulatory governance, incident management, and product delivery, the Director will oversee high-level customer advocacy escalations in close partnership with Legal, steer feature rollout reviews, and build real-time monitoring infrastructure for SLAs and regulatory deadlines. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Sales Activation & Customer Success, this individual will proactively manage risk and financial exposure, own remediation solutions end-to-end, and actively coach and uplevel frontline compliance managers.

About the team

The Compliance team serves as the guardian of Human Interest’s regulatory integrity and fiduciary excellence. We sit at the nexus of regulatory compliance, customer success, onboarding, operations, and product engineering. Rather than acting as a traditional back-office audit function, our team acts as proactive problem solvers—designing scalable automation, building data pipelines, and establishing closed-loop operational workflows that safeguard plan sponsors and participants. As we continue to democratize access to retirement benefits, we're looking for a visionary leader who can scale our compliance operations through technology while maintaining our commitment to fiduciary excellence.

What you get to do every day

  • Lead and direct Human Interest's compliance program ensuring adherence to ERISA, DOL, and IRS regulations across all 401(k) plan operations
  • Modernize compliance workflows and build cross-functional feedback loops with Customer Onboarding, Customer Success, and Product to perform root-cause analysis on errors and delinquencies.
  • Develop and implement technology-driven compliance frameworks that scale with our growing client base while maintaining regulatory excellence
  • Own and drive scalable, technology-enabled initiatives with Product to improve platform-wide plan compliance health.
  • Design and oversee automated compliance monitoring systems to proactively identify and address potential issues
  • Build and manage operational dashboards to continuously track team SLAs, operational metrics, and statutory regulatory deadlines.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Operations, and Technology teams to review platform feature rollout plans, system copy, and marketing collateral to guarantee strict alignment with ERISA and DOL standards.
  • Lead Customer Advocacy and incident management for high-level escalations in close partnership with Legal to resolve plan errors and mitigate exposure.
  • Oversee fiduciary governance processes and ensure proper documentation of fiduciary decisions
  • Lead compliance technology initiatives including plan document automation, testing workflows, and regulatory reporting systems
  • Manage relationships with external auditors, regulatory bodies, and compliance consultants
  • Drive continuous improvement of compliance processes through automation and process optimization
  • Advise executive leadership on compliance risks and operational failures, proposing and owning strategic remediation solutions end-to-end.as primary point of contact for regulatory inquiries and examinations
  • Develop and maintain compliance policies, procedures, and training programs
  • Lead crisis management protocols for compliance-related issues requiring immediate attention
  • Coach, mentor, and uplevel frontline compliance managers to build operational excellence and scale team leadership.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you bring to the role

  • 10+ years of experience in ERISA compliance, with at least 5 years in leadership roles within retirement plan administration
  • Current ERISA-related professional certifications (QKA, QPA, RPF, or equivalent)
  • Proven track record of leveraging technology to drive compliance efficiency and scalability
  • Experience with 401(k) plan administration, including nondiscrimination testing, plan document maintenance, and fiduciary oversight
  • Strong ability to develop compliance frameworks and processes that drive measurable results
  • Experience implementing compliance technology solutions and automated testing systems
  • Exceptional communication skills with ability to translate complex regulatory requirements for diverse stakeholders
  • Data-driven approach to compliance management and risk assessment

Nice to have

  • Advanced ERISA certifications (CEBS, CPC,)
  • Juris Doctor (JD) with an emphasis on ERISA, employee benefits, or administrative law
  • Experience within a high-growth fintech, modern TPA, or SaaS retirement platform.
  • Track record of implementing compliance automation in high-growth environments
  • Experience scaling compliance functions from startup to enterprise stage
  • Background in regulatory technology (RegTech) or compliance software implementation
  • Proven ability to influence regulatory strategy based on industry trends and regulatory changes
  • Experience managing both remote and in-office compliance teams
  • Knowledge of emerging compliance technologies including AI and machine learning applications
  • Practical familiarity with workflow automation tools (e.g., Jira, Gemini) and dashboarding software (e.g., Salesforce, Hex).
  • Deep background navigating voluntary correction programs (IRS EPCRS and DOL VFCP/DFVCP).

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $150,000 - $180,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

Human Interest is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws. Employment with Human Interest is at-will, meaning either you or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, except as otherwise provided by law or written agreement.

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. We deliver the lightest structures possible for aerospace, automotive, defense, and space, at a rate and cost efficiency that far exceeds existing composite production processes.

We build and operate automated factories for composite materials, delivering components to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs. The business has three main divisions: development of automated production machines, development of software design and production tools, and operation of the factory. We work with 25+ customers and completed the largest ever Series A in composites manufacturing to fuel a significant scale-up, with growth plans that will see the business multiply in size over the next two to three years and expand operations into the UK, Europe and the US.

The business has currently more than 130,000 sqm of production capacity with manufacturing facilities in the UK (Gloucester and Swindon) and the US (Dayton, Ohio); a Hardware R&D Centre in Bristol, UK; and a Software R&D Centre in Athens, Greece.

The Technical Business Development Manager will lead U.S. growth for ICOMAT’s advanced composite manufacturing technologies, specifically Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) and next‑generation automated fiber placement solutions. This role blends engineering fluency with strategic business development, supporting capture efforts across aerospace, defense, and space markets. You will serve as the technical‑commercial interface between U.S. customers and ICOMAT’s engineering, operations, and leadership teams in both the United States and the United Kingdom.

Business Development & Capture

What do we need from you?

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in aerospace/defense business development, technical sales, program management, or advanced composites engineering.

  • Strong understanding of composite structures, automated fiber placement, or advanced manufacturing technologies.

  • Experience with DoD or NASA programs, procurement processes, and industry standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in engineering or business.

  • Prior work with major aerospace OEMs, primes, or Tier‑1 suppliers.

  • Familiarity with structural analysis, laminate design, or composite process qualification.

Key Competencies:

  • Technical fluency and ability to communicate complex engineering concepts clearly.

  • Strategic thinking and opportunity shaping.

  • Customer relationship management.

  • Proposal development and capture leadership.

  • Cross‑functional collaboration across global teams.

  • High integrity, professionalism, and compliance awareness.

Our Values: Uncompromising Excellence

  • Discipline over excuses. We commit. We follow through. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standard, especially when the pressure is on.

  • Push the edge. iCOMAT was built on a refusal to accept that curved fiber could not be manufactured at scale. We innovate where others hesitate.

  • Aligned and accountable. Everyone owns their lane, communicates openly, and delivers without being chased. No silos. No ambiguity.

Why iCOMAT?

  • Competitive Salary & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including private healthcare, pension scheme.

  • Stock Options: Equity options to give employees a stake in the company’s success

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Join us at a pivotal time as we scale up, offering unmatched professional growth opportunities in the rapidly advancing field of composite materials.

  • Innovation-Focused Culture: We pride ourselves on our inclusive, forward-thinking work environment. Recognized by Bloomberg as a "UK Startup to Watch," iCOMAT celebrates diversity and encourages all applicants, regardless of background, to apply.

Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, technical analysts dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike virtual security operations center offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of experiences, detecting and responding to incidents as they occur in real-time for our customers.

This role is open to candidates located in either PST or MST timezones.

Successful candidates will have training or knowledge in one or more of the following areas:

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a passion for solving complex technical problems.
  • Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.

This is a full-cycle sales role with a strong emphasis on new business development. You’ll be responsible for identifying and engaging prospective customers, creating qualified pipeline, managing technical and commercial evaluations, and closing new business.

You’ll work with organisations making important decisions about their video call infrastructure, helping them evaluate the technical, operational and commercial benefits of partnering with Whereby.

We’re a lean, collaborative team, so this is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of your territory, influence how we approach the market, and contribute directly to our growth strategy.

Whereby’s vision and mission

Our Vision: A world in which anywhere works

Our Mission: Empower telehealth and other businesses to connect seamlessly through video calling, enabling them to unlock their full potential.

📍 Our global HQ is in Norway, but our users (and team) are worldwide. Whereby has been used in nearly every country in the world by millions of people. 🌏

To succeed in this role, you will need to be a highly skilled communicator, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and collaborate remotely with our global team.

Benefits include unlimited holiday, flexible, hybrid working setup, home office budget, enhanced parental leave, equity, and more.

Sales team mission

Whereby is loved by millions of users worldwide, and our Sales team plays a key role in expanding our customer base and driving revenue growth. Focused on the Telehealth and Digital Mental Health industries, we’re on a mission to facilitate healthcare consultations globally through enterprise customers in the sector.

As an Account Executive, you’ll play a critical role in executing the team’s mission by finding, developing and closing new business opportunities. Leads will come to you from a mix of sources, and you’ll also be expected to go out and create your own. You will work closely with the Commercial, Marketing and ProdEng teams to meet and exceed sales targets.

What we’re looking for in our Account Executive

We’re looking for someone with proven experience in B2B sales who is driven to contribute to the growth of an innovative tech company. You don’t wait for deals to land on your desk: you enjoy hunting for opportunities as much as closing them. You will be comfortable working in a hybrid and distributed team environment, have a customer-centric approach, and excel at building strong relationships with decision-makers.

Your attributes

You’ll likely be a great fit if you:

  • Are goal-driven and results-oriented
  • Are self-starting and proactive about building your own pipeline
  • Thrive in a consultative sales environment
  • Are an effective communicator and skilled at negotiations
  • Are highly organised with excellent time management skills
  • Are adaptable and can prioritise effectively, balancing prospecting with progressing live deals
  • Enjoy working in a collaborative team across multiple departments

Your previous experience

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Has 3+ years of experience in a B2B Account Executive or similar role, preferably in SaaS or the healthcare technology sector
  • Has a track record of successfully closing deals with medium to large enterprises
  • Has a proven ability to generate their own pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking and events
  • Is experienced in selling complex technical solutions, including APIs, to healthcare providers or platforms
  • Is comfortable leading negotiations and handling complex sales cycles
  • Is experienced working with CRM and prospecting tools (e.g. Salesforce, Lemlist, etc.)

Particularly valuable experience

  • Selling APIs, developer tools, communications infrastructure or other technical SaaS solutions
  • Working with digital health, telehealth or healthcare technology platforms
  • Supporting customers through technical evaluations, PoCs or platform migrations
  • Experience with account-based outbound strategies and modern prospecting tools

You don’t need to have worked in video communications before. What matters most is your ability to understand a technical product, identify meaningful business problems and create opportunities through thoughtful, targeted selling.

🌎 We believe in everyone

We fundamentally believe talent is distributed to all of us in equal measure. We open our doors (physical or URL) to everyone and we see our differences as a strength; it’s this philosophy that drives us towards our mission.

This means we see your unique history as having value money cannot buy; we believe in the strength of every intersection of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, different physical ability, family structure, socio-economics, age, nationality, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity.

What you’ll be doing

Build and own your pipeline

  • Proactively identify and engage digital health, telehealth and other relevant platform businesses.
  • Develop targeted outbound strategies to reach decision-makers across Product, Engineering and commercial leadership.
  • Research prospective customers to understand their current video call infrastructure, business priorities and potential reasons to consider switching providers.
  • Generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, your network, partners and industry events, alongside managing relevant inbound enquiries.
  • Build account plans and execute multi-stakeholder outreach strategies.

Manage the full sales cycle

  • Lead discovery conversations to understand customers’ business challenges, technical requirements, buying processes and timelines.
  • Communicate the value of Whereby Embedded through tailored demonstrations and consultative discussions.
  • Coordinate technical evaluations and proof-of-concept projects with customers and internal engineering teams.
  • Develop compelling business cases and commercial proposals.
  • Navigate procurement, negotiations and stakeholder alignment to close new business.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline records in our CRM and provide reliable forecasts.

Help shape our commercial approach

  • Work closely with Marketing, Product and Engineering to improve how we position and sell Whereby Embedded.
  • Share insights from customer conversations to help inform product priorities and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Contribute to improving our outbound messaging, qualification processes and sales playbook.
  • Take ownership of your results and continuously improve your approach based on performance and customer feedback.

Your progression

This is a senior-level role, with ample opportunity for career progression based on performance. You will have the opportunity to lead key accounts, help shape how we build pipeline in the UK and beyond, and contribute to the long-term growth strategy of Whereby.

raw.description:
Symmetrio is recruiting a Senior Firewall Engineer to join the network security team of one of our large government customers. The Senior Firewall Engineer will support a primarily Juniper SRX edge / core firewall infrastructure that supports mission critical applications and operations

This is a hands-on, day-to-day operations role. You will be the person who configures the rules, builds and fixes the VPNs, and tracks down the problem when something stops working. You will work closely with the our customer’s network engineers, security staff, and agency IT teams. You should be self-directed, comfortable owning issues from start to finish, and able to explain technical problems clearly to people outside networking.

This is a remote position. Candidates must be comfortable working EST hours. Competitive compensation, health benefits and 401k retirement plan.

This is a full-time, W2 consultant role with Symmetrio. No C2C or third-party candidates.

Responsibilities

  • Administer, configure, and maintain Juniper SRX firewalls, including edge and core devices, in a large multi-tenant enterprise environment.
  • Create, modify, and review firewall rules and security policies in response to agency and project requests.
  • Build, manage, and troubleshoot IPsec site-to-site and remote access VPNs (IKE/IKEv2).
  • Diagnose and resolve connectivity and traffic-flow issues using CLI tools, session and flow analysis, logs, and packet-level troubleshooting.
  • Perform planned changes, upgrades, and maintenance, with clear documentation and rollback plans.
  • Respond to escalated and critical incidents affecting network availability or security.
  • Work directly with agency IT teams and system owners to understand their requirements and implement secure, supportable rules.
  • Coordinate with network engineering and cybersecurity teams so policy, architecture, and incident response stay aligned.
  • Schedule changes around the operational needs of public safety and other critical services, and communicate impact to stakeholders in plain language.
  • Document configurations, standards, and procedures so knowledge is shared across the team.
  • Support Palo Alto firewalls as the City expands its use of that platform (training provided as needed).

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Juniper SRX firewalls specifically (not only Juniper switches and routers) on Junos OS.
  • Strong CLI skills, including building policies, zones, NAT, and VPNs from the command line, not just from a GUI.
  • Proven IPsec/IKE/IKEv2 VPN troubleshooting experience.
  • Solid understanding of routing, switching, and enterprise network fundamentals.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise or multi-customer environments.
  • Ability to work independently, with strong written and verbal communication.
  • Willingness to complete a hands-on technical lab as part of the interview process.
  • Ability to pass a background check.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Palo Alto firewalls (customer is expanding its Palo Alto footprint).
  • Experience with Juniper Security Director, Junos Space, or other centralized management platforms.
  • Experience with high-end SRX platforms (such as the SRX4000/5000 series) in edge or data center deployments.
  • Experience in government, municipal, or public safety environments.
  • Juniper certifications (JNCIS-SEC, JNCIP-SEC, or higher)

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)

Take Charge of Your Career at Interstates

At Interstates, we don’t just show up to work, we show up for each other. From our headquarters in Iowa to job sites across the country, we’re doing award-winning electrical, controls, automation, and OT work that powers industrial facilities for clients here in the U.S. and around the world. Whether you’re bending conduit, wiring panels, writing code, supporting projects, or helping things run behind the scenes, you’ll be part of a crew that works hard, shares laughs, and takes pride in doing quality work. We believe in building strong teams, doing the right thing, and making a difference in the communities where we live. If you want to grow and do meaningful work, you’ll feel at home here.

As the BIM Coordinator at Interstates, you will play a crucial role in integrating Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes and technologies into our projects. You will be responsible for coordinating BIM activities, facilitating collaboration among project stakeholders, and ensuring the accurate representation of electrical systems within the digital model. Your expertise will contribute to the successful design, construction, and maintenance of electrical systems in a 3D digital environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Create and maintain 3D BIM models using software such as Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD MEP, or similar tools under appropriate supervision.
  • Manipulate existing 3D BIM model families for updates and improvements.
  • Process incoming models and load them into new or existing Revit projects with supervision.
  • Ensure model health, proper storage, and user access by proactively scanning for bugs, responding to user issues, and following agreed upon standards.
  • Collaborate with Project teams and clients to properly coordinate BIM models by sending and receiving updates, resolving conflicts, and addressing coordination issues with supervision.
  • Participate in clash detection analysis to identify and resolve clashes between different building systems, minimizing conflicts before construction.
  • Generate and distribute BIM-related reports and outputs. This can include Navisworks files for viewing, clash detection reports, progress reports, and coordination status updates.

Secondary Responsibilities:

  • Stay informed about emerging BIM technologies and trends, evaluating new tools and workflows for potential adoption within the organization.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience: Associates in electrical construction, Design, Architecture, or related field (or equivalent experience) 2+ years of experience in BIM coordination or related roles within the construction industry. Proficiency in BIM software such as Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, or Bentley Systems applications.

Travel Requirements: Travel will be required and will vary according to business requirements. Generally, travel should not exceed 15% of your time.

Compensation: The pay range for this position is $61,800 to $78,000+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by the experience and education required, and level of responsibility. The range posted for this role represents a range that Interstates, in good faith, believes it is willing to pay at the time of this posting. The pay is determined by job related skills, training, education, and experience.

Application Deadline: December 31, 2026
In alignment with Colorado state regulations, we encourage interested candidates to submit their applications by December 31, 2026. This will ensure your application is considered in the initial review process. Applications received after this date may be considered depending on the status of the search.

Interstates Describes Its Culture as:

  • Family-Like: Caring co-workers treat each other like family.
  • Be treated like an individual, not just a number.
  • Flexible schedules allow you to focus on your personal life as well as work life.
  • Lunch gatherings and social activities promote fun and camaraderie.
  • Support charities and your community through events sponsored and hosted by Interstates.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Pay so you know you are valued.
  • 401(k) to help you plan for your future.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance with different options to meet your needs.
  • Vacation so you can focus on you.
  • Performance Bonus just in time for holiday shopping
  • Established Career Paths to help plan your future.
  • Career Coaches that are focused on your success.

What You Should Know Before You Apply

Interstates may collect personal information as part of your job application, such as your contact details, work history, education, and any information you provide. This information is used only for recruitment, to evaluate your candidacy, and to meet legal requirements. For details about our privacy practices and your rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), please see our Privacy Policy. By applying, you acknowledge that you have reviewed this notice.

Interstates is an EEO provider and offers a drug-free workplace. Employment at Interstates is at-will and may be terminated at any time with or without notice or cause, except as otherwise provided by law.

Remote, US

raw.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role

The successful candidate will own Keyloop's relationships with financiers, both captive (OEM-owned) and independent, while maximising client adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub through a customer retention lens and growing the use of Keyloop's AI-based capabilities within the Retention space. The role is UK-based with a global account book and regular international travel, reporting directly into the Financiers & Fleet Director. The candidate will understand the commercial dynamics of automotive finance and be equally comfortable operating at operational and senior commercial/strategic levels within each financier.

Key Headlines

  • First point of contact for existing and new financier accounts, spanning captive and independent financiers.
  • Own the senior relationship with financiers and grow the Keyloop Retention Hub agenda across their organisations and, where relevant, their dealer networks.
  • Drive adoption of the Keyloop Retention Hub with a specific focus on customer retention outcomes.
  • Lead cross-sell of AI-based capabilities within the Retention space (such as AI video and lead nurture), and identify new client opportunities across the wider Keyloop portfolio.
  • UK-based role with regular international travel; account book is global.
  • Monthly face-to-face team meetings in the UK.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Deliver excellent account management across captive and independent financier stakeholders.
  • Maintain weekly dialogue with clients on Keyloop Retention Hub adoption and customer retention outcomes.
  • Build and maintain multi-level relationships within financier organisations (commercial, risk, retention/customer, operations and IT), from operational teams through to senior leadership.
  • Develop and apply a thorough understanding of financier commercial models, the customer ownership lifecycle (including PCP/PCH and trade cycle management) and retention dynamics, and how these intersect with dealer network operations.
  • Support contract renewals and commercial negotiations alongside Legal and the Enterprise Team, including liaison with financier procurement and legal teams.
  • Position the Keyloop Retention Hub and its AI-based capabilities as drivers of customer retention and commercial value in client conversations.
  • Produce Quarterly Review Packs covering retention outcomes, adoption of the Retention Hub and AI-based capabilities, and system development delivered.
  • Collaborate with key financier contacts to understand their short, medium and long-term retention strategies, ensuring Keyloop is the partner of choice.
  • Keep product/sales presentation material and POS assets current and available on shared portals.
  • Feed back market intelligence on competitor retention and AI-based offerings to sharpen internal positioning.

Skillset and Experience required

  • Experience within the automotive sector, ideally within automotive finance (captive or independent financier).
  • Direct experience working with captive or independent financiers — understanding of their commercial models, customer lifecycle and retention priorities, and relationships with dealer networks. Financier-side experience is strongly favourable.
  • Thorough understanding of the automotive finance customer lifecycle, including origination, contract management, end-of-contract customer journey, and retention and trade cycle management.
  • Experience selling SaaS/cloud-based solutions.
  • Proven track record in account management, ideally managing senior corporate stakeholders within financiers.
  • User or provider experience with customer retention solutions, ideally within automotive finance.
  • Customer- and outcomes-focused, with the maturity and diplomacy to manage engagement across financier stakeholder levels — from operational through to senior commercial/strategic.
  • Able to implement a professional, structured sales approach using MEDDPIC (Keyloop's preferred sales methodology) — covering Metrics, Economic Buyer, Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Paper Process, Identify Pain and Champion — alongside use of Salesforce.
  • Self-driven, ambitious, resilient, highly motivated, competitive, resourceful, excellent communication skills, especially around listening, questioning – politely assertive.
  • Fluency in English is required, and proficiency in another European language — such as French, Spanish, Italian, or German — is preferred.
  • Highly organised within a process-oriented environment. Computer literate and familiarity with SF.com an advantage.
  • Fluency with AI tools such as Claude and Copilot is a plus but not mandatory.

Why join us?

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

An inclusive environment to thrive

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

Be rewarded for your efforts

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

raw.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

Parachute Health is building the definitive platform for ordering home medical equipment and supplies, helping clinicians and suppliers ensure that millions of patients each year receive the critical equipment and supplies they need. Our Merchandising Operations team (AKA “Merch”) comprises Category Managers and Category Analysts who have three primary jobs: 1) build and maintain our catalog, 2) build and maintain our coverage criteria rules engine, and 3) partner with R&D to improve the tools and workflows behind both. Merch sits at the intersection of e-commerce, compliance, operations, and R&D, and its work is central to Parachute's core functionality. Clinicians use our catalog to find and order the right equipment for their patients, and suppliers rely on it to fulfill those orders. Our coverage criteria help users determine whether an item should be covered by the patient's insurance.

The Merch team's work is nuanced and detail-dense: we maintain information on tens of thousands of products so our software, and the people who use it, can rely on it. The 18-person team splits its time between project work, like building and redesigning product categories and turning payer rules into qualification questions, and ticket-based work, resolving complex requests escalated by our support and partner teams. Our work requires efficient operational processes and excellent documentation.

As Director of Merchandising Operations, you will own the team's operating framework: how work is planned, prioritized, and delivered, and how the team partners with other teams across Parachute. You'll coach and develop a mix of managers and individual contributors, lead the team's largest cross-functional projects, and serve as a close thought partner to the SVP of Merchandising.

The role is primarily internal (roughly 90%), with occasional customer communication, especially on escalations, that calls for a steady, polished hand.

What You'll Do

  • Be the operational leader for a highly motivated, highly capable team of managers and individual contributors: keep work running smoothly, protect morale, and learn and add to a team culture that is already strong.
  • Drive key projects: stay close to the work and personally drive the team's largest, most complex projects, including timelines, dependencies, and cross-team communication.
  • Know every team process end to end. Lead the creation, maintenance, and centralization of SOPs and shared resources; drive consistent practices, training, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across category teams.
  • Collaborate with partner teams (e.g., Supplier Implementation, Product, Customer Success) so handoffs and shared processes run smoothly.
  • Be a Merch advocate: make the team's work understandable and visible across the company.
  • Run bandwidth and capacity planning; flag risks early and rebalance coverage.
  • Define and report on team metrics (ticket throughput, SLAs, SKU work, rollout milestones).
  • Own escalations as needed, partnering effectively with people at all levels across the organization.
  • Support recruiting as needed, own onboarding for new merchants, and maintain continuity coverage for every category.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in operations, program delivery, or management or technology consulting (e.g., a Big Four or top-tier firm), with 3+ years managing and growing managers.
  • Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects using a clear, repeatable methodology.
  • Data-driven: comfortable with capacity models, dashboards and prioritization trade-offs.
  • Willingness to travel roughly once a quarter.

More About You

  • Passionate about improving patient outcomes in the healthcare space.
  • Gets things done: drives work to completion and builds processes that stick.
  • Thrives in complex, nuanced domains; quickly learns intricate systems (e.g., insurance coverage rules, product data) well enough to make sound calls.
  • Clear, concise communicator who pushes back constructively and drives decisions.
  • Sound compliance judgment: in a highly regulated industry, you know which issues to resolve and which to escalate.
  • Track record of growing into increasing scope and responsibility.
  • Nice to have: catalog, product data or e-commerce experience; healthcare, DME/HME or payer experience.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
  • Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
  • Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
  • Flexible Vacation Policy
  • Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
  • Home Office and Wellness Stipend
  • Monthly Internet Stipend
  • Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Base Salary Range (based on level and experience)

$145,000-$180,000

This role is not eligible for employer visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and for the duration of employment. The Company does not sponsor employment authorization for this position.

raw.title: Network Architect
raw.excerpt: About RunwareRunware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end.
raw.description:
About Runware

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end. One API gives developers access to image, video, audio, 3D and language models, and our Sonic Inference Engine runs them on hardware we designed ourselves: custom servers, custom boards and a closed-loop, water-free cooling system, packed into Sonic Inference Pods — roughly 1 MW of liquid-cooled GPU compute in a 20-foot container that can be sited wherever power is cheap and available.

This is why infrastructure at Runware is the product, not a cost center. Our edge is that we run inference 30–90% cheaper per GPU-hour than our peers, and that edge is earned in the data center: in how fast we can stand up a new site, how tightly we run our fleet, and how little downtime our customers ever see. More than 20 billion requests have run through the platform for over a million developers, with customers such as Wix, Quora, Freepik and Higgsfield building production applications on top of it.

We raised a $50M Series A led by Dawn Capital, with Comcast Ventures, Speedinvest, Insight Partners and a16z speedrun participating, and we are now building out a global network of pods across the US and Europe. We need someone to own how that network is operated.

The Role

As Network Architect, you'll own the design, build, and operation of the network that moves every inference request through Runware: the GPU cluster fabric inside our data centers, the backbone and edge that deliver results to customers, and the cloud and hybrid connectivity that ties partner capacity into one platform. Runware's product is latency. The network is where a large share of that latency, and of our cost per request, is decided, and today there is no single owner for it. You'll be that owner.

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role with significant authority and no direct reports to start. You'll report to Risto Haukioja, Head of AI Infrastructure. You'll set the network strategy, design and build the systems yourself, define how they are operated and capacity-planned, and lead through design authority across Infrastructure, Platform, and ML Engineering. You've run high-performance teams before, and you'll shape the standards and hiring plan for network engineering as the footprint grows. We expect you to use AI tooling as a core part of how you work, so that one architect can produce what a small team used to.

What you'll do

  • Own the network architecture end to end. Define the target architecture and multi-year roadmap for Runware's data center fabric, backbone and edge, and cloud and hybrid connectivity, and make the design decisions that trade off latency, throughput, cost, and resilience.
  • Design and build the GPU cluster fabric. Architect spine-leaf fabrics for multi-node inference and training: 400G/800G Ethernet, RoCEv2 and InfiniBand, lossless transport, congestion control, and topology choices that keep east-west traffic from becoming the bottleneck.
  • Deliver inference to customers fast and reliably. Own the backbone and edge: multi-region interconnect, transit and peering strategy, anycast and traffic steering, DDoS and edge security posture, and the path that gets every response to the customer with as few milliseconds as possible.
  • Connect cloud, bare metal, and partner capacity into one platform. Design VPC, VPN, and private interconnect across hyperscalers, bare-metal providers, and colocation sites so new capacity can be brought online quickly and operated consistently.
  • Build network operations, not just networks. Define how the network is monitored, changed, and repaired: telemetry and observability, change management, incident runbooks, and on-call practices that hold up at scale. Stand up what doesn't exist yet.
  • Run capacity planning. Build the models that forecast bandwidth, port, and interconnect needs from product growth, and turn them into procurement and build plans with lead times that match the business, not the other way round.
  • Automate the network. Treat network configuration as code: IaC, intent-based provisioning, automated validation and rollback, and telemetry-driven remediation, so the network can grow without a proportional growth in people.
  • Accelerate your own output with AI. Use AI tools throughout your work (design exploration, configuration generation, log and telemetry analysis, documentation, automation code) and set the standard for how the wider infrastructure team does the same.
  • Lead through design authority. Set network standards, review designs across Infrastructure, Platform, and ML Engineering, mentor engineers, and define the hiring plan and operating model for network engineering as the footprint grows.
  • Own vendor and carrier relationships. Evaluate and select hardware, optics, carriers, and interconnect partners, and negotiate for performance and cost.

Requirements

  • 15+ years in network engineering and architecture, including at least 5 years as the design authority for large-scale production networks at a cloud provider, hyperscaler, CDN, HPC/AI infrastructure company, or carrier.
  • Hands-on. You still design, configure, and troubleshoot networks yourself, and you've built data center, backbone, and cloud networks from the ground up, not just inherited them.
  • Deep, current expertise in modern data center networking: spine-leaf Clos fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, BGP at scale, 400G/800G Ethernet, RoCEv2 and lossless Ethernet (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), and InfiniBand for GPU clusters.
  • Strong backbone and edge experience: multi-region interconnect, transit and peering, anycast, traffic engineering, and DDoS mitigation, with a track record of measurably reducing customer-facing latency.
  • Cloud and hybrid networking across at least two hyperscalers plus bare-metal or colocation environments: VPC design, private interconnect (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, Cloud Interconnect or equivalent), and VPN at scale.
  • Experience designing and running network operations: observability, change management, incident response, and on-call, with the judgement to know what to build first when starting from little.
  • Proven capacity planning: you've built forecasting models that turned product growth into bandwidth, port, and interconnect plans, and you've run the procurement cycles that followed.
  • Network automation as a working practice, not an aspiration: Python or Go, IaC for network config, CI-style validation, and streaming telemetry.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own output. You can show how AI tooling is part of how you design, write configuration and automation code, analyse telemetry, and document, and you expect it to multiply what you ship.
  • Experience leading high-performance engineering teams: you've hired, set standards, and run teams that delivered under pressure, and you lead well through influence when you have no direct reports.
  • Strong ownership and comfort in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where you identify the problems, create clarity, and drive the work to done.
  • Based in, or with full working overlap with, US Pacific time.

Strong Differentiators

  • Experience networking large GPU clusters for AI inference or training (NVIDIA Spectrum-X, Quantum InfiniBand, NCCL tuning, GPUDirect RDMA), and an opinion on Ethernet versus InfiniBand backed by production numbers.
  • Hands-on with modern network operating systems and disaggregated hardware: SONiC, Cumulus, Arista EOS, Junos, or NVIDIA Cumulus/Spectrum platforms.
  • Experience with Ultra Ethernet, 800G and 1.6T optics, co-packaged optics, or other emerging fabric technologies.
  • Experience running peering and transit for a latency-sensitive product, including ASN management, route optimisation, and IXP presence.
  • Experience with eBPF, DPDK, SmartNICs/DPUs, or kernel-bypass networking on the host side.
  • Prior work at a startup or scale-up where you built the network function from zero.
  • Public contributions: RFCs, open-source network tooling, conference talks, or published post-mortems.

Benefits

We're a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they're followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready and stronger than ever for the next leap.

  • Generous paid time off: vacation, sick days, public holidays

raw.description:
HubSpot Philosophy and Product

We believe the world has changed. We see businesses using more kinds of software, not less, that all needs to work together. To help our customers grow better in this environment, HubSpot is evolving from an “all-in-one” suite into an “all-on-one” platform.

HubSpot is a set of tools that supports a companies customer facing teams including Marketing, Sales and Service helping them to optimize each stage of the buyer’s journey and grow their business.

HubSpot’s flywheel philosophy uses the momentum of happy customers to drive referrals and repeat sales for our customers. We’ve also invested in an integrations ecosystem that helps customers do more with HubSpot and creates real value for people who adopt our suite of software.

We are actively hiring for a Corporate Account Executive; candidates are eligible to be office, flex or remotely located in the Republic of Ireland based on individual preference! Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

Your Role at HubSpot

As a Lead Account Executive at HubSpot you will be engaging directly with medium to corporate sized businesses, helping them to grow. You will use proactive and inbound selling strategies to find and close new business, and increase the customer's usage of the HubSpot platform over time. You will use your knowledge of digital transformation and change management to act as a trusted advisor and business consultant to the customer, running the sales process end to end with them

What are the responsibilities of a Corporate UKI Account Executive?

  • Develop and be responsible for your own annual, quarterly and monthly territory business plan
  • Find new prospects from both inbound and self-sourced leads
  • Run qualification calls with C- level executives and department leaders
  • Close both new business and install base at or above quota on a monthly cadence
  • Sell through internal champions to multiple stakeholders, as well as directly to C -level
  • Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced
  • Run online and occasionally in person product demonstrations
  • Answer Legal, Security and Procurement questionnaires and RFP
  • Sell the full growth platform, heavily weighted towards the Enterprise license
  • Liaise with internal HubSpot stakeholders such as Legal, Finance and Security to solve for the more complex contract requirements of our Corporate customers

What are the role requirements?

  • 5+ years of Closing Sales experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Unmatched consultative selling and closing skills
  • Accurate forecasting and pipeline management
  • Track record of being a high performer (e.g. over quota, President's Club)
  • A sharp focus on your goals and a strong approach for achieving them

Who excels in this role?

Top performers in the Account Executive position usually have:

  • Strong communication, time management and adaptability in order to be set up for success remotely
  • Experience working in a high-growth, "scale up" environment
  • Passion for helping businesses grow and curiosity about the tech industry
  • Humility and enthusiasm in their work

Interested in learning more about our Remote Program? Learn more here!

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

€138.800—€183.200 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

WHO WE ARE

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

WHAT'S A MOTION DESIGNER AT HOOK?

Motion Designers are passionate animators who bring visuals and narratives to life through their knowledge of animation principles and their proficiency with motion design and video editing tools. They utilize their understanding of the craft and inquisitive nature to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing their skills.

They seek to build and uphold our growth-oriented culture, to elevate the motion work done at Hook, while always learning and growing in the process. Motion Designers work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team. On small projects they may be the sole motion designer while on larger projects they have the support of others in the Motion Department.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Collaborate with your team members to ensure motion work exceeds client expectations.
  • Leverage knowledge of animation, editing and post-production tools to produce quality work that meets specifications.
  • Respond to client and creative feedback with thoughtful solutions that solve the underlying creative challenges
  • Become proficient in the tools and workflows Hook uses on a daily basis.
  • Communicate clearly and frequently with teammates to maintain project cohesion.
  • Seek out skill advancement by engaging in company initiatives and discussions.
  • Seek out opportunities to enrich our existing culture within the department and organization.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • A firm understanding of the 12 Principles of Animation
  • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop and Premiere
  • Interest in or experimentation with any of the following: frame-by-frame (cel) animation, 3D animation and rendering, AI design and animation tools, realtime motion graphics (Lottie/Rive/Unreal/etc), basic scripting/Expressions, video editing, and audio production.
  • Knowledge of various A/V formats and when to use them
  • A strong motion reel or portfolio that demonstrates your abilities as an animator
  • A growth mindset that embraces challenges and new methods of thinking
  • A friendly, collaborative attitude

WHAT ELSE

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you.

We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever (within the US)” approach. We're a close-knit group of people who love the internet and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us!

Hook believes in compensation transparency and equity. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments and aligns to location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as a L4. During the interview process we’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. Please follow this link to learn more.

Position: Club Promoter

Company: Always The VIP LLC

Location: New York City / Remote Outreach

Classification: Independent Contractor (1099)

Compensation: Uncapped Performance-Based Commission

Openings: Multiple Positions Available

About Always The VIP

Always The VIP is New York City’s premier nightlife and hospitality group, connecting high-end guests with top-tier venues, world-class DJs, and exclusive VIP experiences across the city. Learn more at www.alwaysthevip.com/about-us.

The Role

We are seeking outgoing, high-performing Club Promoters to drive advance ticket sales, group event turnouts, and VIP bottle service table reservations across NYC’s top nightlife destinations.

This role is built for active networkers, social connectors, and street team enthusiasts who want to monetize their social reach, personal networks, and in-person presence into an uncapped, performance-based income stream.

Explore our partner venues and events at www.alwaysthevip.com/nightlife.

Who Fits This Role?

  • Side-Hustlers & Connectors: Individuals looking for a flexible way to earn extra income by inviting co-workers, friends, colleagues, or college classmates to top NYC events.

  • Nightlife & Party Enthusiasts: Active partygoers who are regularly out in the scene and want to turn their social calendar into a revenue stream.

  • Street Team Promoters: Outgoing networkers who enjoy visiting NYC nightlife hubs, lounges, and social events in person to meet people and distribute event invites.

  • Digital & Social Content Creators: Individuals with an engaged Instagram or TikTok presence looking to monetize their reach using tracked referral links and custom promo codes.

  • Hospitality Industry Professionals: Bartenders, servers, hosts, and door staff seeking high-margin side revenue by leveraging their industry connections.

  • Group & Event Organizers: Connectors who regularly organize group outings, birthdays, or weekend trips for their social circles.

Key Responsibilities & Primary Revenue Drivers

  • VIP Bottle Service Sales: Consult with high-end clients to secure VIP table reservations, qualify party size/budget against venue minimum spends, and drive premium beverage revenue.

  • Advance Ticket Sales: Promote event lineups and lock in pre-sale ticket conversions using personal tracking links and custom promo codes.

  • Group & Event Booking Facilitation: Coordinate large-group outings, corporate celebrations, birthdays, and bachelor/bachelorette parties to maximize party spend and attendance.

  • Social & Street Team Outreach: Leverage personal networks, social media, and direct networking at NYC nightlife hubs, parties, and social gatherings to invite prospective guests using your personal promo codes.

  • On-Site Client Hosting (Optional): Welcome your booked bottle service clients at the venue door and facilitate smooth table entry. While optional, hosting your clients on-site opens up opportunities to earn direct client tips. When client-purchased paid hosting services are booked, promoters also earn additional hosting commissions.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Active Social Network: Personal network or social media presence (public Instagram profile strongly preferred) with direct access to partygoers and potential bottle service clients.

  • Sales-Oriented Mindset: Focused on driving revenue conversions (ticket purchases and table deposits) rather than passive guest list management.

  • Strong Communication Skills: Confident, charismatic, and engaging when reaching out to prospective clients online or in person at social events.

  • Core Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating social media platforms, basic Google Suite tools, and digital link-tracking tools.

  • Age Requirement: Must be 21 years of age or older.

  • Reliability & Professionalism: Dependable, self-driven, and well-presented when representing the brand and interacting with partner venues.

Earning Potential & Compensation Structure

  • Direct Ticket Sales Commissions: Earn dedicated payouts per ticket sold through your personal referral codes and tracking links.

  • Uncapped Bottle Service Commissions: Earn top-tier commission percentages on minimum table spends and total bottle service revenue generated.

  • Client Hosting Payouts & Tips: When clients book paid hosting add-ons, promoters earn additional hosting commissions. Even when hosting without a paid add-on package, attending on-site provides direct opportunities to receive optional client tips for exceptional service.

Perks & VIP Privileges

  • Schedule Freedom: Work on your own time with total independence—no mandatory shifts.

  • Complimentary Access: Enjoy free venue entry whenever hosting booked guests on-site or expanding your network across partner venues.

  • Promotional VIP Tables: Active promoters gain access to promotional VIP tables with complimentary drink service on select event nights.

  • Industry Access: Receive guest passes and VIP entry across premier partner clubs and event lineups.

Legal Disclosures & Engagement Terms

  • Pay Transparency: In compliance with NYC Local Law 32, compensation for this role is strictly performance-based (commission). There is no base hourly wage or salary provided. Earnings are directly tied to documented ticket sales, guest entry turnouts, bottle service revenue generated, and contracted hosting services. Client tips are optional and provided at the client's sole discretion.

  • Independent Contractor Status (1099): This engagement is strictly that of an Independent Contractor (1099-NEC). Contractors maintain full autonomy over their schedules, promotion methods, and client outreach.

  • Tax Compliance: Contractors are solely responsible for all federal, state, and local tax obligations. Prior to payout disbursement, a valid IRS Form W-9 must be submitted. Always The VIP LLC will issue an IRS Form 1099-NEC as required by law.

  • Venue Compliance & Age Restrictions: Promoters and their hosted guests must strictly adhere to venue entry requirements, dress codes, state liquor laws, and security protocols. Promoters and guests must be at least 21 years of age with valid government-issued photo identification. Entry is at the discretion of venue door management.

  • Equal Opportunity Statement: Always The VIP LLC provides equal engagement opportunities to all independent contractors regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

How to Apply

Apply online at www.alwaysthevip.com/jobs. Submit your application along with your primary social media handle for review (ensure your profile is set to public). Qualified candidates will be contacted for an interview.
