Location: Remote, Eastern Territory US

Reporting to: Senior Director, Medical Affairs – Americas

Orchard Therapeutics, a Kyowa Kirin company, is a global gene therapy leader focused on transforming the lives of patients with rare disorders through innovative gene therapies based on gene-modified hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs). Orchard has its global headquarters in London, England, and its U.S. headquarters in Boston, Massachusetts.

Job Summary

The Senior Medical Science Liaison (Sr MSL) is a therapeutic and disease area scientific expert for investigational and approved gene therapy clinical programs. They demonstrate leadership in field medical excellence and coaching as well as medical and scientific support with national level strategic planning in the Eastern Territory of the United States. As a field-based member of the medical affairs team, the Sr MSL will be responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with external thought leaders involved in all phases of the clinical development process through a fair-balanced and high-value exchange of clinical and scientific information. In addition to these typical MSL responsibilities, the Sr MSL will develop strategy, serve as a team mentor, and lead national level initiatives. This position necessitates professionals exhibiting established personal and scientific credibility and self-awareness, who work well in a collaborative, cross-functional environment with other individuals within broader US and Global organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, build and maintain collaborative partnerships with healthcare providers (HCP’s) and key external experts such as KOL’s and academic institutions to become a trusted scientific partner.
  • Provide timely, audience-appropriate information and updates to enhance the understanding of the scientific and medical value of Orchard’s programs. This includes, but is not limited to, collaboration with Market Access, Government Affairs, Diagnostics, Patient Advocacy, Clinical Development etc.
  • Maintain training records and deliver training updates to ensure all personnel in assigned Qualified Treatment Centers are appropriately trained according to Orchard’s SOPs and the latest Product Manual.
  • Develop a territory profile including Centers of Excellence, key expertise, newborn screening approaches and leaders, and market access pathways to inform medical strategy and tactical planning in collaboration with our Commercial, Diagnostic, and Patient Advocacy partners.
  • Gather insights from the field on data, therapeutic area, and competitive intelligence to help inform company strategies and evidence generation plans.
  • Build thorough operational understanding to ensure excellence in execution balanced with risk management within the boundaries of all governance processes.
  • Review and oversee Investigator-Sponsored Trial (IST) requests and Early Access Program (EAP) requests throughout the internal review process and any follow up requests for information.
  • Build effective internal partnerships through communication and collaboration across the organization with individuals from Medical Affairs, Patient Advocacy, Public Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Technical Operations, Market Access, Commercial, etc.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external regulatory and legal guidelines.
  • Maintain clinical, scientific, and technical expertise in therapeutic area.
  • Develop strategic initiatives to support departmental goals from a field medical excellence perspective
  • Successfully manage at least two large cross-functional projects with demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills while successfully maintaining geographical responsibilities
  • Proactively seek out and demonstrate successful peer coaching of other team members
  • Develop US field resource materials specific to stakeholder group, disease state, and technology.
  • Provide strategic insights by maintaining expertise in the therapeutic area and related fields to effectively communicate scientific insights and support strategic objectives
  • Monitor the competitive environment for advances and trends in the therapeutic area, including new treatment management and therapies, competitive products and provide feedback to internal stakeholders on specific initiatives of competitors
  • Serves as peer leader to mentor and coach new or junior MSLs, supporting onboarding, training, and field excellence

Requirements

Education / Key Competencies

  • Advanced Scientific / Healthcare Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, NP, DVM, CGC or similar preferred; RN, MS, or similar with substantial experience considered)
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a scientific, clinical or MSL role within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry
  • Extensive experience as an MSL supporting post-approval commercial products in the field
  • Ability to lead and motivate team members without a direct reporting relationship including coaching and mentoring colleagues

raw.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to own the evolution of our architecture and platform so it works for agents as well as people. Our goal is simple: double the output of our entire organization while raising the quality bar. The scope is the whole platform. You’ll work across infrastructure, shared services, and product code, and step in as a product engineer anywhere in the stack when that is the fastest way to move.

The ideal candidate is deep in code architecture and platform engineering, already works agent-first, and has built foundations that other teams adopted because they were better. This role reports directly to our VP of Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our codebase. Set the patterns, module boundaries, and domain abstractions across our monorepo, and lead the refactors and migrations that get us there.

  • Design the monorepo for agents. Structure packages, ownership, the build graph, and conventions so an agent can find the right context, make a scoped change, and verify it without reading the whole repo.

  • Build the platform substrate. Own the shared services, infrastructure, and paved paths (data access, background jobs, environments, observability) that product teams build on and agents can use safely.

  • Own the agentic SDLC. Define how work moves from ticket to production when agents do much of the writing, testing, and reviewing. Set the defaults every team builds on, and change them as models and tools improve.

  • Scale verification with volume. Build AI-assisted code review, test generation, and CI gates so confidence to merge keeps pace as PR volume doubles. Decide where human review is required and where it is not.

  • Put agents to work in the background. Stand up agents that pick up well-scoped tickets, triage flaky tests, run dependency upgrades and large migrations, and draft fixes from incidents and error reports.

What We're Looking For

  • You've owned the architecture of a large, multi-team codebase. You've set the module boundaries and patterns others build within, run monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel, or similar), and led migrations that changed how a whole org works.

  • Strong platform and infrastructure depth: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and services you've run in production through real incidents.

  • You can work across the stack as a product engineer, from data model to UI, and you're happy to do it.

  • You work agent-first today. A large share of the code you ship comes from AI coding agents, and you have specific, earned opinions on where they break and how codebase structure fixes that.

  • Current knowledge of the agentic stack as it applies to software engineering: context engineering, agent instructions and skills, MCP, sandboxed execution, and how to evaluate a coding agent's output.

  • You operate with earned authority. You influence through demonstrated judgment, working code, and clear writing rather than title or mandate.

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, including time setting technical direction across multiple teams.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

  • 401(k) savings plan

  • Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

  • Home office & equipment stipend

  • Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

  • Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Compensation Range: $250K - $300K

WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

About You

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for the following key areas: 1) design and execution of mobile and social strategy 2) acting as the primary paid mobile and social POC for your assigned clients by answering client emails and leading weekly calls 3) channel management on accounts you own.

Our Account Managers work with brand-name companies who demand – and recognize – excellence. You’ll be part of a cross-functional team that includes production and client services, all working to make sure client needs are anticipated and met.

We are looking for a highly accountable and detail-oriented individual with the drive to work independently and stellar communication skills to join a thriving team. Ideal candidates will have had successful account management experience buying mobile app install campaigns across mobile ad networks, DSPs, and Facebook. They will come from either the ad network/agency side, or user acquisition role on the client side.

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading mobile and social app marketing strategy for DEPT mobile clients
  • Managing a combination of managed service mobile partners and self-serve ad platforms
  • Oversee budget across a variety of app install campaigns on mobile and social networks outside of Google Ads.
  • Assisting in channel expansion strategies and deliverables.
  • Creating roadmaps, planning strategic initiatives & optimization efforts to hit client goals and targets.
  • Engaging with the POCs across the various mobile network partners, managing all forms of communication from weekly calls to daily slack questions and requests
  • Monitoring daily performance metrics and campaign pacing, identify irregularities or poor performance and communicate optimization recommendations to internal team, vendors, and clients
  • Campaign set up - create tracking links, build social and ASA campaigns, and communicate campaign structure, pacing, benchmarks and objectives
  • Troubleshooting across attribution vendors and advertising platforms, researching discrepancies and ensuring all necessary parameters and attributes are being properly tracked
  • Operating as the mobile and social expert on a mobile account, being able to advise clients on many facets of mobile app marketing strategies and tactics
  • Vetting new mobile partners through research to better prioritize the opportunity based on effort versus reward
  • Identifying and executing tasks that will have the most significant impact in hitting targets.
  • Implementing testing initiatives in key areas such as ad creatives, landing page messaging, landing page layout, audience segmentation, placements, networks, and 3rd-party tools.

You’ll need to have:

  • A minimum of 2 years’ digital marketing experience experience and a minimum 1 year of experience in a client-facing digital marketing role
  • Good pulse on mobile app industry and trends
  • Expertise on Facebook, Tiktok, and ideally experience on at least one other social channel
  • Knowledge of Facebook Advertising and proven work experience executing on Facebook Ads
  • Desire to quickly learn and master social channels you may have not owned in the past
  • Experience working with an MMP
  • Understanding of mobile KPIs, mobile media buying tactics and strategies
  • Strong analytical thinker - considers all details & angles of a situation
  • Highly detail-oriented, organized, and able to excel while juggling many tasks at once
  • Ability to clearly communicate & present strategies, results, and metrics to internal teams and clients
  • Strong communication & interpersonal skills - ability to collaborate & work autonomously
  • Self-starter mentality; comfortable with setting goals and achieving them.
  • Computer-savvy, quick learner, and online problem-solver. Can easily figure out new technologies online.
  • Innovative thinker and collaborative team player
  • Proven prior work experience managing accounts with various goals and across several different industries (B2B, lead gen, eCommerce, B2C)

Additional things that will impress us:

  • Experience with TikTok, Snapchat, Facebook, Twitter, Pinterest, Reddit, Quora & Apple search ads.
  • You are an energetic and creative mobile marketing enthusiast; eager to roll up your sleeves and be hands on, learn, and grow in the app marketing space
  • You are entrepreneurial spirited and a self-starter; able to work both independently and in a team environment
  • You are comfortable working with 3rd party tracking platforms (ex: Kochava, Adjust, AppsFlyer, etc.)
  • Experience with UAC campaigns, Apple search ads and 3rd party app networks

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

As the Safety and Systems Technical Program Manager, you will drive the execution of our safety and systems engineering development efforts for our autonomous vehicle platforms. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we need a technical program manager to ensure our safety assessments, system architectures, and verification and validation processes (simulation and real world testing) are delivered efficiently and rigorously. You will translate complex technical milestones into clear, centralized plans, streamline communication across engineering leads, and leverage modern AI tools to eliminate administrative friction. If you thrive on bringing structure to safety-critical engineering, aligning cross-functional teams, and clearing roadblocks before they happen, this role is for you.

  • Consolidate project timelines, Jira tracking boards, and status updates into a centralized master plan, utilizing AI tools (like Claude) to synthesize information and limit the manual overhead required from engineering leads.

  • Track the execution of verification and validation (V&V) in simulation and real-world testing - providing dedicated TPM support to test leads so they can focus on test definition and evaluation - while applying systems engineering principles to ensure all requirements have full test coverage.
  • Take a leading role in organizing driverless deployment decisions through Production Readiness Reviews (PRR), coordinating the delivery of safety and Security artifacts to ensure they meet internal quality gates and timeline expectations.
  • Lead the alignment of continuous software evaluation activities, ensuring the Safety, Security, and Systems teams provide the right deliverables adapted to various product maturity and deployment phases.
  • Establish efficient issue burndown tracking methods, acting as the central liaison to route identified process, anomaly, and system performance issues to the appropriate stakeholders and drive them to resolution.

Software Engineer (Portugal)

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is a fully remote, full-time role for an experienced platform engineer comfortable working for a rapidly growing Series-B startup. You'll work on challenging projects involving cloud architecture, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines. At HiddenLayer our services are written in Go and are fully containerized running on multiple Kubernetes clusters deployed with ArgoCD. We also value and use other CNCF FOSS software such as Prometheus, Thanos, and Fluentd/Fluentbit.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop and optimize containerized applications using Docker.
  • Collaborate with development teams to create seamless CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
  • Manage and improve existing AWS infrastructure and explore opportunities to integrate with Azure for multi-cloud capabilities.
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in DevOps, cloud security, and cost optimization.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues in a timely manner.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, with a strong focus on AWS.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
  • Proficiency in Docker and container orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub for CI/CD pipelines and source code management.
  • Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, and cloud security.
  • Proven track record of building and managing production-grade cloud infrastructure.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We just raised $100M in Series B funding led by Delta-v Capital, with backing from Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's venture arm, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others. It's a validation of what we've built: 10x revenue growth, 50+ new enterprise customers, and deployments across defense, finance, and the world's largest AI platforms. This funding goes straight into expanding our platform and GTM capabilities, and into growing our team globally.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

  • Fully Remote: We are a completely remote global team. Though we’re distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together. We offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Better than your average startup healthcare benefits. We also offer vision, dental, and 401k offerings.
  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to paid company holidays.
  • Commitment to Learning and Development: We support personal growth and education through a dedicated L&D fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

To learn more about HiddenLayer visitHiddenLayer and follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter.

HiddenLayer is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

raw.description:
Client : Secteur manufacturier

Lieu : 100 % télétravail

Mode de travail : Remote

Durée : 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement

Heures : 35 h/semaine

Langue : Anglais obligatoire – candidats anglophones acceptés

CV : Anglais

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) de données senior spécialisé(e) en SAP Master Data, intégration et migration de données afin de contribuer à un important programme de transformation technologique au sein d'une grande organisation du secteur manufacturier.

La personne intégrera l'équipe Enterprise Data Management (EDM) et sera responsable de concevoir, développer et exploiter les pipelines de données permettant à Jaggaer Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM) de devenir la source de référence (Golden Record) pour les données maîtres fournisseurs de l'organisation.

Le mandat s'inscrit dans un environnement complexe de transformation SAP ECC / Jaggaer SLM / SAP S/4HANA, avec un accent particulier sur la migration, l'intégration, la consolidation et la qualité des données fournisseurs.

La ressource devra assurer la circulation fiable des données entre les systèmes : SAP ECC alimente Jaggaer SLM, qui retourne ensuite les données vers SAP ECC via les IDocs, avant leur migration ultérieure vers SAP S/4HANA.

Le profil recherché doit posséder une solide expertise pratique en Data Engineering, SQL, Python, SAP Vendor Master Data, ETL/ELT et intégration SAP IDocs, ainsi qu'une expérience concrète de projets complets de conversion ERP ou Master Data.

Exigences principales

Minimum de 8 années d'expérience en ingénierie de données (Data Engineering).

Participation à au moins 2 projets complets de conversion ERP ou Master Data, incluant les différentes étapes de migration.

Expérience pratique avec SAP Vendor Master Data.

Bonne connaissance des principales tables fournisseurs SAP :

LFA1 – Données générales fournisseurs

LFB1 – Données fournisseurs au niveau de la société

LFM1 – Données fournisseurs au niveau de l'organisation d'achats

LFBK – Coordonnées bancaires fournisseurs

Expérience avec les SAP IDocs, notamment :

Structures IDoc

Monitoring avec WE02 / WE19

Retraitement avec BD87

Connaissance des messages CREMAS

Maîtrise avancée de SQL et Python pour le développement, la transformation et la validation des données.

Expérience avec au moins une technologie ETL/ELT ou de migration de données, notamment :

SAP Data Services

Syniti

SAP Migration Cockpit

Informatica

Snowflake

dbt

Azure Data Factory

Expérience concrète en Master Data Matching, Deduplication et Survivorship.

Capacité à développer des règles de nettoyage, standardisation, enrichissement et consolidation de données.

Expérience dans la conversion de règles d'affaires en code testé, versionné et reproductible.

Capacité à exécuter des simulations de conversion et des répétitions de mise en production (Mock Conversions / Cutover Rehearsals).

Expérience en réconciliation et validation des données après migration.

Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de Data Quality, Data Lineage et Data Governance.

Capacité à travailler avec des équipes EDM, architectes de données, intégrateurs et partenaires externes.

Grande autonomie et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement peu structuré, avec une documentation limitée.

Maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais obligatoire.

Atouts importants

Expérience d'implantation avec Jaggaer SLM, Jaggaer SRM ou Jaggaer Advantage.

Expérience avec le modèle SAP S/4HANA Business Partner et Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI).

Connaissance de Snowflake Cortex ou d'outils de matching et classification assistés par IA.

Expérience avec Collibra ou des outils comparables pour la gouvernance, la traçabilité et la qualité des données.

Expérience avec des sources de validation et d'enrichissement des fournisseurs :

Dun & Bradstreet (D&B)

Tax ID

Validation des comptes bancaires

Certification CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) ou équivalent.

Expérience dans un environnement manufacturier complexe.

Expérience dans des projets de transformation ERP impliquant plusieurs systèmes et partenaires externes.

Responsabilités principales

Conversion et migration des données fournisseurs

Concevoir, développer et exécuter les pipelines ETL/ELT permettant la migration des données maîtres fournisseurs de SAP ECC vers Jaggaer SLM.

Assurer la préparation des données pour le chargement initial et la mise en production.

Implémenter les règles de nettoyage, normalisation et enrichissement approuvées par les équipes EDM.

Développer les mécanismes de matching, déduplication, fusion et survivorship.

Assurer la traçabilité entre les données historiques et les enregistrements consolidés dans le Golden Record.

Exécuter les simulations de conversion et répétitions de Cutover.

Effectuer la réconciliation des volumes, champs clés et attributs financiers après chaque chargement.

Identifier et résoudre les écarts de migration.

Intégration SAP / Jaggaer SLM

Soutenir les intégrations de données entre SAP ECC et Jaggaer SLM.

Participer à l'intégration basée sur les SAP IDocs, notamment CREMAS.

Contribuer au mapping des données entre les systèmes.

Assurer le monitoring des interfaces et le suivi des erreurs.

Participer au retraitement des messages et à la résolution des anomalies.

Valider que les données fournisseurs retournées de Jaggaer vers SAP ECC sont compatibles avec les besoins de migration vers SAP S/4HANA Business Partner.

Collaborer avec le partenaire d'implantation sur les spécifications d'interfaces, les tests et les corrections.

Qualité et gouvernance des données

Traduire les règles de qualité des données fournisseurs en contrôles automatisés.

Développer des indicateurs et rapports permettant de suivre la qualité des données.

Mettre en place des Data Quality Scorecards et rapports d'exceptions.

Réaliser le profilage des données sources.

Identifier les anomalies et les communiquer aux responsables concernés.

Maintenir à jour les documents de Data Mapping et Data Lineage.

Documenter les métadonnées techniques dans les outils de gouvernance.

Contribuer à la fiabilité et à l'intégrité des données fournisseurs.

Développement et automatisation

Développer des solutions de traitement et transformation de données avec SQL et Python.

Convertir les règles d'affaires en processus automatisés, testés et versionnés.

Optimiser les performances des pipelines de migration et d'intégration.

Mettre en place des mécanismes de validation et de gestion des erreurs.

Assurer la reproductibilité et la maintenabilité des traitements.

Participer à l'amélioration continue des mécanismes d'intégration.

Exploitation et pérennité des solutions

Livrer des pipelines de données production-ready, documentés et surveillés.

Assurer la stabilité et la fiabilité des traitements après la mise en production.

Rédiger les procédures opérationnelles (Runbooks).

Documenter les procédures de chargement récurrent.

Définir les mécanismes de gestion des files d'erreurs et de retraitement.

Mettre en place les contrôles visant à prévenir la création de fournisseurs en double.

Assurer le transfert de connaissances aux équipes EDM.

Compétences comportementales

Autonomie : Capacité à avancer sans supervision constante, à identifier les bons interlocuteurs et à assurer le suivi de ses dossiers.

Agilité : Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements dynamiques, peu structurés et impliquant plusieurs fournisseurs et partenaires externes.

Adaptabilité : Capacité à gérer les changements de priorités et les nouveaux contextes.

Proactivité : Capacité à anticiper les difficultés et à proposer des solutions.

Rigueur : Attention particulière à la qualité, à l'intégrité et à la traçabilité des données.

Collaboration : Capacité à travailler avec les équipes d'affaires, EDM, TI et partenaires d'implantation.

Vos informations seront traitées de manière confidentielle et conformément à la Loi 25 sur la protection des renseignements personnels du Québec. Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Prior Authorization & Healthcare Administration)

Position type: Part-Time

Work hours: 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (4 hours per day/20 hours per week)

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare organization dedicated to providing quality, patient-centered care and efficient healthcare services. We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant specializing in Prior Authorization and Healthcare Administration to support essential administrative operations, streamline insurance authorization processes, and maintain accurate staff credentialing records.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced healthcare administrative professional who enjoys managing important processes, coordinating with insurance providers, and helping healthcare teams focus more on patient care.

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, you will primarily handle prior authorization requests, incoming phone calls, and HR credential tracking. You will also assist with insurance verification, medical billing support, community outreach, scheduling coordination, and general administrative responsibilities as needed.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience submitting and managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations, strong English communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and the confidence to work independently.

While prior authorization experience is essential, previous HR administration, credentialing, or healthcare-specific phone-handling experience is not required. Training will be provided for the practice's HR processes, and training resources are available for its EHR system.

If you're an experienced Medical VA who enjoys staying organized, solving problems, and making a meaningful difference behind the scenes of patient care, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Prior Authorization Management (Top Priority)

  • Prepare, submit, track, and manage prior authorization requests for healthcare services.
  • Coordinate with insurance providers to confirm authorization requirements and submission procedures.
  • Ensure all necessary patient, provider, and supporting documentation is complete and accurate before submission.
  • Follow up on pending authorization requests and monitor their progress through determination.
  • Track authorization approvals, denials, pending requests, and outstanding documentation.
  • Monitor authorization expiration dates and provide timely reminders to prevent interruptions in authorized services.
  • Maintain accurate records of authorization numbers, effective dates, expiration dates, payer correspondence, and follow-up actions.
  • Identify authorization discrepancies or missing requirements and coordinate appropriate resolutions.
  • Communicate authorization updates and outstanding concerns to the appropriate healthcare staff.
  • Help reduce the therapist's administrative workload by maintaining an organized and efficient authorization process.
  • Manage approximately five prior authorization requests per week, supporting a practice with approximately 60 active clients.

Phone Management & Call Coordination (Top Priority)

  • Answer incoming calls professionally, courteously, and efficiently.
  • Provide general assistance to callers and direct inquiries to the appropriate staff members.
  • Screen spam, unsolicited, and irrelevant calls to minimize unnecessary interruptions.
  • Route patient, insurance, and administrative inquiries to the appropriate team members.
  • Take accurate messages and document relevant call details when necessary.
  • Maintain professional phone etiquette and clear communication.
  • Escalate urgent or sensitive concerns according to established procedures.
  • Support an estimated call volume of approximately 10 incoming calls per week.
  • Assist with outbound calls as needed for administrative follow-ups and outreach.

HR Administration & Staff Credential Tracking (Top Priority)

  • Maintain organized and accurate records of staff credentials, professional certifications, and required training.
  • Track credential, certification, and training expiration dates.
  • Monitor upcoming renewal deadlines and provide timely reminders to the appropriate staff members.
  • Update credentialing trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
  • Identify missing, outdated, or incomplete staff documentation.
  • Follow up on outstanding credentialing or training requirements.
  • Assist with organizing and maintaining confidential HR-related documentation.
  • Support compliance-sensitive administrative tracking according to established organizational procedures.
  • Learn and follow the client's HR administration and credential management processes.

Training will be provided for the client's HR and credential tracking procedures. Previous HR or credentialing experience is not required.

Insurance Verification & Medical Billing Support (Secondary Priority)

  • Assist with verifying patient insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits.
  • Contact insurance providers to clarify coverage information or resolve insurance-related inquiries.
  • Support medical billing-related administrative tasks as assigned.
  • Assist with organizing billing records, documentation, and outstanding follow-ups.
  • Identify incomplete or inconsistent insurance information and communicate concerns to the appropriate staff.
  • Maintain accurate records of insurance communications and verification results.

Community Outreach & External Communication (Secondary Priority)

  • Make outbound calls to community organizations, stakeholders, and other relevant contacts as directed.
  • Assist with email outreach to community partners and stakeholders.
  • Respond to routine administrative inquiries and coordinate follow-up communications.
  • Maintain organized records of outreach activities and responses.
  • Support administrative initiatives that strengthen communication with community stakeholders.

Scheduling & General Administrative Support (Secondary Priority)

  • Assist with appointment scheduling and coordination when needed.
  • Maintain accurate administrative records, trackers, and documentation.
  • Support routine clerical tasks, data entry, and document organization.
  • Coordinate with internal staff regarding outstanding administrative requests.
  • Assist with managing multiple tasks and deadlines efficiently.
  • Follow established healthcare administrative procedures and confidentiality standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organization, tracking, and administrative workflows.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Prior Authorization Management

Take ownership of healthcare prior authorization workflows, including submission, tracking, payer follow-ups, and monitoring authorization expiration dates. Ensure requests are properly documented and processed efficiently to reduce the therapist's administrative workload and prevent avoidable service interruptions.

2. Professional Phone Management

Handle incoming calls, screen spam or irrelevant inquiries, and route callers to the appropriate staff members. Maintain professional, clear, and courteous communication while ensuring important calls and messages are handled appropriately.

3. HR Administration & Credential Tracking

Maintain accurate records of staff credentials, certifications, and required training. Proactively monitor expiration dates, organize documentation, and send timely renewal reminders to support efficient administrative operations.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Medical Virtual Assistant consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate and timely submission of healthcare prior authorization requests.
  • Organized tracking of pending, approved, denied, and expiring authorizations.
  • Proactive insurance follow-ups and timely communication of outstanding requirements.
  • Reduced administrative workload for the therapist and healthcare team.
  • Professional handling of incoming calls and accurate routing of inquiries.
  • Effective screening of spam and unnecessary calls.
  • Accurate maintenance of staff credentialing and training records.
  • Timely reminders for upcoming credential and certification renewals.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail across multiple administrative responsibilities.
  • Accurate insurance verification and reliable billing-related support when needed.
  • Professional communication with patients, insurance representatives, staff, and community stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality standards.

Tools & Platforms

  • Integrity Checkpoint EHR: Used for patient records and healthcare administrative workflows. Training is available.
  • Regular Text Messaging & GroupMe: Used for internal communication, coordination, and updates.

Requirements

Prior Authorization Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience submitting, tracking, and managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations (mandatory).
  • Familiarity with insurance authorization requirements, submission procedures, and payer follow-up processes.
  • Experience monitoring authorization statuses, approval dates, and expiration dates.
  • Ability to identify missing documentation and resolve administrative authorization issues.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing authorization requests and supporting records.
  • Ability to maintain organized trackers and follow up on outstanding requests independently.

U.S. Healthcare Administrative Experience

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices or healthcare administrative operations.
  • Familiarity with common healthcare workflows, medical terminology, and insurance-related processes.
  • Understanding of insurance eligibility, benefits verification, and general medical billing support.
  • Experience maintaining accurate patient or administrative records.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality.
  • Ability to handle healthcare information professionally and securely.

Communication & Phone Management

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (mandatory).
  • Strong professional phone etiquette and confidence handling incoming and outbound calls.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with patients, insurance representatives, staff members, and external contacts.
  • Strong active listening skills and attention to detail when documenting messages.
  • Ability to screen calls and appropriately route inquiries.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally in a remote healthcare environment.

Organization & Administrative Coordination

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Ability to maintain accurate trackers, spreadsheets, and administrative records.
  • Attention to detail when monitoring staff credentials, certifications, and training expiration dates.
  • Ability to provide timely reminders and follow up on outstanding requirements.
  • Comfortable handling confidential administrative and staff information.
  • Ability to learn and follow HR credentialing and compliance-tracking procedures.

Previous HR administration or staff credentialing experience is not required. Training will be provided.

Technical Skills & Independent Work

  • Experience using EHR/EMR systems or similar healthcare administrative platforms.
  • Strong computer literacy and proficiency with digital documentation, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.
  • Willingness and ability to learn Integrity Checkpoint EHR.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to administrative responsibilities.
  • Excellent time management, multitasking, and prioritization skills.
  • Dependable, adaptable, and committed to completing tasks accurately and on time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Prior Authorization Specialist, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting therapists, behavioral health providers, or other U.S.-based healthcare professionals.
  • Experience handling insurance eligibility and benefits verification.
  • Familiarity with medical billing workflows and insurance follow-ups.
  • Previous experience managing staff credentials, certifications, or training records.
  • Experience handling inbound calls in a healthcare environment.
  • Experience with community outreach, outbound calls, or email communication with external stakeholders.
  • Experience using Integrity Checkpoint EHR or similar healthcare systems.
  • Experience supporting scheduling coordination and general healthcare administrative operations.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Experienced in Prior Authorizations: Confident managing authorization submissions, follow-ups, and expiration tracking.
  • Highly Organized: Keeps accurate records, monitors deadlines, and ensures nothing important is overlooked.
  • An Excellent Communicator: Handles phone calls, insurance inquiries, and professional correspondence clearly and courteously.
  • Proactive: Anticipates deadlines, follows up on pending requests, and identifies potential issues early.
  • Detail-Oriented: Carefully reviews healthcare documentation, authorization information, and administrative records.
  • Independent & Self-Motivated: Takes ownership of responsibilities without requiring constant supervision.
  • Reliable & Accountable: Consistently completes assigned tasks and communicates progress appropriately.
  • Adaptable & Tech-Savvy: Comfortable learning new systems, including Integrity Checkpoint EHR.
  • A Strong Multitasker: Effectively balances authorization requests, calls, credential tracking, and secondary administrative tasks.
  • Professional & Confidentiality-Conscious: Handles sensitive healthcare and staff information responsibly.

Basic Requirements

Descartes Unites the People and Technology that Move the World

The need for efficient, secure, and agile supply chains and logistics operations has become ever more critical and complex. By combining innovative technology, powerful trade intelligence and the reach of our network, Descartes helps get goods, information, transportation assets, and people where they’re needed, when they’re needed.

We’re one of the most broadly deployed logistics and supply chain technology companies in the world. More than 26,000 customers around the globe use our cloud-based solutions to transform the way they move inventory and information to enhance productivity, better serve customers, thrive competitively, keep pace with evolving regulations, and respond to rapidly changing market conditions. Descartes is publicly traded (Nasdaq:DSGX, TSX:DSG) with headquarters in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada, and offices and partners around the world. With record financial performance for more than 16 years, we lead the industry in innovation investment. Every day, logistics service providers, manufacturers, retailers, distributors, and other logistics-intensive businesses of all sizes rely on our scale, stability, and comprehensive solution footprint to move what’s most important to them. Learn more at www.descartes.com.

We’re growing fast and invite you to join our amazing team.

Mission — Why the Job Exists

Drive customer retention, growth and advocacy by helping Fleet customers achieve measurable operational value from Descartes solutions. Own the post-sale customer journey, build strategic relationships, and ensure our technology delivers lasting improvements in efficiency, service, and performance.

Outcomes — What Success Looks Like

  1. Customer Retention: Protect recurring revenue through proactive account management, early risk identification and effective renewal planning.
  2. Customer Value: Develop success plans and demonstrate measurable improvements in fleet efficiency, utilisation, service and costs.
  3. Product Adoption: Increase solution adoption and executive engagement across strategic accounts.
  4. Account Growth: Identify and develop qualified expansion opportunities aligned with customer needs and business outcomes.
  5. Portfolio Management: Within 90 days, segment accounts, establish key relationships and document success plans for priority customers.
  6. Customer Advocacy: Within 6–12 months, develop customer references, case studies and advocacy opportunities.
  7. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align Sales, Product, Support and Professional Services to deliver customer outcomes.

Skills & Competencies — How the Work Gets Done

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Proven success in Customer Success, Account Management or commercially accountable customer-facing roles.
  • Experience retaining and growing complex SaaS or enterprise technology accounts.
  • Understanding of fleet, logistics, transport or supply chain operations.
  • Strong commercial judgement, stakeholder management and executive communication.
  • Ability to use customer and operational data to identify risks, demonstrate ROI and drive improvements.
  • Experience managing renewals, success plans, escalations and growth opportunities.

Desirable: Knowledge of route optimisation, fleet execution, telematics, delivery visibility or fleet safety solutions.

Culture Add: TEAM Values

We value team members who communicate with transparency, sharing information openly and building trust across functions. You bring excellence and expertise to your craft, holding a high bar for quality while continuously improving your skills. You demonstrate accountability by owning outcomes, following through on commitments, and taking responsibility for results. You are driven by metrics, using data and experimentation to inform decisions and deliver measurable impact.

Aptitudes

  • Smart: Able to quickly understand complex systems, connect ideas, and make sound judgments.
  • Curious: Actively seeks to understand customer problems, emerging technologies, and better ways of working.
  • Coachable: Open to feedback, willing to adapt, and continuously improving through learning.

What’s in It for You

  • Meaningful Impact: Help customers improve critical fleet operations and achieve measurable business results.
  • Ownership & Visibility: Manage strategic accounts and collaborate with senior customer and Descartes stakeholders.
  • Career Growth: Develop expertise in Fleet Management technology within a global logistics technology organisation.
  • Opportunity to Influence: Help shape the evolution of Fleet Customer Success across EMEA.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work with experienced teams in a culture that values autonomy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Join Descartes and help customers turn fleet technology into measurable business success.

Join Us

As we scale, we’re looking for new doers, collaborators and innovators to join Descartes in uniting the people and technology that move the world as the Global Leader in Logistics and Supply Chain Technology. We’re entrepreneurial, hardworking, geeky-in-a-good way problem solvers. Guided by our values, we nurture a TEAM focused culture that invests in people and creates opportunities for advancement across a broad spectrum of career paths. We prioritize work-life balance and foster an environment with the space to take ownership, to be heard, and to carve a path for your individual accomplishments to help drive our success. At Descartes, everyone has a voice and the best idea wins, regardless of who makes it. We offer competitive compensation, great benefits, remote and flexible work hours, and the opportunity to join a company on an awesome mission with a great existing team and trajectory.

Descartes also has a deep sense of environmental responsibility. Learn more about how we helped our customers save over 552,000 metric tons of CO2 in 2020 by reducing fuel and paper consumption: .  Join a team that’s committed to working with customers to conserve resources and enhance sustainability.

If you feel you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for, and Descartes sounds like the team and the mission you want to be part of, apply now. We can't promise it will be a fit, but we do promise to consider your experience.

Recordings, transcripts, and notes are used for recruitment, including improvement of our process, and record-keeping purposes. Should you have any questions or concerns about our process, please connect with our hiring team in advance of scheduled interviews.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Regional Marketing Manager, you will own regional marketing for the sales team in your territory and set the standard for how the regional team plans and runs its work. You will choose, plan, and run the events and campaigns that create, expand, and accelerate pipeline in your region, and you will move easily between high-level strategy and creative, detailed execution. Staff is a leadership-level individual contributor role: you lead through the work you build and ship, not through direct reports. In a modern marketing organization, that means building and running your own plans, programs, measurement, and AI-assisted automation instead of handing them off, and it suits builders who are comfortable being a leader without a team to manage. Your audience is CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software. You will judge audience quality by seniority and buying role, not headcount, so you will need to understand how they work and what they want from a vendor.

You will support both direct and channel sales teams, work with GitLab partners on Channel and Alliance Marketing activities, and partner with external agencies and third parties to prepare and run campaigns. As a senior individual contributor, you will mentor other regional marketers, help build and improve team process, and share best practices with regional peers by planning and operating transparently. Your impact is measured in pipeline: the target is 10X spend contribution to sales pipeline for your region, with your regional budget spent within 5% variance. This role supports one of our sales regions (AMER, EMEA, or APAC), and involves travel up to 50% of the time.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive results for your region as its marketing leader: own the pipeline and growth outcomes, and go beyond events and experiences to bring partners in to drive marketing across channels, in support of growth through our revenue team.
  • Adapt digital and content marketing programs to the needs of your regional sales team.
  • Create, expand, and accelerate sales opportunities through regional and account-focused campaigns that promote GitLab’s products and services, within the marketing strategy.
  • Set regional event and campaign strategy, with discretion over which events and campaigns best support regional sales goals, and manage events onsite, including logistics, booth staffing, and swag.
  • Project manage every campaign from start to finish, following the GitLab process, so each one meets its objectives, arrives on time, and stays within budget, then measure and report on its effectiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional work to drive demand generation and regional marketing plans, and advocate for your sales region within marketing and for marketing with your sales team.
  • Support Channel and Alliance Marketing activities with GitLab partners, from campaign approval through execution.
  • Work with external agencies and third parties to prepare, manage, and execute campaigns.
  • Mentor and guide regional marketing specialists and managers, and lead in building and driving process within the team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven ability to build and execute a regional strategy, with a record of delivering, accelerating, and expanding sales pipeline through regional marketing.
  • Experience supporting both direct sales and channel sales teams, and in enterprise solution demand creation and regional marketing.
  • Exemplary analytical skills and a proven aptitude for using data to optimize program performance and inform future strategies.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to convey ideas and data clearly in writing and in presentations to a variety of audiences, without a fear of over-communicating. You plan and operate transparently and share best practices with other regional marketers.
  • A proven aptitude for building and driving a budget within your territory, and extreme attention to program details and deadlines.
  • The capacity to empathize with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of engineering and platform, and the security leaders who govern how their teams ship software, and a passion for, and substantial understanding of, the developer tools, IT operations tools, and/or IT security markets.
  • Ability to use GitLab, and you share our values and work in accordance with them.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% and to comply with the company’s travel policy.

About the team

Regional Marketing at GitLab turns marketing strategy into regional action. We support our sales teams in AMER, EMEA, and APAC by running the events and campaigns that build pipeline in their territories, working with direct sellers, channel sellers, and alliance partners. We work closely with Product Marketing, Corporate Events, Digital Marketing, Marketing Operations, Developer Relations, Business Development, Customer Success Managers, and Solution Architects. Our goals are set through the Marketing OKRs and measured in pipeline contribution and regional budget. To see how the role fits in the team and where it can lead, read the Regional Marketing Manager job family and the Regional Marketing leadership page.

Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. We are a global OSINT company headquartered in the US, empowering investigators, compliance teams, and security professionals with cutting-edge AI-powered products. Our technology collects and analyzes massive volumes of data from 500+ open sources: social media, messengers, blockchains, and the dark web, to support data-driven investigations and decision-making.

Our customers include law enforcement agencies and enterprise organizations across 80+ countries. Social Links is scaling rapidly with the ambition of becoming a unicorn valued at $1B+.

We are looking for a Support Engineer to join our Support team. You will own technical customer requests end-to-end: investigating product issues, troubleshooting API and access problems, and working closely with Development, Product, and Customer Success to resolve them within SLA.

Your Tasks Will Be

  • Providing timely and effective technical support to customers through the ticketing system, ensuring requests are tracked, prioritized, resolved, or escalated in accordance with established SLAs
  • Investigating and troubleshooting product-related issues: identifying potential causes, gathering relevant technical information, and documenting findings to support efficient resolution
  • Handling customer inquiries related to product functionality, API usage, account access, licenses, and other support matters
  • Collaborating with internal teams, including Development, Product, Sales, and Customer Success, to investigate issues, coordinate resolutions, and communicate updates to customers
  • Supporting internal customer-facing teams with technical guidance, product-related information, and assistance with customer requests
  • Maintaining and updating support documentation, troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles
  • Identifying recurring issues, product limitations, and customer feedback, and sharing relevant insights with internal teams to support continuous product and process improvement

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in customer or technical support, preferably in a B2B SaaS or technology environment
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, analyze customer reports, reproduce problems, and collect relevant diagnostic information
  • Basic understanding of APIs, HTTP requests, and JSON, with hands-on experience in Postman or similar tools
  • Experience working with ticketing systems (Jira, Zendesk, or similar) and following SLAs
  • Experience working with technical documentation, knowledge bases, and internal support procedures
  • Ability to prioritize requests, manage multiple tickets simultaneously, and escalate complex issues effectively
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, including developers and customer-facing departments
  • Willingness to identify process improvement opportunities and contribute ideas to enhance support workflows and service quality
  • English: B2 level or higher, with strong written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Practical experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB for basic data checks
  • Experience with Confluence and Jira as part of daily support workflows
  • Russian: B2+ level

What We Offer

  • Remote-first setup: work from anywhere in the world (excluding Russia and Belarus)
  • Predictable schedule: full-time, 5/2, with the working day starting around 12:00–13:00 CET/CEST for overlap with the team and customers
  • Real ownership from day one: your work directly affects product reliability for law enforcement and enterprise customers in 80+ countries
  • A collaborative team with a startup spirit and a clear path to grow
  • Work on a technically challenging, fast-growing product at the intersection of OSINT, AI, and cyber intelligence

We are an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment for all candidates.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Growth Director to join our leadership team in Portugal and play a key role in shaping the next phase of our growth.

This is not a traditional sales role.

Key Responsibilities

This is an opportunity to:

  • Build a scalable growth engine from the ground up

  • Drive new business and market positioning

  • Have real ownership of revenue and impact

As Growth Director, you will be responsible for:

Driving Growth Strategy

  • Define and execute a go-to-market strategy for Portugal (with future expansion to Iberia)

  • Build and evolve value propositions across B2C Omnichannel, B2B, AI, and MarTech

Building Pipeline & New Business

  • Create a strong, consistent, and qualified pipeline

  • Lead outbound initiatives and develop strategic client relationships

  • Work closely with marketing, events, and partnerships

Improving Conversion & Performance

  • Increase win rates and deal quality

  • Bring structure, discipline, and predictability to the sales process

  • Track and optimise key commercial KPIs

Leading Pre-Sales & Strategic Deals

  • Lead discovery, proposals, and strategic pitches

  • Position IMPACT as a trusted partner in complex digital initiatives

  • Collaborate with the delivery and architecture teams

Ensuring Alignment with Delivery

  • Guarantee the feasibility and quality of what is sold

  • Ensure smooth transition from sales to delivery

  • Act as a bridge between the commercial and delivery teams

YOUR PROFILE

As a Growth Director, this is what we're looking for:

  • 8+ years in business development, growth, or sales leadership

  • Strong experience in complex/consultative sales

  • Ability to engage C-level stakeholders and manage long sales cycles

  • Strategic mindset with strong execution capability

  • High ownership, accountability, and entrepreneurial mindset

Experience in Digital, E-commerce, or Omnichannel is a strong plus.

What success looks like for you as Growth Director at IMPACT Portugal:

  • Build a strong and predictable pipeline

  • Increase conversion and commercial performance

  • Deliver meaningful revenue growth

  • Establish a structured and scalable growth engine

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Remote Setup (preference for being located in Portugal)

  • Collaboration with international teams across Europe

  • Competitive base salary

  • Performance bonus aligned with both revenue and pipeline targets, and company performance

  • You will be part of the local leadership in Portugal, which means having a direct influence on how we shape and execute the company strategy.

LIFE AT IMPACT

For more than 20 years, IMPACT has pioneered some of the most advanced commerce solutions in the Nordics. What started in Aarhus, Denmark, has grown into a European powerhouse with offices across the world.

While we cover all the major tech platforms and work with some of the most exciting businesses, we make a sincere effort to stay down-to-earth. It’s who we are, and it’s the kind of talent we want to attract. We empower people and businesses to drive positive change and quality experiences, and we’re not afraid to take the lead on shaping the future of commerce.

Today, we’re a global team of digital talents working to strategize, craft, and support all things tech. We push the boundaries for commerce with curiosity, ambition, and empowerment that cement the ambition tochange commerce for the better. But it’s not all about size. Because more than anything, we want to maintain our collective can-do attitude that creates a working environment where everything is possible – and have fun while doing it.

APPLICATION

If you’re ready to take on a pivotal role in driving our success, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to join our journey in shaping the future of digital commerce!

For a more direct contact, please reach out to Cristina Silva (), our People & Culture team representative in Portugal.

• Act as a visible leader externally representing USA TODAY Co.’s product vision with partners, investors, and the broader market • Monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy • Bring external perspective from high-growth technology environments to accelerate transformation Qualifications & Experience Leadership Experience • 15+ years of progressive product leadership experience, including senior executive roles • Proven success leading product organizations in high-growth technology companies • Demonstrated impact driving product-led growth, digital transformation, and revenue expansion Industry Expertise • Strong experience in both: o Technology-driven product environments (SaaS, platforms, marketplaces, or digital ecosystems) o Media, content, or digital publishing companies with scaled audiences Functional Expertise • Deep expertise across: o Product strategy and roadmap development o Customer experience and user-centered design o Data, analytics, and experimentation frameworks o Monetization models (subscription, advertising, data-driven products) • Proven ability to align product, technology, and commercial strategies Leadership Capabilities • Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen • Exceptional cross-functional leader with ability to influence at executive and board levels • Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams and organizations • Comfort operating in complex, fast-changing environments with competing priorities Personal Attributes • Visionary and growth-oriented, with an entrepreneurial mindset • Customer-obsessed with strong intuition for user needs and product-market fit • Data-driven decision-maker with bias for action and experimentation • Highly collaborative, capable of aligning diverse stakeholders • Resilient, adaptable, and energized by large-scale transformation and change

The annualized base salary for this role will range between $450,000 and $480,000. Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Build a creator partnerships program for a leading wellness brand. Work with influencers, negotiate deals and turn content into ads. Remote | Full-time | Reports to Head of Growth

PaleoHacks is one of the largest wellness platforms online, dedicated to helping people live healthier lives through paleo and keto nutrition. From cookbooks and meal plans to recipes and practical tips, we've supported millions on their health journeys.

We're a remote-first company with a small, talented team of 16 full-time team members spread across the globe. With five growing brands under our umbrella, we're now doubling down on data because better reporting leads to better decisions and even bigger growth.

We're looking for a Partnership Manager to build our creator partnerships program from the ground up, starting on Facebook and Instagram and expanding to TikTok and TikTok Shop. You'll create a steady flow of creator content our growth team can test and scale as paid ads, both from the brand pages and as whitelisted ads through creators' own handles. This is a hands-on, manager level role for someone who understands the strategy behind a successful partnerships program, can execute it themselves and works autonomously.

📋 Build and run influencer, creator and ambassador programs from scratch, including outreach, recruiting and long-term relationships

✏️ Structure and negotiate partner deals: rates, commissions, fees, incentives, exclusivity and deliverables

💡 Secure usage rights so creator content can run as ads from the brand pages and as whitelisted ads through creators' own handles

💻 Manage creator content across paid social in partnership with the Head of Growth and media buying team

📊 Set goals and KPIs for the program, track partner and content performance, and scale what works

🧪 Choose and run the right influencer marketing platforms and tools

📦 Expand the program to TikTok and TikTok Shop, and later build a creator-driven affiliate marketing program

🎓 Keep a pulse on social media trends and what creator content is performing right now

Requirements

To be successful in this role, you need:

✅ Proven, hands-on experience building a creator or influencer program, ideally from scratch

✅ Track record structuring and negotiating influencer, creator and ambassador agreements (rates, commissions, usage rights, exclusivity, deliverables)

✅ Tested processes and templates you can bring in to scale quickly, rather than learning on the job

✅ Experience with whitelisting and running creator content as paid ads

✅ Hands-on experience with influencer marketing platforms and tools

✅ Strategic understanding of what makes a creator program succeed: platforms, goals, KPIs and consistently hitting targets

✅ Able to work autonomously and own the program end to end

Brownie points for:

⭐ Experience with direct-response and email affiliate networks and platforms such as ClickBank, Everflow and BuyGoods

⭐ TikTok and TikTok Shop creator program experience

⭐ Experience building a creator-driven affiliate program

⭐ Health, wellness, supplements or other DTC consumer brand experience

⭐ Experience working alongside media buyers on Meta ad performance

The ideal candidate is a builder, excited to create a program from scratch rather than run an existing one. A hands-on doer who rolls up their sleeves and executes, not someone who only sets direction. Strategic thinking matters: they can explain the "why" behind their decisions and back it up with numbers. As a self-starter, they work autonomously, take full ownership and don't need to be managed day to day. Natural relationship builders are warm and personable with creators, but confident and firm in negotiations. Results-driven, they're motivated by hitting targets and seeing their content perform as ads. Curiosity and trend awareness keep them watching what's working on social right now. Organisation and reliability matter, with processes that let the program scale. Comfortable working async with a US team, they pick up requests at the end of the LA day and show progress by the next morning. They thrive in a fast-moving growth team where priorities shift based on performance.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?

💰 3,500 USD per month*

💼 Full-time

🌍 Fully remote

🌴 Unlimited PTO (including public holidays). We trust you to get the job done

🤒 Paid sick leave

📅 At least 4 hours of daily overlap with 8am-2pm US Mountain Time (core hours), with flexibility for real life

💬 Async-first culture - Slack with one weekly video call

📊 Clear scoreboard tied to real P&L

📚 Detailed documentation, recorded context, and AI-generated briefs provided for the handover

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Medical Billing & Patient Accounts Specialist – Bilingual (Filipino / Spanish) with specialized, hands-on expertise in athenaOne (AthenaHealth) billing and revenue cycle workflows.

In this position, you will be responsible for managing end-to-end claim follow-ups, resolving claim holds, tracking unpaid or denied claims, and serving as the primary point of contact for patients calling with billing, statement, or balance inquiries. Because AthenaHealth integrates billing directly into its EHR platform, candidate fluency with Athena's Collector module, claim status rules, and hold queues is strictly required on day one.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Claim Follow-Up & Denial Resolution (Athena Collector)

  • Monitor and manage daily athenaOne billing worklists, claim hold queues, and claim status dashboards.
  • Research, correct, and resubmit unpaid, rejected, or denied claims with commercial insurance payers, Medicare, and Medicaid.
  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs) directly within Athena to resolve claim discrepancies and process appeals.

2. Patient Billing & Inbound Phone Support

  • Answer inbound patient phone calls regarding billing statements, account balances, co-pays, deductibles, and co-insurance.
  • Clearly and empathetically explain medical bills, charge breakdowns, and insurance coverage decisions to patients over the phone.
  • Set up approved patient payment plans, process phone payments, and resolve patient billing disputes directly within Athena.

3. Account Reconciliation & Charge Auditing

  • Review patient account ledgers in Athena to verify proper insurance payment posting and patient balance adjustments.
  • Identify recurring billing errors or payer rules to help streamline practice revenue cycle management.
  • Maintain clear, thorough documentation of all insurance follow-up attempts and patient call interactions in the patient chart.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • AthenaHealth Mastery (Non-Negotiable): Direct, recent hands-on experience using athenaOne / AthenaHealth billing modules (Athena Collector, Claim Worklists, Hold Queues, Patient Statements).
  • Medical Billing Experience: Minimum 2+ years of U.S. medical billing, accounts receivable (A/R) follow-up, and insurance denial management experience.
  • Patient Accounts & Phone Skills: Proven background handling inbound patient billing calls with exceptional telephone etiquette, conflict resolution skills, and spoken English clarity.
  • Revenue Cycle Literacy: Strong knowledge of CPT/ICD-10 coding rules, modifiers, EOB/ERA interpretation, and payer-specific authorization guidelines.
  • Technical Setup: Dedicated, quiet home office, noise-canceling headset, high-speed internet, and familiarity with web-based VOIP phone systems.

ALTEN Mexico is a subsidiary of the ALTEN Group, a global leader in engineering and technology consulting.

The Body Design and Release Engineer (D&R) in the Closures division will be responsible for designing, developing, and releasing structural and mechanical components for Stamped Doors in vehicles, ensuring compliance with quality, safety, functionality, and cost standards. This role will collaborate closely with manufacturing and testing teams, as well as suppliers, to ensure that designs are feasible, comply with automotive regulations, and meet product performance requirements.
