À propos de nous

Nesto Cloud est la plateforme technologique hypothécaire de bout en bout, native du cloud et propulsée par l'IA au Canada. Elle aide les institutions financières à moderniser le prêt grâce à l'automatisation intelligente par l'IA, à sa technologie propriétaire d'IA et de cloud, ainsi qu'à des solutions d'impartition des processus d'affaires (BPO).

Soutenus par l'écosystème du Groupe Nesto, nous transformons des décennies d'expertise hypothécaire en une technologie de pointe qui réduit les coûts d'exploitation hypothécaire, accélère le processus de prêt, renforce la conformité et offre des expériences exceptionnelles aux prêteurs comme aux emprunteurs.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le chef de file canadien des solutions technologiques et de financement hypothécaire, gérant plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux. Privilégié par plusieurs des plus grandes institutions financières du pays, nous combinons plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA pour façonner l'avenir du prêt.

Grâce à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le secteur résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers et le secteur commercial multi-résidentiel. Reconnu parmi les entreprises du palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, nous continuons de faire évoluer l'industrie grâce à l'innovation, la technologie et des solutions axées sur le client.

Exploitant nos activités à travers notre famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, notre mission est de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien du futur et de créer un véritable champion canadien des technologies de prêt et des services financiers. Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez Nesto Cloud

Chez Nesto Cloud, vous bâtirez l'avenir du prêt aux côtés de certains des meilleurs développeurs, ingénieurs en IA et experts en prêt hypothécaire du pays. Vous travaillerez avec une pile technologique moderne et des cadres de développement propulsés par l'IA conçus pour vous aider à innover, à développer vos compétences et à accélérer votre carrière.

À propos du rôle

Le/La Gestionnaire, sécurité GRC (Gouvernance, Risques et Conformité) détient la responsabilité de bout en bout du programme de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de conformité de nesto. Nous avons bâti des fondations solides et automatisé une grande partie de nos flux de travail de conformité ; votre rôle sera d'élever ce programme vers une exécution de calibre mondial. Vous optimiserez nos systèmes automatisés, affinerez nos processus de préparation aux audits, renforcerez la rigueur de la gouvernance des politiques, consoliderez la discipline de gestion des risques et ferez évoluer les flux de travail d'évaluation des fournisseurs. Vous prendrez un programme fonctionnel pour le rendre exceptionnel, résilient et répétable.

  • Assumer la gouvernance des politiques de sécurité et la cartographie des contrôles à travers les cadres de conformité de nesto (SOC 1/2, ISO 27001 et cadres réglementaires applicables).
  • Faire mûrir notre programme de conformité automatisé afin de passer à l'échelle de manière durable au rythme de la croissance de nesto. Optimiser notre plateforme GRC et nos outils d'automatisation pour des flux de travail en libre-service, tout en éliminant progressivement la préparation manuelle aux audits.
  • Élever la qualité du programme d'audits externes de nesto tout en élargissant continuellement son portée à mesure que l'entreprise prend de l'expansion.
  • Faire évoluer le cadre de gouvernance de l'IA chez nesto, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de conformité, en passant des politiques fondamentales à des contrôles de niveau entreprise permettant le déploiement et l'utilisation interne rapides et sécurisés de fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA.
  • Transformer la gestion des risques en un conseiller stratégique pour l'entreprise. Collaborer avec les responsables des unités d'affaires pour faire évoluer nos analyses de risques, relier les constatations techniques aux impacts commerciaux et permettre à la direction de faire des compromis éclairés en toute confiance.
  • Mettre à l'échelle les évaluations de sécurité des fournisseurs et des clients. Faire évoluer les flux de travail de prise en charge, perfectionner l'automatisation des questionnaires et renforcer la façon dont nous communiquons notre posture de sécurité aux prospects et clients d'envergure.
  • Diriger et développer une équipe GRC qui élève les standards d'excellence technique, approfondit les compétences dans les disciplines de gouvernance et de gestion des risques, et favorise la responsabilisation à travers toutes les initiatives.
  • Renforcer la résilience de l'organisation grâce à des cadres de continuité des affaires et de reprise après sinistre évolués et régulièrement testés, assurant la confiance opérationnelle de nesto en période de crise.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en GRC, audit, gestion des risques ou conformité dans des secteurs réglementés (services financiers, SaaS, santé).
  • Excellente maîtrise des cadres et des audits SOC 1, SOC 2 et NIST.
  • Solides connaissances des méthodologies d'évaluation des risques et des opérations de conformité.
  • Expérience pratique avec les plateformes d'automatisation GRC.
  • Excellentes compétences en gestion de projet, en engagement des parties prenantes et en collaboration transversale.
  • Fortes capacités de rédaction ; aptitude à communiquer clairement les concepts de politiques et de contrôles à des auditoires techniques et non techniques.
  • Capacité à influencer la direction grâce à des analyses de risques basées sur des données probantes et des perspectives alignées sur les objectifs d'affaires.
  • L'anglais est requis pour la rédaction et la documentation. La maîtrise du français (parlé et lu) constitue un atout majeur.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.

  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. raw.description:
About Us

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.
With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

The Role

Creative Solutions now owns execution from end to end, so strategy has to cover the whole span: pre-sale (discovery, ideation, proposals) and post-sale (kickoff strategy, campaign briefs, post-campaign insights). As a Strategist on this team, you’ll shape the idea that wins the pitch and stay with it until it ships, performs, and turns into a renewal. Our goal is simple: the idea that wins the pitch is the idea that ships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the core insight and creative idea, plus the integrated plan behind it: creators, media and distribution, and measurement
  • Build proposals and RFP responses with a clear, data-backed case for #paid
  • Set the creator mix: when to scale with micro and niche creators, when to concentrate on macro names, and how to combine both
  • Build the investment plan, splitting budget across organic content, usage rights and paid amplification, and set channel mix and flighting
  • Define KPIs and benchmarks up front, optimize in flight, and turn results into renewal stories
  • Stay involved post-sale with creator briefs, content direction, and strategic QA
  • Stay ahead of market and platform changes, and translate them into sharper proposal work
  • Contribute to proactive packages and first-to-market moments
  • This person covers the whole creator-campaign lifecycle, from pre-sale ideation through post-campaign insights, with a stronger emphasis on creator mix, budget planning, and measurement
  • Lead strategy on priority enterprise accounts and act as the strategic counterpart to client partner teams in client meetings
  • Own the measurement plan in partnership with our Measurement team, Sales, Paid Media & Client Experience
  • Mentor Senior Strategists and set quality standards for decks and briefs. This is a player-coach role.

To Be Successful, You'll Need

  • Deliver integrated ideas that ship and perform
  • Use data to sharpen an idea rather than decorate it
  • Plan and defend budget allocations across paid social
  • Design measurement plans and act on performance data
  • Communicate strategy clearly in writing and in client presentations
  • Design and build decks with strong visual and narrative craft
  • Use AI tools to inform research and accelerate the creative process
  • Manage several projects at once under tight deadlines
  • Own ambiguous, high-stakes proposals independently, and drive decisions across functions without formal authority

About You

  • 8+ years in brand, creative, social, or creator strategy (or equivalent demonstrated experience), with a portfolio of ideas that shipped and performed
  • A record of winning pitches with integrated plans
  • Deep fluency in TikTok, Meta/Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, and Snapchat, and in how creators actually work
  • Credibility with senior client stakeholders, and strong writing and presentation skills
  • Preferred: enterprise or Fortune 500 clients, regulated categories, social search or AEO experience, and agency or platform experience working across creative and media teams

Equal Employment Opportunity

#paid is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented individuals and creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their best and authentic selves to work.
If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the Role

We are looking for a People Operations Coordinator to manage day-to-day HR operations for employees across multiple countries.

You will work across payroll, EOR and HR vendors, onboarding and offboarding, employee records, and local employment requirements. The role currently supports approximately 15-20 countries and will expand as BJAK grows into new markets.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage monthly payroll operations across multiple countries, including payroll inputs, changes, deductions, validation and reconciliation.

  • Coordinate with EOR, payroll and HR service providers to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.

  • Manage employee onboarding, contract changes, transfers and offboarding across different countries.

  • Maintain accurate employee records, employment documents and HR system data.

  • Manage day-to-day EOR and HR vendor operations, including employee cases, invoices, service issues and escalations.

  • Research employment requirements in new and existing markets, including payroll, statutory benefits, leave, termination and employment compliance.

  • Maintain country-specific HR documentation, processes and SOPs.

  • Identify payroll, employment or operational issues and work with internal teams and vendors to resolve them.

What You Will Need

  • 2+ years of experience in HR operations, payroll, people operations or a related role.

  • Experience supporting employees across multiple countries is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with payroll, EOR providers or international HR vendors is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling payroll, employee data and employment documentation.

  • Ability to research local employment requirements and turn them into clear processes and documentation.

  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills and experience working with HR systems.

  • Good written and spoken English.

  • Ability to manage multiple countries, vendors and deadlines at the same time.

Te whiwhinga mahi: The opportunity

If you're a registered health professional and endorsed Health Improvement Practitioner (HIP) who thrives on making an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you. As part of our supportive virtual team, you'll connect with tāngata by video and phone, offering brief, focused interventions that help them take positive steps for their mental, physical and social wellbeing.

This role is fully remote, you can be based anywhere in Aotearoa New Zealand, working from home. We supply all the equipment you need (laptop, additional monitor and headset) along with access to the systems to set up your home workspace. You will stay connected through day-to-day virtual teamwork, with regular face-to-face contact with your team and the practices and communities we support where practicable (some travel within the Pinnacle network will be required). Full-time or part-time hours will be considered.

You'll be a valued member of primary care teams within an integrated care model, supporting clinics, and whānau in rural and remote communities to improve hauora, access, and choice, wherever they live.

What you will do:

  • Work as a generalist, seeing people of any age via video and phone, providing evidence-based brief behavioural health interventions with meaningful, high-volume impact.
  • Provide timely, warm handover appointments with practice teams including same-day virtual contacts where possible.
  • Follow virtual care protocols for consent, privacy, identity, risk assessment and escalation.
  • Actively participate in primary care teams virtually and through regular face-to-face visits
    building team capability in behavioural health, mental health and addictions.
  • Help plan and run virtual therapeutic groups, clinical pathways and internal education sessions.
  • Use data to continually improve service delivery at individual, practice and population levels.

He kōrero mōu: About you

  • Registered health professional with a current practising certificate (e.g. psychologist, nurse, psychotherapist, counsellor, occupational therapist, or social worker).
  • Completed HIP training, endorsed as a HIP, with experience working as a HIP in a practice setting.
  • Experience in therapeutic approaches such as Kaupapa Māori approaches, ACT, MI, FACT or CBT.
  • Clinical experience delivering evidence-based psychological interventions in a health setting.
  • Confidence building rapport and engaging tangata effectively by video and phone.
  • Cultural responsiveness, a commitment to health equity, and knowledge of Te Tiriti o Waitangi.
  • Strong self-motivation and organisation to work autonomously from home while staying connected to a virtual team.
  • A current full New Zealand driver's licence and access to reliable internet and a private, safe home space for confidential clinical work.
  • Telehealth/virtual service experience is desirable.

Mō tō mātou rōpū: About the team

Pinnacle has made an explicit commitment to Māori and our communities to improve equity of health and wellbeing, in accordance with Te Tiriti o Waitangi. We have also made an equity commitment to our Pasifika population.

Visit  to find out more about the Pinnacle group.

Libra Solutions helps simplify and ease the burden of legal processes for plaintiffs, heirs, and the attorneys and doctors who serve them. Together, under the Libra Solutions banner, we support a nationwide network of more than 45,000 attorneys and 10,000 healthcare providers – creating a powerful platform to deliver faster, more seamless outcomes for our customers.

CMS Integration Specialist

Libra Solutions is seeking a skilled CMS Integration Specialist to support and scale integrations between MoveDocs and leading Case Management Systems (CMS) such as Litify, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, CasePeer, and others.

  • Manage the full lifecycle of CMS integrations from initial demo through activation through go-live and post go-live follow-up.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for law firms at and after integration on their MoveDocs integration.

  • Troubleshoot basic integration issues and escalate technical matters appropriately
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering to support enhancements and feedback loops
  • Track integration metrics, appointment volume impact, and platform utilization trends
  • Maintain clear documentation of integration workflows and best practices

Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work cross-functionally

raw.title: Applied AI Engineer
raw.excerpt: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast.
raw.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We’re building a cutting-edge AI team, and this role is for an engineer who wants to apply AI to real problems in energy. As an Applied AI Engineer, you’ll help build our Product Factory: an agentic pipeline that takes software from requirements and design through code review, deployment and monitoring, with human review where the risk calls for it.

You’ll also ship customer-facing features using VLMs and LLMs, and build AI tools and agents that make teams across Fuse more productive, from customer support to warehouses and back office. This is an applied engineering role, not pure research: you’ll own what you build, from spec to production.

Responsibilities

  • Ship AI features for customers, such as personalised energy recommendations and onboarding from an energy bill.
  • Build LLM applications and agents for support, engineering, warehouse and back-office teams, including multi-agent systems and durable workflows (e.g. Temporal).
  • Build the engineering around them: cloud infrastructure, integrations, and access control so users and agents only reach what they should.
  • Own evaluation: datasets, golden answers, human and LLM judges, A/B tests. Know whether a change genuinely helped.
  • Choose models by performance, latency and cost, and revisit as models improve.
  • Work with trading, operations and backend teams so models reflect real-time market conditions, energy pricing and demand and weather forecasts.
  • Monitor AI systems in production and keep them reliable.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience, with requirements varying by role level.
  • Experience owning an applied AI system end to end, ideally in a startup or small team, and able to explain what broke and how you knew it worked.
  • A software engineer who moved into applied AI, or an ML engineer who writes production code. We value both.
  • Strong Python (or similar) and experience deploying LLMs or VLMs into production.
  • Solid understanding of cloud technologies, containerisation and scalable AI applications.
  • Analytical, rigorous and quick to learn. You don’t need our exact tools, just the ability to pick them up.
  • Bonus: PyTorch or TensorFlow; forecasting, weather and demand modelling; energy markets and trading; fine-tuning or RL; vision, document or NLP pipelines; agent runtimes.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
  • Biannual bonus scheme
  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs
  • Private health insurance
  • Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits may vary by location.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

  • Reporting to: Manager, Regional Support & Technical Account Management
  • Travel expectations: up to ~40% (variably in-country and across Benelux, Nordics, and Baltics)
  • Location: working remotely unless you are travelling to customer sites

Your Impact

As the Deployment Engineer, you will be tasked with driving customer success and technical adoption of Axon products and solutions, with the objective of grant a successful adoption and use of our technology for the Public Safety and adjacent sectors in the region. Axon is seeking professionals that can work at the tactical level and drive a successful adoption through persistence and execution.

Your Day to Day

  • Become the dedicated technical expert across the Axon ecosystem, maintaining deep knowledge of both current and expanding product deployments.
  • Serve as a technical liaison between Axon, the customer, and any strategic delivery partners.
  • Follow-up on all requests submitted from customers.
  • Work with the sales team to support existing customers.
  • Manage tickets and RMA and work with internal teams from the identify of an issue and through the entire life cycle of the adoption.
  • Travel may be required, up to 40%, nationally and internationally.
  • Coordinate and schedule regular calls with existing customers.
  • Focus on customer loyalty
  • Proactively look out for customers’ business, suggesting new and innovative ways to keep them succeeding with Axon products
  • Facilitate integration with existing customer platforms.
  • Installation and commissioning

What You’ll Bring

  • Fluent Dutch and English written and verbal communication skills is essential.
  • Tactically focused on managing customer success adoption.
  • Mission driven mentality, highly motivated, with a drive to execute on tasks.
  • Strong technical foundation including working knowledge of:
    • Enterprise networking including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
    • SaaS platforms, cloud applications, APIs, identity management, authentication, and enterprise software administration.
    • Windows environments, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise endpoint management concepts.
    • Integration patterns, system interoperability, and enterprise application ecosystems.
    • Technical troubleshooting across software, networking, configuration, and infrastructure domains.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

raw.description:
Position Summary:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, focused on changing the management of disease in reproductive health, oncology, and organ transplantation. Signatera is a personalized, tumor-informed test for molecular residual disease (MRD) assessment and surveillance monitoring in patients previously diagnosed with cancer.

The Associate Director / Director of Product Management, Signatera Heme will own the product strategy and roadmap for Signatera in hematologic malignancies, starting with multiple myeloma and lymphomas. This person will work in a highly matrixed environment with the Foresight BU, R&D, Lab Operations, Software Engineering, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Business Development, and Regulatory. The role combines product management, market entry as a laboratory developed test (LDT), evidence generation, analytics, and clinical trial product support, including trials run under IUO and IVD pathways.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute the Signatera product roadmap for hematologic malignancies, beginning with multiple myeloma and lymphomas (for example, DLBCL, follicular, mantle cell, and Hodgkin lymphoma) and extending to additional heme indications.
  • Lead market entry planning for Signatera in heme as a laboratory developed test (LDT), including clinical validation requirements, CLIA and state requirements, market access/reimbursement and payer considerations, and launch readiness with Lab Operations, Regulatory, Medical, commercial and Marketing.
  • Define product requirements for blood-based malignancies with R&D, Lab Operations, and Software Engineering, including assay, sample type, workflow, and reporting needs.
  • Lead product support for clinical trials using Signatera in heme, including IUO use in studies with pharma and academic partners, and the path toward IVD and regulated use.
  • Partner with Regulatory, Clinical, and Business Development on trial start-up, study requirements, and pharma and companion diagnostic opportunities.
  • Build product performance metrics and dashboards. Analyze test volume, adoption, ordering patterns, turnaround time, and retention. Use the results to prioritize improvements.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs and Clinical on evidence generation strategy and execution. Areas of collaboration include identifying clinical gaps, designing studies, working with investigators and trial partners, and planning publications and congress presentations.
  • Guide product development for Signatera Genome in heme, including whole genome sequencing technology, phased variants, and structural variants. Work with R&D and Bioinformatics to define how these features improve tumor tracking and MRD sensitivity in heme malignancies.
  • Conduct Voice of Customer interviews, market research, and competitive and market intelligence in hematologic oncology.
  • Engage with key opinion leaders, advisory boards, and congresses (for example, ASH, EHA, and ASCO). Gather insights to guide product decisions.
  • Work with Marketing on product positioning, launch plans, pricing, and key collateral.
  • Build business cases and financial models to support product initiatives.
  • Present strategy, progress, and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, statistics, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, or MBA) preferred.
  • 5+ years (7+ preferred) of experience in product management, product marketing, or market analytics at a diagnostics, biotech, or pharmaceutical company.
  • Hematologic oncology experience is strongly preferred, especially multiple myeloma and lymphoma.
  • Working knowledge of oncology molecular testing, next-generation sequencing (NGS), and biomarkers, including NGS bioinformatic workflows (e.g., variant calling, filtering, and interpretation) and genomic data analysis. MRD experience preferred.
  • Experience with data analysis. SQL, Snowflake, or similar tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with a high complexity molecular laboratory, including cfDNA or plasma workflows, is a plus.
  • In depth knowledge of whole genome sequencing and variant types, including structural variants, single nucleotide variants, and phased variants, is preferred.
  • Experience with clinical trials. Experience in IUO and IVD regulated environments is required.
  • Experience bringing a molecular test to market as an LDT, including clinical validation and laboratory requirements.
  • Experience designing or supporting clinical evidence generation, such as clinical validation studies, retrospective studies, or prospective trials.
  • Prior KOL engagement and external customer facing experience preferred.
  • 30-40% travel for advisory boards, congresses, and customer meetings.

Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities:

Technical

  • Understanding of MRD in multiple myeloma and lymphomas, including how blood-based MRD testing fits withing current bone marrow and imaging-based MRD assessment paradigms.
  • Understanding of how somatic variants are detected in whole genome sequencing and how they support MRD tracking in heme tumors.
  • Understanding of LDT market entry requirements and the evidence needed for clinical adoption and payer coverage.
  • Ability to translate customer and clinical needs into clear product requirements.
  • Strong analytical skills. Able to build metrics, interpret data, and present findings.
  • Basic financial modeling skills.
  • Proficiency with MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Behavioral

  • Ability to lead without authority and influence cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills and ability to function effectively in a highly matrixed cross functional environment.
  • Ability to explain complex topics simply (biomarkers, multiple indications, regulatory pathways).
  • Strong customer focus, including building relationships with thought leaders.
  • Strong organization and time management. Able to manage several projects at once and meet tight deadlines.
  • Flexibility between fast development and quality standards.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with senior leadership.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

Duties are typically performed in a [remote home office / hybrid office] setting. This position requires the ability to use a computer keyboard, communicate over the telephone and computer, and read printed material. Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends) at times. While the position may be based anywhere in the United States, availability during Pacific time hours is required and site based presence in San Carlos CA, Boulder CO, or Austin TX is preferred.

Travel required for this position: 30-40% (advisory boards, congresses, customer meetings).

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$180,300—$230,900 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Position Summary...

Last Mile Delivery sits at the center of how we win with customers—and it’s undergoing a fundamental transformation. As expectations for speed, precision, and reliability rise, and the gig economy continues to evolve, we are re-architecting delivery from the ground up using advanced optimization, real-time decisioning, and applied AI at massive scale.

We’re looking for a Group Director of Product Management to lead Last Mile Optimization & AI—the intelligence layer that powers every critical decision across our delivery ecosystem. This leader will own the platforms that determine how work is created, priced, matched, routed, and fulfilled—continuously balancing speed, cost, and experience across millions of real-time decisions. Unlike traditional marketplaces, this system must also incorporate real-time store operations—where variability in picking, readiness, and substitutions directly impacts delivery performance.

This role requires evolving a live, large-scale system—improving cost, reliability, and speed today while re-architecting for the future through better optimization, data foundations, and decisioning systems.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of marketplace dynamics, large-scale optimization, and operational complexity.

What you'll do...

  • Define the future of last mile:Set and drive the vision and strategy for optimization and AI acrosspricing, matching, batching, routing, and store-aware decisioning—incorporating real-time operational signals from storesand drivers.
  • Own the intelligence layer:Build and scale horizontal AI platforms that power real-time,high-stakesdecisioning across the entireecosystem,including the underlying data foundations, consistent metrics, governance, and shared signals that ensure reliable and aligned decision-making across systems.
  • Operate and evolve a live system: Improve cost, reliability, and speed in an already scaled system—balancing short-term performance with long-term architectural evolution, while accounting for real-world variability in store operations.
  • Partner to push the frontier:Work closely with Engineering and Data Science todeliver scalable, explainable, and continuously improving optimization and ML systems in production environments.
  • Balancea dynamic marketplace:Optimizeacomplex, multi-sided ecosystem across customers, drivers, and store operations—balancing driver earnings, cost efficiency, and service reliability.
  • Lead at scale:Grow and develop a high-performing team of product leaders, raising the bar on product craft, clarity, and execution.
  • Create alignment in complexity:Drive focus and prioritization across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Business teams.
  • Solve at massive scale: Tackle challenges like real-time responsiveness, signal quality, and marketplace volatility across millions of daily decisions—including working with noisy or incomplete data, non-stationary demand, and tightly coupled system dynamics.
  • Drive high-stakes prioritization:Make clear, high-quality tradeoffs between foundational improvements, optimization gains, and new capabilities in a highly constrained and dynamic environment.
  • Influence the business:Partner with senior leadership to shape investment strategy, articulate tradeoffs, and guide one of the company’s most critical growth engines.

WhatYou’llBring...

Deep understanding of model limitations in production and the ability to design systems that account for feedback loops and unintended consequences.
  • Strong product strategy and prioritization:Demonstratedability to define clear direction,sequenceinvestments, and make difficult tradeoffs in complex, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with operations:Experience partnering closely with operations teams to ensure systems reflect real-world constraints and drive measurable execution improvements.
  • Comfort with ambiguity:Ability to navigate and lead in environments where tradeoffs between speed, cost, and experience are constant and dynamic.
  • Executive presence:Exceptional communication, influence, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Sharp product instincts:Systems thinker with strong judgment and the ability to translate complexity intoclear, actionable strategy.

This role directly shapes how millions of deliveries happen every day—impacting customer satisfaction, driver experience, and the efficiency of one of the largest marketplaces in the world. The platforms you lead will define how we scale intelligently, compete effectively, and innovate in last-mile delivery.

About the role
As Business Development Manager, North America, you will play a key role in expanding Micropol's business across the region. Working closely with colleagues in both the U.S. and Sweden, you will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, growing strategic customer relationships, and strengthening our distributor network.

You will focus on markets including defence, critical infrastructure, industrial applications, and telecommunications, with particular emphasis on the defence sector.

This is a hands-on and commercially driven role where you will own the sales process from prospecting and opportunity development through negotiations, implementation, and long-term relationship management.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Identifying and developing new business opportunities throughout North America.

  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, distributors, and strategic partners.

  • Driving sales activities throughout the entire customer journey.

  • Developing existing accounts while actively pursuing new business opportunities.

  • Providing market feedback to support product development and business strategy.

  • Managing customer information and sales activities within CRM systems.

  • Planning and participating in trade shows, industry events, and customer visits.

  • Contributing to the development and improvement of sales and marketing processes.

This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the United States. Travel is required, primarily within North America and occasionally to Europe. You will report to the Regional Sales Manager, based in Cleveland, Ohio.

Who you are
You are an ambitious and relationship-oriented sales professional who enjoys creating business opportunities and building long-term partnerships. You combine commercial drive with a genuine interest in technology and are comfortable working with customers in technically demanding industries. You are proactive, self-motivated, and capable of managing your territory independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues across functions and geographies. As a person, you are professional, trustworthy, and driven by delivering value to customers and results for the business.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management.

  • Experience managing customer relationships and driving business growth.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience within defence, critical infrastructure, industrial technology, telecommunications, or related industries.

  • Technical background or experience selling technical products and solutions.

  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Valid driver's license.

  • Willingness to travel throughout North America.

Preferred:

  • Knowledge of fiber optic technology.

  • Experience with public procurement or government-related sales processes.

What we offer
At Micropol, you will become part of an innovative and growing technology company with more than 30 years of industry expertise. We offer a culture characterized by openness, responsibility, and mutual respect, where every employee contributes to our success and continued growth.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary and commission structure.

  • Comprehensive benefits package.

  • A high degree of flexibility and autonomy.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • International collaboration with colleagues and customers across multiple markets.

  • The chance to make a significant impact on our expansion in North America.

Micropol Fiberoptic AB is Sweden's leading specialist in passive fiber optic solutions and the oldest company of its kind in the country. For more than three decades, we have developed advanced fiber optic products and solutions for customers with demanding requirements regarding quality, performance, and reliability.

Through unique design and manufacturing capabilities, we deliver innovative solutions that support critical applications worldwide. As part of our continued international expansion, you will join our U.S. subsidiary, Micropol Fiberoptic Inc., and help shape the next phase of our growth journey.

Apply today and become part of Micropol's continued success. We look forward to hearing from you.

Role Purpose

Ensure the linguistic and phonetic quality of Omilia’s multilingual Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems by designing phoneme inventories, developing lexicons, and reviewing audio corpora to support enterprise-grade voice experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Autonomy: Independently conduct phonological and phonetic analysis, design phoneme inventories, and develop lexicons for multiple languages.
  • Scope & Complexity: Responsible for linguistic quality across all supported languages in TTS, including handling underrepresented phenomena and complex language-specific features.
  • Impact: Directly influences the naturalness, accuracy, and quality of Omilia’s TTS output, impacting customer experience in global contact center deployments.
  • Influence/Mentorship: Collaborates with TTS engineers, data scientists, and ML researchers; coordinates with native-speaker reviewers and external annotation pipelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct systematic phonological and phonetic analysis of the Canadian French and Canadian English languages.
  • Document language-specific features (prosody, stress, tone, coarticulation, dialect variation).
  • Produce structured language profiles for TTS model training and evaluation.
  • Define and maintain phoneme inventories; map to IPA and TTS-specific conventions.
  • Corpus audits and optimal audio references selections for TTS target voice tuning
  • Build and maintain pronunciation lexicons, including G2P rules and exceptions.
  • Review and correct machine-generated G2P outputs; conduct pronunciation audits.
  • Annotate audio corpora, develop evaluation protocols, and produce error analyses.
  • Define linguistic criteria for TTS corpus selection and design prompts for data collection.
  • Collaborate with TTS engineers to integrate linguistic artefacts into synthesis pipelines.
  • Contribute to internal documentation and participate in research discussions.

Requirements

  • M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Linguistics, Phonetics, Computational Linguistics, or related field.
  • Proven experience building pronunciation lexicons or G2P systems for TTS or ASR.
  • Deep knowledge of phonological theory, articulatory and acoustic phonetics.
  • Proficiency with IPA and at least one machine-readable phoneme notation system (X-SAMPA, ARPAbet, etc.).
  • Experience with corpus annotation tools (Praat, ELAN, WebAnno, etc.).
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills.
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in at least one additional language relevant to Omilia’s markets.
  • Technical skills: Praat, ELAN, Audacity, PLS/CMUdict/SSML lexicon formats, Phonetisaurus/Sequitur/neural G2P, basic Python or shell scripting, TTS text normalization.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;

  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;
  • Apple gear.

About OnPay

OnPay is a fast-growing software company headquartered in Atlanta, offering a modern cloud-based payroll, HR, and benefits solution for small to midsize businesses. We’re currently seeking talented and curious individuals to join our team. We want to hear from you if you are interested in joining an exciting and fast-growing company!

Learn more at

We’re on a mission to combine excellent client service with payroll expertise and superb technology — and we are scaling fast as we’ve just raised $100 million in growth funding led by Carrick Capital Partners.

The Role

We are looking for a high-judgment, process-driven Financial Operations Managerto lead our Money Movement and Payroll Settlement team. In this role, you will own the engine of our business: ensuring funds are debited from client accounts accurately and delivered into the bank accounts of thousands of workers seamlessly and on time.

You will manage a daily operational team, oversee multi-million-dollar banking and ACH transmission workflows, lead exception handling (returns, reversals, NSF, and disputes), and partner directly with Risk Operations and banking partners to scale our treasury and clearing infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of Financial Operations Specialists responsible for day-to-day payroll funding, direct deposit transmission, and exception processing.

  • Oversee end-to-end clearing timelines across multiple banking rails (Same-Day ACH, Standard ACH, Wire, RTP, and FedNow).

  • Ensure critical cut-off deadlines (Federal Reserve / ODFI / RDFI windows) are met with zero tolerance for delayed worker payroll disbursements.

  • Monitor real-time account balances, debit settlements, credit batches, and intraday clearing files (NACHA, ISO 20022, proprietary bank APIs).

  • Own the operational resolution of ACH returns (e.g., R01 NSF, R08 stop payment, R03 unauthorized account), credit reversals, trace requests, and payroll adjustments.

  • Implement proactive fraud, exposure, and NSF-monitoring protocols to mitigate credit risk between debit settlement and credit disbursement.

  • Serve as the senior point of escalation for high-value funding failures, off-cycle emergency payroll runs, and banking transmission disruptions.

  • Maintain daily three-way reconciliation across client payroll records, internal ledger balances, and bank statements.

  • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Treasury to track settlement float, collateral accounts, and clearing reserves.

  • Design and enforce strict operational controls (Maker-Checker protocols, dual authorization, and change-log auditing) in compliance with SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, and NACHA rules.

  • Partner closely with Product and Core Platform Engineering to translate manual financial workflows into automated software tools.

  • Drive root-cause analyses on recurring transaction failures, latency issues, or bank API errors to continuously improve straight-through processing (STP) rates.

  • Maintain relationships with tier-1 partner banks and payment processors to optimize cut-off windows, fee structures, and clearing speeds.

  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in financial operations, treasury operations, payment operations, or payroll operations, with at least 2+ years managing high-performing operational teams.

  • Deep familiarity with domestic money movement networks—specifically NACHA rules, ACH clearing cycles, return codes/reasoning, wire networks, and modern real-time rails.

  • Prior experience at a payroll service provider, payroll software/PEO, merchant processor, or B2B embedded fintech platform.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing high-volume, time-sensitive operational queues with strict SLAs.

  • Strong technical understanding of ledger accounting, bank statement reconciliation, and settlement timing differences.

  • Professional certifications such as Accredited ACH Professional (AAP), Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).

  • Experience working directly with bank APIs, SFTP batching, or modern ledgering engines.

  • Working proficiency building operational dashboards and investigating transaction anomalies.

  • Capable of making decisive, level-headed decisions during high-stakes banking outages or settlement delays.

  • A coach who sets clear operational metrics (SLAs, error rates, resolution times) while fostering growth and accountability in team members.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or equivalent experience.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong problem-solving capabilities, and clear written/verbal communication skills.

  • Team-oriented, resilient, proactive and solutions-focused.

  • Customer-service mindset: clear communication, patience, and professionalism when working with stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritize effectively.

  • Must be highly organized, dependable and self-disciplined with a strong work ethic.

  • Solid analytical skills, ability to learn at a fast pace.

Why OnPay?

  • Momentum that matters: We’re backed by over $100MM in new funding and scaling rapidly.

  • Market-leading product: OnPay consistently ranks among the highest-rated payroll solutions, earning top marks for usability, customer satisfaction, and support.

  • Remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S., or join our collaborative HQ team in Atlanta’s Ponce City Market if you reside in the Atlanta metro area.

  • Competitive compensation: Base salary + bonus + stock options = real upside for high performers.

  • Comprehensive benefits: 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision, Short- & Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Fertility Benefits, Parental Leave, and a 401(k) with company match.

  • Growth culture: Join a team with deep employee benefits experience, payroll expertise, market momentum, and a genuine commitment to helping employees grow their careers.

  • Client-first ethos: OnPay is built on a culture of transparency and service — from our transparent pricing to our commitment to making small business simpler.

Location & Compensation

  • Remote (U.S.) | Atlanta HQ Optional

  • Compensation includes a base salary range of $90,000 to $100,000. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At OnPay, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at

Recruiters will never request payments or ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from OnPay, please

raw.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the role:

Hello Heart is looking for a strategic and commercially minded Senior Director, Actuarial Services to lead actuarial strategy, health economic analyses, and financial value demonstration across our business.

In this highly visible role, you will serve as Hello Heart's actuarial expert, translating complex healthcare data into clear, compelling insights that demonstrate the clinical and financial value of our heart health solution. You will partner with customers, consultants, health plans, and internal stakeholders to strengthen our value proposition, support commercial growth, and inform strategic decision-making.

Reporting into our VP, Commercial Actuary, you will collaborate closely with Medical Affairs, Consultant Relations, Sales, Growth, Customer Success, and Finance. You will lead health economic research, develop risk-based pricing models, oversee performance guarantees and related reserves, and represent Hello Heart in high-impact client and consultant engagements.

This is an opportunity to shape how we measure, communicate, and deliver value while advancing our mission to empower people to understand and improve their heart health.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales, Consultant Relations, and Customer Success to strengthen proposals and communicate Hello Heart's economic value.
  • As a client-facing member of the team, join client and consultant calls, performance reviews, and renewal value conversations, providing strategy, decisions, and key input as a credible face of Hello Heart.
  • Advocate for sound actuarial practices, appropriate methodologies, and effective processes that support high-quality analyses and informed decision-making.
  • Serve as one of Hello Heart's primary actuarial subject matter experts, providing strategic guidance on healthcare economics, financial outcomes, pricing, and market opportunities.
  • Lead health economic studies, cost savings analyses, and outcomes research that quantify the impact of Hello Heart and support commercial growth.
  • Leverage medical claims, pharmacy claims, and other large datasets to evaluate healthcare utilization, medication adherence, costs, and financial outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain competitive performance guarantee offerings, assess associated financial risks, oversee reserve requirements, and educate internal stakeholders.
  • Develop risk-based pricing approaches and support value-based contracting and specialty incentive opportunities.
  • Present actuarial and health economic findings to customers, consultants, payers, industry audiences, other external stakeholders, and at conferences.
  • Serve as the primary actuarial contact for independent cost savings studies, research collaborations, and analyses conducted with consultants and external partners.
  • Evaluate the anticipated clinical and financial impact of new products and services, identify market opportunities, and provide actuarial input into strategic planning.
  • Develop executive-ready presentations, research materials, and publications that make complex statistical findings accessible and actionable.
  • Track healthcare market dynamics, competitor trends, Medicare Advantage quality measures, and emerging reimbursement models to inform business decisions.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of actuarial experience within healthcare, health insurance, or a related healthcare organization, including experience conducting health economic and financial analyses.
  • Client-facing or sales-support experience, such as in consulting or a startup, with a track record of presenting analyses to customers, consultants, or executives.
  • A credible storyteller and strong listener who builds trust quickly.
  • Deep knowledge of actuarial principles, healthcare economics, risk assessment, and statistical methodologies, with the ability to apply findings to commercial and strategic decisions.
  • Proficiency in R and experience analyzing large medical and pharmacy claims datasets, including paid and allowed amounts, healthcare utilization, and medication adherence measures.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage artificial intelligence tools and agents to streamline research, analysis, reporting, and complex workflows while critically evaluating outputs for accuracy and reliability.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or a related field.
  • Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) or Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA) credential.
  • Experience developing or evaluating healthcare cost savings studies, financial outcomes research, performance guarantees, and risk-based pricing models.
  • Understanding of risk adjustment, Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, healthcare quality metrics, and related audit processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex actuarial and statistical concepts into compelling presentations for executive and external audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and independently drive high-impact initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time.

In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Establish rapport and trust with managed service provider (MSP) and managed security service provider (MSSP) prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to understand their business and their fit with Huntress.
  • Set qualified meetings within our ideal customer profile by following best practices and standard processes.
  • Generate and qualify net-new accounts and work inbound opportunities to create a pipeline for the Account Executive team.
  • Use clear, value-driven messaging to build interest in Huntress and answer prospect questions with honesty, professionalism, and empathy.
  • Research accounts, document prospecting activity, and qualification notes in CRM, and maintain strong data hygiene.
  • Use AI tools with good judgment to support account research, call prep, and message drafting in your day-to-day work.
  • Keep improving your cold calling, messaging, and pipeline management skills through training, feedback, and repetition.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • 8+ months of experience in a quota-carrying outbound B2B SaaS sales role.
  • Experience with outbound cold calling.
  • Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
  • Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.
  • Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.
  • A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.
  • Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

What We Offer:

  • 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
  • New starter home office set up allowance (€480)
  • Generous personal leave entitlements
  • Digital monthly reimbursement (€111)
  • Travel to the US 1-2 times/year for various company events
  • Pension
  • Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

raw.title: QA Engineer - Ostro
raw.excerpt: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
raw.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

At Veeva Ostro, we are transforming how life sciences connect with the people who need their innovations most. Every day, we help millions live healthier lives by bridging the gap between those who make medicines, treatments, and diagnostics and those who take them.

What You'll Do

    We are seeking a detail-oriented QA Engineer who seamlessly bridges manual precision with automated efficiency. As a disciplined, self-starting problem solver, you take full ownership of software quality without needing micromanagement. Beyond core testing, you bring a strong curiosity for modern QA innovations, including AI-driven testing frameworks and LLM-based approaches, and a drive to help shape the future of our quality processes.

  • Develop and execute manual and automated test plans to ensure SaaS platform quality and reliability
  • Identify, document, and track software defects alongside development teams for rapid resolution
  • Create and maintain test cases, scripts, and data for functional and non-functional testing
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to align on requirements and expected behaviors
  • Research and implement AI-driven automation frameworks and LLM-based techniques to optimize testing
  • Conduct regression and performance testing to ensure system scalability
  • Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines to streamline deployments
  • Deliver clear, structured test reports and status updates to key stakeholders
  • Drive continuous QA process improvements independently with minimal oversight

Requirements

  • 3+ years in software quality assurance, mastering both manual precision and automated testing
  • Hands-on experience with frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium, plus proficiency in JavaScript, Python, or Java
  • Proven ability to validate APIs using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks
  • Practical understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD) for automated test integration
  • Active interest in AI/ML-driven testing solutions and eagerness to experiment with LLM-based testing approaches
  • Strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and complex edge cases
  • Strong communication skills to partner effectively with Dev, Implementation, and Customer Support teams
  • Self-starter who prioritizes tasks, solves problems independently, and owns outcomes without micromanagement

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-driven test automation tools or LLM-based QA methodologies
  • Knowledge of SaaS environments and website-based software deployment
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $70,000 - $120,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at .
